```tsx
import { ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS, ORDER_GROUND_LABELS, ORDER_RULES, type ContactMessage, type OrderSummary, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseOrderId, type OrderId } from "../src/router";
import { changedFacts, CheckBlock, CorrectBlock, EventsBlock, EventsList, FormsBlock, NoticeBlock, OrderPage, OwedBlock, utcWithOffset } from "../src/screens/Order";
import { clockLine, emptyOrderForm, OrderForm, orderRequest, OrdersList, type OrderFormState } from "../src/screens/Orders";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { HOSTILE, HOSTILE_ESCAPED } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * The console's screens of an order (3f design, sections 8.4 and 8.5, Task 2): the clock lines of the list, the form
 * "Open an order" and the blocks of an order's page, rendered on the server. The authority, the reference and each link
 * are an outsider's words, shown as text; nothing decides for a person whether the author must not be told.
 */

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
/** The rendered text without its markup, its entities read back, as a person reads it. */
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;

const ID = "7c4f5e4b-1a7d-4f4b-8e5d-9c3b8a7f6e5d";
const ITEM = "8d5a6f5c-2b8e-4a5c-9f6e-0d4c9b8a7f6e";
const MESSAGE = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const AT = "2026-10-16T02:00:00.000Z";
const START = Date.parse(AT);
/** The instant a number of minutes after AT. */
const t = (minutes: number) => new Date(START + minutes * 60_000).toISOString();

const summary = (over: Partial<OrderSummary> = {}): OrderSummary => ({
  id: ID,
  kind: "tco_removal",
  memberState: "DE",
  authority: "Bundeskriminalamt (BKA)",
  reference: "BKA-2026-1",
  openedAt: AT,
  state: "running",
  clock: { clockStart: AT, stopped: false, stoppedAt: null, stopGround: null, deadlineAt: t(60), targetAt: t(55), itemsOpen: 2, firstEffectAt: null, lastEffectAt: null, withinHour: null },
  dueAt: null,
  closedAt: null,
  closeGround: null,
  items: 2,
  itemsInForce: 0,
  verified: false,
  noticesHeld: 0,
  ...over,
});

const item = (over: Partial<OrderView["items"][number]> = {}): OrderView["items"][number] => ({
  id: ITEM,
  position: 1,
  link: "https://korbat.example/p/1",
  linkKind: "post",
  addedAt: AT,
  unverified: true,
  postId: null,
  post: null,
  decisionId: null,
  caseId: null,
  inForce: false,
  disabledAt: null,
  noEffect: null,
  preserveUntil: null,
  preserveEndedAt: null,
  reinstatedAt: null,
  reinstatedGround: null,
  closedAt: null,
  closedReason: null,
  gap: false,
  ...over,
});

const view = (over: Partial<OrderView> = {}): OrderView => ({
  ...summary(),
  items: [item()],
  channel: "mailbox",
  messageId: MESSAGE,
  receivedAt: AT,
  sentAt: null,
  issuedAt: null,
  sectionC: false,
  emergency: false,
  crossBorder: false,
  withholdFromAuthor: true,
  preserve: true,
  openedBy: "anna",
  openedVia: "console",
  importedAt: null,
  tellPerson: null,
  events: [{ id: "9e6b7a6d-3c9f-4b6d-8a7f-1e5d0c9b8a7f", kind: "opened", ground: null, at: AT, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: "anna", via: "console" }],
  owed: { received: false, verification: true, issuedAt: true, texts: true, document: true, holdUntil: false, tellPerson: false, scrutinyUntil: null },
  hold: null,
  mayClose: true,
  mayEvents: ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect"],
  mayCorrect: "entry",
  ...over,
});

const message = (over: Partial<ContactMessage> = {}): ContactMessage => ({
  id: MESSAGE,
  folder: "inbox",
  receivedAt: AT,
  seenAt: AT,
  stale: false,
  disposition: null,
  handledAt: null,
  handledBy: null,
  orders: [],
  ...over,
});

describe("an order's clock line (8.4's table)", () => {
  test("running: the deadline, the minutes left and the target, each from the clock", () => {
    expect(clockLine(summary(), START + 10 * 60_000)).toBe(
      `Due ${bothTimes(t(60))}: 50 minutes left. Target ${bothTimes(t(55))}: an image may stay in an edge cache for up to 5 minutes after the disabling.`,
    );
  });

  test("overdue, partly given effect, and stopped by an Annex III", () => {
    expect(clockLine(summary({ state: "overdue" }), START + 61 * 60_000)).toBe(`Overdue since ${bothTimes(t(60))}: 2 of 2 items are neither disabled nor closed. Act now.`);
    const partial = summary({ clock: { ...summary().clock!, itemsOpen: 1, firstEffectAt: t(20) } });
    expect(clockLine(partial, START + 30 * 60_000)).toBe(`1 of 2 items disabled, the first at ${bothTimes(t(20))}. 1 are still open: the deadline ${bothTimes(t(60))} still runs for them.`);
    const stopped = summary({ state: "stopped", clock: { ...summary().clock!, stopped: true, stoppedAt: t(10), stopGround: "force_majeure", deadlineAt: null } });
    expect(clockLine(stopped, START + 30 * 60_000)).toBe(
      `Clock stopped at ${bothTimes(t(10))}: Annex III sent (${ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS.force_majeure}). No deadline runs. A fresh ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes start when the grounds cease or the clarification arrives, never the rest of the old hour.`,
    );
  });

  test("given effect: inside the hour, outside it, and while the clock was stopped", () => {
    const effect = (lastEffectAt: string, withinHour: boolean) =>
      summary({ state: "given_effect", clock: { ...summary().clock!, itemsOpen: 0, firstEffectAt: lastEffectAt, lastEffectAt, withinHour } });
    expect(clockLine(effect(t(40), true), START)).toBe(`Given effect: the last post was disabled at ${bothTimes(t(40))}, 40 minutes after the clock started: inside the hour.`);
    expect(clockLine(effect(t(75), false), START)).toBe(`Given effect: the last post was disabled at ${bothTimes(t(75))}, 75 minutes after the clock started: outside the hour.`);
    expect(clockLine(effect(t(75), true), START)).toContain("while the clock was stopped: inside the hour.");
  });

  test("no time of receipt: the deadline is unknown and the line says to act now", () => {
    const unknown = summary({ state: "unknown_deadline", clock: { ...summary().clock!, clockStart: null, deadlineAt: null, targetAt: null } });
    expect(clockLine(unknown, START)).toBe("Deadline unknown: act now. Whoever has the server records the time of receipt with staff.js order-received.");
  });

  test("a DSA order has no clock: its stated deadline or none; a closed order says when, and on which ground", () => {
    expect(clockLine(summary({ kind: "dsa_art9", state: "no_clock", clock: null }), START)).toBe("No deadline recorded: act without undue delay.");
    expect(clockLine(summary({ kind: "dsa_art10", state: "no_clock", clock: null, dueAt: t(600) }), START)).toBe(`Due ${bothTimes(t(600))}, as the order states.`);
    expect(clockLine(summary({ state: "closed", closedAt: t(5), closeGround: "withdrawn" }), START)).toBe(`Closed on ${bothTimes(t(5))} without effect: ${ORDER_GROUND_LABELS.withdrawn}.`);
    expect(clockLine(summary({ state: "closed", closedAt: t(5) }), START)).toBe(`Closed on ${bothTimes(t(5))}.`);
  });
});

describe("the list of orders (8.4)", () => {
  test("each order a block: its kind, its state, the authority and the reference as an outsider's words, its clock line, a link built from its checked id", () => {
    const hostile = summary({ authority: HOSTILE.script, reference: HOSTILE.quote });
    const out = html(<OrdersList page={{ open: [hostile], closed: [] }} now={START} onOpenOrder={noop} />);
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.quote);
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(out).toContain(`href="/orders/${ID}"`);
    expect(text(out)).toContain("As written in the order");
    expect(text(out)).toContain("Germany (DE)");
    expect(text(out)).toContain(clockLine(hostile, START));
    expect(text(out)).toContain("Open this order");
  });

  test("the closed ones under their title; nothing recorded says so; an id that is not a lower-case uuid gets no link", () => {
    const closed = text(html(<OrdersList page={{ open: [], closed: [summary({ state: "closed", closedAt: t(5) })] }} now={START} onOpenOrder={noop} />));
    expect(closed).toContain("Closed in the last 30 days");
    expect(text(html(<OrdersList page={{ open: [], closed: [] }} now={START} onOpenOrder={noop} />))).toBe("No order is recorded.");
    expect(html(<OrdersList page={{ open: [summary({ id: ID.toUpperCase() })], closed: [] }} now={START} onOpenOrder={noop} />)).not.toContain("href=");
  });
});

describe("the form Open an order (8.4)", () => {
  const filled = (over: Partial<OrderFormState> = {}): OrderFormState => ({
    ...emptyOrderForm(),
    message: "none",
    channel: "portal",
    kind: "tco_removal",
    memberState: "DE",
    authorityChoice: "bka",
    reference: "BKA-2026-1",
    links: ["https://korbat.example/p/1", "", "  https://korbat.example/p/2  "].join(String.fromCharCode(10)),
    sectionC: "no",
    ...over,
  });
  const form = (state: OrderFormState, over: Partial<Parameters<typeof OrderForm>[0]> = {}) =>
    html(<OrderForm me={{ homeState: "DE" }} form={state} messages={[message()]} busy={false} problem={null} duplicate={null} onChange={noop} onSubmit={noop} onOpenOrder={noop} {...over} />);

  test("Section C untouched is never sent: the form says no choice is made for you", () => {
    expect(orderRequest(filled({ sectionC: null }))).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "Choose whether the author must not be told: no choice is made for you." });
  });

  test("a removal order: the register's name for the authority, the links one a line, the post kept from its author", () => {
    const sent = orderRequest(filled());
    expect(sent).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      request: {
        messageId: null,
        channel: "portal",
        kind: "tco_removal",
        memberState: "DE",
        authority: "Bundeskriminalamt (BKA)",
        reference: "BKA-2026-1",
        links: ["https://korbat.example/p/1", "https://korbat.example/p/2"],
        sectionC: false,
        emergency: false,
        withholdFromAuthor: true,
      },
    });
    // A message picked is the mailbox, and its id is sent; I cannot tell holds like a tick.
    const picked = orderRequest(filled({ message: MESSAGE, channel: null, sectionC: "unsure", authorityChoice: "other", otherAuthority: HOSTILE.script }));
    expect(picked.ok && picked.request).toMatchObject({ messageId: MESSAGE, channel: "mailbox", sectionC: true, withholdFromAuthor: true, authority: HOSTILE.script });
  });

  test("a DSA order: the withholding only when ticked or forced by Section C; an order to provide information takes no link", () => {
    const art9 = orderRequest(filled({ kind: "dsa_art9" }));
    expect(art9.ok && art9.request.withholdFromAuthor).toBe(false);
    const ticked = orderRequest(filled({ kind: "dsa_art9", withhold: true }));
    expect(ticked.ok && ticked.request.withholdFromAuthor).toBe(true);
    const silent = orderRequest(filled({ kind: "dsa_art9", sectionC: "yes" }));
    expect(silent.ok && silent.request).toMatchObject({ sectionC: true, withholdFromAuthor: true });
    const art10 = orderRequest(filled({ kind: "dsa_art10" }));
    expect(art10.ok && art10.request).toMatchObject({ links: [], withholdFromAuthor: false, emergency: false });
    // Nothing named and nothing to send: the schema refuses it.
    expect(orderRequest(filled({ links: "" })).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  test("nothing is preselected that decides anything; the home state is listed first; the message not listed warns that no deadline shows", () => {
    const empty = form(emptyOrderForm());
    expect(empty).not.toMatch(/checked=""/);
    expect(empty).toMatch(/<option value="" selected="">-<[/]option><option value="DE">Germany [(]DE[)]<[/]option>/);
    expect(text(empty)).toContain("The message is not listed");
    expect(text(empty)).not.toContain("The order is opened without a time of receipt");
    expect(text(form(emptyOrderForm("none")))).toContain("The order is opened without a time of receipt, so korbat cannot show its deadline. Act now, as if the hour were almost over.");
    expect(text(form(emptyOrderForm("none")))).toContain("How it arrived");
  });

  test("DSA Article 9: the withholding is ticked and locked while the author must not be told, or while nobody can tell; free when Section C is not set", () => {
    const box = (out: string) => out.match(/<input type="checkbox"[^>]*>/g) ?? [];
    for (const sectionC of ["yes", "unsure"] as const) {
      const locked = form(filled({ kind: "dsa_art9", sectionC }));
      expect(box(locked)).toEqual(['<input type="checkbox" disabled="" checked=""/>']);
      expect(text(locked)).toContain("An author who must not be told cannot be shown their post marked as removed.");
    }
    const free = form(filled({ kind: "dsa_art9", sectionC: "no" }));
    expect(box(free)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(box(free)[0]).not.toContain("disabled");
    expect(box(free)[0]).not.toContain("checked");
    expect(text(free)).toContain("Tick it only if the order's text says the content must be kept from its author too.");
    // The removal order's own box is the emergency, never the withholding.
    expect(text(form(filled()))).toContain("The order says it is an emergency");
    expect(text(form(filled()))).not.toContain("Withheld from the author");
  });

  test("order_exists links to the order that stands", () => {
    const out = form(filled(), { duplicate: parseOrderId(ID) as OrderId, problem: "x" });
    expect(out).toContain(`href="/orders/${ID}"`);
    expect(text(out)).toContain("Open the order that is recorded");
  });
});

describe("an order's page (8.5, Task 2's blocks)", () => {
  const me = { homeState: "DE", contactPoint: "orders@korbat.example" } as const;
  const page = (order: OrderView, over: Partial<Parameters<typeof OrderPage>[0]> = {}) =>
    html(
      <OrderPage
        order={order}
        me={me}
        now={START}
        messages={[message()]}
        busy={false}
        notice={null}
        error={null}
        reasons={{}}
        links=""
        onReason={noop}
        onCloseItem={noop}
        onLinks={noop}
        onAddLinks={noop}
        onRecord={noop}
        onCorrect={noop}
        {...over}
      />,
    );

  test("the clock comes first, under the kind; there is no block 4 and no Extension received yet (Task 3's)", () => {
    const out = text(page(view()));
    expect(out.indexOf(clockLine({ ...view(), items: 1 }, START))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(out.indexOf(clockLine({ ...view(), items: 1 }, START))).toBeLessThan(out.indexOf("As written in the order"));
    expect(out).not.toContain("Disable for an order");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Extension received");
  });

  test("block 2: a removal order is checked against the register, the authority drawn as text, with the home state's entries", () => {
    const out = html(<CheckBlock order={view({ authority: HOSTILE.script })} me={me} />);
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(`Before you act, check the order against your offline copy of the Commission's register: is ${HOSTILE.script} listed for Germany, and does the address`);
    expect(text(out)).toContain("Bundeskriminalamt (BKA): Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), contact point TCO@bka.bund.de");
    expect(text(out)).toContain("If you are in doubt and the hour is running, give effect");
    const dsa = text(html(<CheckBlock order={view({ kind: "dsa_art9", clock: null })} me={me} />));
    expect(dsa).toContain("No register lists who may issue such an order.");
    expect(dsa).toContain("it is given effect only after the check is recorded");
    expect(text(html(<CheckBlock order={view({ kind: "dsa_art9", clock: null, verified: true })} me={me} />))).not.toContain("given effect only after the check");
  });

  test("block 3: each link as an outsider's words; an account's and a missing link's lines; closing an open item needs a reason", () => {
    const items = [item({ link: HOSTILE.url, linkKind: "account" }), item({ id: "1f7c8b7e-4d0a-4c7e-9b8a-2f6e1d0c9b8a", position: 2, linkKind: "other" })];
    const out = page(view({ items }));
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE.url);
    expect(out).not.toContain(`href="${HOSTILE.url}"`);
    expect(text(out)).toContain("This link names an account, not a post.");
    expect(text(out)).toContain("This link names nothing that korbat serves.");
    expect(out.match(/<button type="button" disabled="">Close this item without effect<[/]button>/g)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(page(view({ items }), { reasons: { [ITEM]: "no_post" } }).match(/<button type="button">Close this item without effect<[/]button>/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    // A disabled item, and an order nobody may correct, offer no closing.
    expect(text(page(view({ items: [item({ disabledAt: t(30) })] })))).toContain(`Disabled at ${bothTimes(t(30))}`);
    expect(text(page(view({ items: [item({ disabledAt: t(30) })] })))).not.toContain("Close this item without effect");
    expect(text(page(view({ mayCorrect: null })))).not.toContain("Close this item without effect");
  });

  test("block 5: only the events the database would take now; each is confirmed by the key, with its ground or message chosen first", () => {
    const out = html(<EventsBlock order={view({ mayEvents: ["annex3_sent", "clarification_received", "hold_extended"] })} messages={[message()]} busy={false} onRecord={noop} />);
    expect(text(out)).toContain("Annex III sent: Confirm with your staff key");
    expect(text(out)).toContain("Clarification received: Confirm with your staff key");
    expect(text(out)).toContain(ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS.insufficient_information);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(`Received ${bothTimes(AT)}, Inbox`);
    expect(text(out)).not.toContain("Close without effect");
    expect(out.match(/<button type="button" disabled="">/g)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(html(<EventsBlock order={view({ mayEvents: [] })} messages={[]} busy={false} onRecord={noop} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("block 6: the forms' values as text, the time in UTC with its offset, the contact point and the copy from the home state's facts", () => {
    expect(utcWithOffset("2026-10-10T01:00:12.345Z")).toBe("2026-10-10 01:00:12 +00:00");
    const stopped = view({ clock: { ...summary().clock!, stopped: true, stoppedAt: t(10), stopGround: "manifest_error" } });
    const out = text(html(<FormsBlock order={stopped} me={me} />));
    expect(out).toContain("Reference of the removal order: BKA-2026-1");
    expect(out).toContain("Issuing authority: Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Germany (DE)");
    expect(out).toContain("Time and date of receipt of removal order: 2026-10-16 02:00:00 +00:00");
    expect(out).toContain(`Reason: ${ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS.manifest_error}`);
    expect(out).toContain("Contact point: orders@korbat.example");
    expect(out).toContain("Copy to: TCO@bka.bund.de");
    expect(text(html(<FormsBlock order={view()} me={{ homeState: null, contactPoint: null }} />))).toContain("Contact point: not filled in: see the README, Before going public");
    expect(html(<FormsBlock order={view({ kind: "dsa_art9", clock: null })} me={me} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("block 7: what the command line owes, one line each; nothing owed, no block", () => {
    const out = text(html(<OwedBlock order={view()} />));
    expect(out).toContain("The check is not recorded (staff.js order-verify).");
    expect(out).toContain("The order's own date and time are not recorded (staff.js order-issued).");
    expect(out).toContain("The authority's reasons and remedies are not recorded (staff.js order-texts).");
    expect(out).toContain("The document's digest is not recorded (staff.js order-document).");
    const none = { received: false, verification: false, issuedAt: false, texts: false, document: false, holdUntil: false, tellPerson: false, scrutinyUntil: null };
    expect(html(<OwedBlock order={view({ owed: none })} />)).toBe("");
    const dsa = text(html(<OwedBlock order={view({ kind: "dsa_art9", clock: null, owed: { ...none, texts: true } })} />));
    expect(dsa).toContain("Record the authority's reasons, its remedies and the order's territorial scope before you give effect");
  });

  test("block 8: told at the effect, or held: with no end, until the computed end, released", () => {
    expect(text(html(<NoticeBlock order={view({ items: [item({ disabledAt: t(30) })] })} />))).toContain(`Told at ${bothTimes(t(30))}.`);
    const hold = { until: null, basis: "regulation", open: true, extended: false, endedAt: null, endReason: null, releasedAt: null, noticesHeld: 1 } as const;
    expect(text(html(<NoticeBlock order={view({ sectionC: true, hold })} />))).toContain("Held with no end");
    const until = text(html(<NoticeBlock order={view({ sectionC: true, hold: { ...hold, open: false, until: t(60_000), releasedAt: t(60_000) } })} />));
    expect(until).toContain(`Held until ${bothTimes(t(60_000))}: the end the database computes from the Regulation's six weeks, counted from the receipt.`);
    expect(until).toContain(`Released at ${bothTimes(t(60_000))}.`);
    expect(html(<NoticeBlock order={view()} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("block 9: the events newest first, each with who wrote it, a handle as text", () => {
    const events: OrderView["events"] = [
      { id: "9e6b7a6d-3c9f-4b6d-8a7f-1e5d0c9b8a7f", kind: "opened", ground: null, at: AT, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: HOSTILE.script, via: "console" },
      { id: "0a7c8b7e-4d0a-4c7e-9b8a-2f6e1d0c9b8b", kind: "annex3_sent", ground: "force_majeure", at: t(10), effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: null, via: "cli" },
    ];
    const out = html(<EventsList order={view({ events })} />);
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    const read = text(out);
    expect(read.indexOf(`${bothTimes(t(10))}: Annex III sent: ${ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS.force_majeure}`)).toBeLessThan(read.indexOf(`${bothTimes(AT)}: Order opened`));
    expect(read).toContain("command line");
    expect(read).toContain(`@${HOSTILE.script}, console`);
  });

  test("block 10: the rule decides the controls; a correction sends what changes and nothing else", () => {
    expect(html(<CorrectBlock order={view({ mayCorrect: null })} busy={false} onCorrect={noop} />)).toBe("");
    const caution = text(html(<CorrectBlock order={view({ mayCorrect: "caution" })} busy={false} onCorrect={noop} />));
    expect(caution).toContain("Section C is ticked: the author must not be told");
    expect(caution).not.toContain("Issuing state");
    expect(html(<CorrectBlock order={view({ mayCorrect: "caution", sectionC: true })} busy={false} onCorrect={noop} />)).toBe("");
    const entry = html(<CorrectBlock order={view()} busy={false} onCorrect={noop} />);
    expect(entry).toMatch(/<button type="button" disabled="">Correct<[/]button>/);
    // An order opened from a message keeps its channel: the field is offered only without one.
    expect(text(entry)).not.toContain("How it arrived");
    expect(text(html(<CorrectBlock order={view({ messageId: null, channel: "portal" })} busy={false} onCorrect={noop} />))).toContain("How it arrived");
    expect(text(html(<CorrectBlock order={view({ mayCorrect: "admin" })} busy={false} onCorrect={noop} />))).toContain("Correct: Confirm with your staff key");
    const order = view();
    const same = { kind: order.kind, memberState: order.memberState, authority: order.authority, reference: order.reference, channel: order.channel, sectionC: order.sectionC, emergency: order.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: order.withholdFromAuthor };
    expect(changedFacts(order, same)).toEqual({});
    expect(changedFacts(order, { ...same, reference: "BKA-2026-2", channel: "post" })).toEqual({ reference: "BKA-2026-2" });
    expect(changedFacts(view({ messageId: null }), { ...same, channel: "post" })).toEqual({ channel: "post" });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/cli-orders.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { STAFF_USAGE, runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, newPostRow, newTestStaff, removeFixtures, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, orderForTest, removeOrderAlerts, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const NEWLINE = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * The order commands of the command line (3f design, sections 7.4, 7.7 and 8.11; W.8): each as the migrator, one
 * transaction with the 10-second lock timeout, the order's row first, its event via `cli` and its audit row
 * order_recorded last under the system actor, never a text in the audit row but its digest; a refusal is one sentence
 * ending in "nothing changed", exit 1, and writes nothing. order-open writes the console's rows through insertOrder with
 * the receipt it is given, its alert order_opened before its audit row, and refuses without HOME_STATE and APP_ORIGIN. An
 * order is named by its id or as <CC>:<reference>, order_ambiguous when several share it; an instant has its offset.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the order commands", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staff: TestStaff;
  let author: { id: string };
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();
  // Read in beforeAll: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
  let appOrigin: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    staff = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, staff);
    author = await newProfile(w.apiDb);
    // Counted once the staff and the profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [staff.id, author.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
    await w.close();
  });

  const env = (extra: Record<string, string> = {}) => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin, ...extra });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], options: { env?: Record<string, string>; input?: string | Buffer } = {}) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const input = async () => (options.input === undefined ? Buffer.alloc(0) : Buffer.isBuffer(options.input) ? options.input : Buffer.from(options.input, "utf8"));
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, options.env ?? env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, input);
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };
  }
  const orderRow = async (id: string) => (await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.legal_orders where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  const eventsOf = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; ground: string | null; via: string }>(sql`select kind, ground, via from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${id}::uuid order by at, id`)).map((e) => [
      e.kind,
      e.ground,
      e.via,
    ]);
  const lastAudit = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${id} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    ))[0]!;
  /** An order opened in the console, without a message, for the commands to record against. */
  const consoleOrder = async (kind: "tco_removal" | "dsa_art9" | "dsa_art10" = "tco_removal", sectionC = false) => {
    const view = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { kind, sectionC, links: kind === "dsa_art10" ? [] : ["https://elsewhere.example/cli"], withholdFromAuthor: kind === "tco_removal" || sectionC });
    orders.push(view.id);
    return view;
  };

  test("the usage lists every order command", () => {
    for (const command of ["order-open", "order-received", "order-sent-at", "order-due", "order-verify", "order-issued", "order-texts", "order-document", "order-scrutiny", "order-reopen", "order-tell-rule", "order-told"]) {
      expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command} `);
    }
  });

  test("order-open: the console's rows with the receipt it is given, the alert order_opened and its audit row as the system actor; without HOME_STATE or APP_ORIGIN it refuses", async () => {
    const post = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const refused = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "tco_removal", "--state", "DE", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", "X", "--channel", "portal", "--link", "https://e.example/x"], {
      env: { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! },
    });
    expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: 1, lines: ["err order-open: HOME_STATE and APP_ORIGIN must be set for the migrate service; nothing changed"] });
    const received = new Date(Date.now() - 20 * 60_000);
    const reference = `CLI-${randomUUID()}`;
    const opened = await cli([
      "order-open",
      "--kind",
      "tco_removal",
      "--state",
      "FR",
      "--authority",
      "Office central",
      "--reference",
      reference,
      "--channel",
      "post",
      "--received",
      received.toISOString(),
      "--section-c",
      "--link",
      `${appOrigin}/post/${post}`,
      "--link",
      "https://elsewhere.example/named",
    ]);
    expect(opened.code, opened.text).toBe(0);
    const id = /order ([0-9a-f-]{36}) opened/.exec(opened.text)![1]!;
    orders.push(id);
    const deadline = new Date(received.getTime() + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString();
    expect(opened.lines).toEqual([`out order-open: order ${id} opened: tco_removal, FR, reference ${reference}, 2 items (1 name no post). Receipt: ${received.toISOString()}; deadline ${deadline}.`]);
    const row = await orderRow(id);
    expect([row.opened_via, row.opened_by, row.cross_border, row.section_c, row.withhold_from_author, row.preserve, row.channel]).toEqual(["cli", null, true, true, true, true, "post"]);
    expect(await eventsOf(id)).toEqual([["opened", null, "cli"]]);
    const [alert] = await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: Record<string, unknown>; mailed: boolean }>(
      sql`select kind, facts, mailed_at is not null as mailed from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${id}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(alert).toEqual({ kind: "order_opened", facts: { items: 2, dueAt: deadline, unknown: 0 }, mailed: false });
    const audit = await lastAudit(id);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.metadata.via, audit.metadata.reference]).toEqual(["order_opened", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "cli", reference]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(audit.metadata)).not.toContain("elsewhere.example/named");
    // The same reference again: refused, nothing changed.
    const again = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "tco_removal", "--state", "FR", "--authority", "Office central", "--reference", reference, "--channel", "post", "--link", "https://e.example/y"]);
    expect([again.code, again.text]).toEqual([1, "err order-open: an order of this authority with this reference is already recorded (order_exists); nothing changed"]);
    // Without a receipt: the console says deadline unknown.
    const unknown = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "tco_removal", "--state", "DE", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", `U-${randomUUID()}`, "--channel", "other", "--link", "https://e.example/u"]);
    orders.push(/order ([0-9a-f-]{36}) opened/.exec(unknown.text)![1]!);
    expect(unknown.text).toMatch(/Receipt not recorded: the console says deadline unknown[.]$/);
  });

  test("order-open from a listed message: the message's receipt, the channel mailbox, the message handled as an order", async () => {
    const m = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60_000), "junk");
    messages.push(m);
    const opened = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "dsa_art9", "--state", "DE", "--authority", "Staatsanwaltschaft", "--reference", `M-${randomUUID()}`, "--channel", "mailbox", "--message", m, "--link", "https://e.example/m"]);
    expect(opened.code, opened.text).toBe(0);
    const id = /order ([0-9a-f-]{36}) opened/.exec(opened.text)![1]!;
    orders.push(id);
    const [msg] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; stamped: boolean; received: Date }>(sql`select disposition, handled_at is not null as stamped, received_at as received from public.contact_messages where id = ${m}::uuid`);
    expect([msg!.disposition, msg!.stamped]).toEqual(["order", true]);
    // A row read with select * may hold its times as text: each is compared as an instant.
    expect(new Date((await orderRow(id)).received_at as string | Date).getTime()).toBe(new Date(msg!.received).getTime());
    const portal = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "dsa_art9", "--state", "DE", "--authority", "S", "--reference", `P-${randomUUID()}`, "--channel", "portal", "--message", m, "--link", "https://e.example/p"]);
    expect(portal).toMatchObject({ code: 1, text: "err order-open: an order whose message is listed arrived by mail: --channel mailbox; nothing changed" });
  });

  test("the receipt, the sending time and a DSA order's deadline; an instant without its offset is refused", async () => {
    const order = await consoleOrder();
    const noOffset = await cli(["order-received", order.id, "2026-10-10T01:00:12"]);
    expect(noOffset).toMatchObject({ code: 1, text: "err order-received: 2026-10-10T01:00:12 is not an instant with an offset; nothing changed" });
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 60_000);
    const received = await cli(["order-received", order.id, at.toISOString()]);
    expect(received.text).toBe(`out order-received: receipt ${at.toISOString()}; deadline ${new Date(at.getTime() + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString()}.`);
    expect((await cli(["order-received", order.id, at.toISOString()])).code).toBe(1);
    const sent = new Date(at.getTime() - 5 * 60_000);
    expect((await cli(["order-sent-at", order.id, sent.toISOString()])).text).toBe(`out order-sent-at: sent ${sent.toISOString()}; the clock starts ${sent.toISOString()}.`);
    expect((await cli(["order-due", order.id, "none"])).text).toBe("err order-due: a removal order's deadline is its hour, from its receipt; nothing changed");
    const dsa = await consoleOrder("dsa_art9");
    const due = new Date(Date.now() + 86_400_000);
    expect((await cli(["order-due", `DE:${dsa.reference}`, due.toISOString()])).text).toBe(`out order-due: due ${due.toISOString()}.`);
    expect(await eventsOf(order.id)).toEqual([
      ["opened", null, "console"],
      ["received_set", null, "cli"],
      ["sent_at_set", null, "cli"],
    ]);
    const audit = await lastAudit(order.id);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.metadata.event]).toEqual(["order_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "sent_at_set"]);
  });

  test("order-verify records the check, its text only as a digest in the audit row; an item added later is unverified again", async () => {
    const order = await consoleOrder();
    const how = "Register entry BKA, checked by phone against the copy of the register";
    const verified = await cli(["order-verify", order.id, "--how", how]);
    expect(verified.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`^out order-verify: order ${order.id} verified at [0-9T:.Z-]+: 1 items compared with the order[.]$`));
    const audit = await lastAudit(order.id);
    expect(audit.metadata.howSha256).toBe(createHash("sha256").update(how).digest("hex"));
    expect(JSON.stringify(audit.metadata)).not.toContain("by phone");
    expect((await cli(["order-verify", order.id])).text).toBe("err order-verify: --how is required; nothing changed");
  });

  test("order-issued: refused after the receipt; recorded before it, with the notice's hold", async () => {
    const order = await consoleOrder("tco_removal", true);
    await cli(["order-received", order.id, new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60_000).toISOString()]);
    expect((await cli(["order-issued", order.id, new Date().toISOString()])).text).toBe("err order-issued: an order is not issued after it was received; nothing changed");
    const issued = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 60_000);
    const done = await cli(["order-issued", order.id, issued.toISOString()]);
    expect(done.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`^out order-issued: issued ${issued.toISOString()}; the notice is held until [0-9T:.Z-]+[.]$`));
  });

  test("order-texts reads the authority's words from standard input, with salt and digest; the audit row holds the digest; order-document keeps the digest and the length alone", async () => {
    const order = await consoleOrder("dsa_art9");
    const reasons = `The content incites violence.${NEWLINE}Article 9 order of the authority.`;
    const recorded = await cli(["order-texts", order.id, "--reasons"], { input: reasons });
    expect(recorded.text).toBe(`out order-texts: reasons recorded (${Array.from(reasons).length} characters). No author has been told of this order: the notice shows the text from its first telling.`);
    const row = await orderRow(order.id);
    expect([row.reasons, typeof row.reasons_salt, typeof row.reasons_digest]).toEqual([reasons, "string", "string"]);
    expect((await lastAudit(order.id)).metadata).toEqual({ event: "texts_recorded", text: "reasons", digest: row.reasons_digest });
    expect((await cli(["order-texts", order.id, "--scope"], { input: "x".repeat(501) })).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["order-texts", order.id, "--reasons", "--redress"], { input: "x" })).text).toBe("err order-texts: give exactly one of --reasons, --redress and --scope; nothing changed");
    const document = Buffer.from("%PDF-1.7 an order's document");
    const doc = await cli(["order-document", order.id], { input: document });
    const digest = createHash("sha256").update(document).digest("hex");
    expect(doc.text).toBe(`out order-document: ${digest}, ${document.length} bytes.`);
    expect([(await orderRow(order.id)).document_sha256, Number((await orderRow(order.id)).document_bytes)]).toEqual([digest, document.length]);
  });

  test("order-scrutiny and order-reopen", async () => {
    const order = await consoleOrder();
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString();
    expect((await cli(["order-scrutiny", order.id, "requested", "--by", "korbat", "--at", at])).text).toBe("out order-scrutiny: request recorded.");
    expect((await cli(["order-scrutiny", order.id, "decided", "--outcome", "annulled", "--at", at])).text).toBe(
      "out order-scrutiny: decided: annulled. An admin reinstates each item on its case, ground scrutiny, at once.",
    );
    expect((await cli(["order-reopen", order.id, "--how", "closed by mistake"])).text).toBe("err order-reopen: the order is not closed; nothing changed");
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    expect((await cli(["order-reopen", order.id, "--how", "closed by mistake"])).text).toBe(`out order-reopen: order ${order.id} is open again. Its times are unchanged.`);
    expect(await eventsOf(order.id)).toEqual([
      ["opened", null, "console"],
      ["scrutiny_requested", null, "cli"],
      ["scrutiny_decided", "annulled", "cli"],
      ["reopened", null, "cli"],
    ]);
  });

  test("order-tell-rule and order-told: an order to provide information alone; the home state's default when --when is left out; told only once the rule allows it", async () => {
    const info = await consoleOrder("dsa_art10");
    expect((await cli(["order-told", info.id, "--at", new Date().toISOString(), "--how", "mail"])).text).toBe(
      "err order-told: whether the person may be told of this order is not recorded: run staff.js order-tell-rule first; nothing changed",
    );
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", info.id])).text).toBe("err order-tell-rule: the home state's default is never; give --when to record a rule; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", info.id, "--when", "never", "--basis", "TDDDG s. 22"])).text).toBe("out order-tell-rule: the person is told never, on the basis recorded.");
    expect((await cli(["order-told", info.id, "--at", new Date().toISOString(), "--how", "mail"])).text).toBe("err order-told: the rule recorded for this order is that the person is never told; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", info.id, "--when", "at_effect", "--basis", "the order's sentence 3"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect((await cli(["order-told", info.id, "--at", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "mail from the contact address"])).text).toMatch(/^out order-told: recorded at /);
    const removal = await consoleOrder();
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", removal.id, "--when", "never", "--basis", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
  });

  test("an order named as <CC>:<reference> while several orders of the state share it is order_ambiguous, naming each by its id", async () => {
    const reference = `AMB-${randomUUID()}`;
    const one = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { reference, authority: "Authority one", links: ["https://e.example/a1"] });
    const two = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { reference, authority: "Authority two", links: ["https://e.example/a2"] });
    orders.push(one.id, two.id);
    const named = await cli(["order-verify", `DE:${reference}`, "--how", "x"]);
    expect(named.code).toBe(1);
    expect(named.text).toContain(`err order_ambiguous: 2 orders of DE have this reference; name one by its id:`);
    expect(named.text).toContain(one.id);
    expect(named.text).toContain(two.id);
    expect(named.text).toMatch(/nothing changed$/);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);
    // The post an order named, once no item names it.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.posts where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-staff-orders.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ErrorEnvelope, OrderView, OrdersPage, StaffMe, StaffStepUpOptionsResponse, type AuthenticationResponseJSON } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth, type Auth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration, type Moderation } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { createStaff } from "../../src/staff";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, casesMedia, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, disableItemForTest, removeOrderAlerts, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { DEVICE_BOUND, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
const MARKED = { "x-staff-activity": "1" };

/**
 * The routes of order records through the real app (3f design, sections 7.4, 7.5, 10.2 and 10.3; invariants 10, 24 and
 * 25 over HTTP): every route behind the staff session; an order opened with and without a message, without a key, 201
 * with its view; order_exists with the order that stands; links added; the list and one order, 404 for an unknown one; a
 * clock event under the step-up order_event_recorded, refused without it, an admin's closing refused to a moderator; a
 * correction without a key under entry and caution, and under admin only with the step-up order_corrected
 * (staff_step_up_required without it). /api/staff/me carries the home state and the contact point. Every answer is held
 * to its contract, and the last test to leaving no row behind but the audit rows.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the order routes over HTTP", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let auth: Auth;
  let moderation: Moderation;
  let app: ReturnType<typeof createApp>;
  let moderator: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let admin: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const staffIds: string[] = [];
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig({ ...process.env, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, CONSOLE_RP_ID: "", HOME_STATE: "DE", CONTACT_POINT: "authorities@korbat.example" });
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    auth = createAuth({ config, logger, authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore, config, logger });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, staff: createStaff({ apiDb, auth: auth.forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff }), moderation });
    moderator = await staffBrowser("moderator");
    admin = await staffBrowser("admin");
    // Counted once the staff and the profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await moderation.settle();
    await removeOrders(migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, staffIds);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const consoleBrowser = () => new Browser(app, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, { base: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, csrfCookie: STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE, csrfHeader: "x-staff-csrf" });
  const refusal = async (res: Response): Promise<[number, string]> => [res.status, ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code];
  async function held<T>(schema: { parse(raw: unknown): T }, res: Response): Promise<T> {
    expect([200, 201], await res.clone().text()).toContain(res.status);
    const raw = await res.json();
    const read = schema.parse(raw);
    expect(raw).toStrictEqual(read);
    return read;
  }

  /** A staff account with a profile and one key enrolled through the flow, signed in from the console's browser. */
  async function staffBrowser(role: "moderator" | "admin") {
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, role);
    await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: user.id, handle: `o_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`, displayName: "Staff" });
    staffIds.push(user.id);
    const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const link = await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id);
    const enrolled = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, soft, link.token);
    let counter = 0;
    const assert = (challenge: string) => soft.get({ credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: ++counter });
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    const options = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/options", { method: "POST" });
    const { challenge } = ((await options.json()) as { options: { challenge: string } }).options;
    const signedIn = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", { json: { response: assert(challenge) } });
    expect(signedIn.status, await signedIn.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return { id: user.id, b, assert };
  }
  type Staff = typeof moderator;
  /** The key's confirmation of exactly this action on the order, asked for as the console asks for it. */
  async function confirmation(s: Staff, action: "order_event_recorded" | "order_corrected", orderId: string, params: unknown): Promise<AuthenticationResponseJSON> {
    const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: { action, target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params }, headers: MARKED });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return s.assert(StaffStepUpOptionsResponse.parse(await res.json()).options.challenge);
  }
  const openBody = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
    messageId: null,
    channel: "portal",
    kind: "tco_removal",
    memberState: "DE",
    authority: "Bundeskriminalamt",
    reference: `HTTP-${randomUUID()}`,
    links: ["https://elsewhere.example/http"],
    sectionC: false,
    emergency: false,
    withholdFromAuthor: true,
    ...over,
  });
  const open = async (s: Staff, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
    const view = await held(OrderView, await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/orders", { json: openBody(over), headers: MARKED }));
    orders.push(view.id);
    return view;
  };
  const event = async (s: Staff, orderId: string, params: { kind: string; ground: string | null; messageId: string | null }, keyed = true) =>
    s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}/events`, { json: keyed ? { ...params, stepUp: await confirmation(s, "order_event_recorded", orderId, params) } : params, headers: MARKED });
  const correct = async (s: Staff, orderId: string, facts: Record<string, unknown>, keyed = false) =>
    s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}/correct`, { json: keyed ? { facts, stepUp: await confirmation(s, "order_corrected", orderId, { facts }) } : { facts }, headers: MARKED });

  test("every order route needs a staff session", async () => {
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    const id = randomUUID();
    for (const [path, init] of [
      ["/api/staff/orders", undefined],
      [`/api/staff/orders/${id}`, undefined],
      ["/api/staff/orders", { json: openBody() }],
      [`/api/staff/orders/${id}/items`, { json: { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/x"] } }],
      [`/api/staff/orders/${id}/events`, { json: { kind: "annex3_sent", ground: "manifest_error", messageId: null } }],
      [`/api/staff/orders/${id}/correct`, { json: { facts: { emergency: true } } }],
    ] as const) {
      expect(await refusal(await b.fetch(path, init as never)), path).toEqual([401, "staff_session_required"]);
    }
  });

  test("/api/staff/me carries the home state and the contact point", async () => {
    const me = await held(StaffMe, await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/me"));
    expect([me.homeState, me.contactPoint]).toEqual(["DE", "authorities@korbat.example"]);
  });

  test("an order opened from a message and without one, without a key; the list and the read; an unknown order is 404; the same reference again is order_exists with the order that stands", async () => {
    const m = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 60_000), "inbox");
    messages.push(m);
    const fromMessage = await open(moderator, { messageId: m, channel: "mailbox" });
    expect([fromMessage.channel, fromMessage.receivedAt !== null, fromMessage.state, fromMessage.openedBy]).toEqual(["mailbox", true, "running", expect.stringMatching(/^o_/)]);
    const without = await open(moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", withholdFromAuthor: false, channel: "other" });
    expect([without.channel, without.receivedAt, without.state, without.clock]).toEqual(["other", null, "no_clock", null]);
    const page = await held(OrdersPage, await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/orders", { headers: MARKED }));
    expect(page.open.map((o) => o.id)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([fromMessage.id, without.id]));
    expect((await held(OrderView, await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/orders/${fromMessage.id}`))).id).toBe(fromMessage.id);
    expect(await refusal(await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/orders/${randomUUID()}`))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    const again = await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/orders", { json: openBody({ reference: fromMessage.reference }), headers: MARKED });
    const body = ErrorEnvelope.parse(await again.json());
    expect([again.status, body.error.code, body.error.details]).toEqual([409, "order_exists", { orderId: fromMessage.id }]);
    // A request that would hold a notice on a post its author sees is refused by the schema.
    expect(await refusal(await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/orders", { json: openBody({ sectionC: true, withholdFromAuthor: false, kind: "dsa_art9" }), headers: MARKED }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
  });

  test("links are added without a key", async () => {
    const order = await open(moderator);
    const added = await held(OrderView, await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/orders/${order.id}/items`, { json: { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/more"] }, headers: MARKED }));
    expect(added.items.map((i) => i.position)).toEqual([1, 2]);
  });

  test("a clock event needs its step-up; an Annex III stops the clock and a clarification with its message starts a fresh hour; a closing is an admin's", async () => {
    const order = await open(moderator);
    expect(await refusal(await event(moderator, order.id, { kind: "annex3_sent", ground: "manifest_error", messageId: null }, false))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_required"]);
    const stopped = await held(OrderView, await event(moderator, order.id, { kind: "annex3_sent", ground: "manifest_error", messageId: null }));
    expect([stopped.state, stopped.clock!.stopped, stopped.clock!.stopGround, stopped.clock!.deadlineAt]).toEqual(["stopped", true, "manifest_error", null]);
    expect(stopped.mayEvents).toContain("clarification_received");
    expect(await refusal(await event(moderator, order.id, { kind: "grounds_ceased", ground: null, messageId: null }))).toEqual([422, "order_event_refused"]);
    const m = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(), "inbox");
    messages.push(m);
    const restarted = await held(OrderView, await event(moderator, order.id, { kind: "clarification_received", ground: null, messageId: m }));
    expect([restarted.state, restarted.clock!.stopped]).toEqual(["running", false]);
    expect(restarted.events.map((e) => e.kind)).toEqual(["opened", "annex3_sent", "clarification_received"]);
    expect(await refusal(await event(moderator, order.id, { kind: "closed_without_effect", ground: "withdrawn", messageId: null }))).toEqual([403, "admin_required"]);
    const closed = await held(OrderView, await event(admin, order.id, { kind: "closed_without_effect", ground: "withdrawn", messageId: null }));
    expect([closed.state, closed.closeGround, closed.mayCorrect]).toEqual(["closed", "withdrawn", null]);
    expect(await refusal(await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/orders/${order.id}/items`, { json: { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/late"] }, headers: MARKED }))).toEqual([409, "order_closed"]);
    const reopened = await held(OrderView, await event(admin, order.id, { kind: "reopened", ground: null, messageId: null }));
    expect(reopened.closedAt).toBeNull();
  });

  test("a correction: entry without a key; after an effect, caution without one, and admin only with the step-up order_corrected", async () => {
    const order = await open(moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", withholdFromAuthor: false, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c1", "https://elsewhere.example/c2"] });
    const entry = await held(OrderView, await correct(moderator, order.id, { reference: `${order.reference}-fixed` }));
    expect(entry.events.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: "corrected", ground: "entry" });
    await disableItemForTest(migrateDb, order.items[0]!.id);
    expect(await refusal(await correct(moderator, order.id, { emergency: true }))).toEqual([403, "admin_required"]);
    expect(await refusal(await correct(admin, order.id, { emergency: true }))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_required"]);
    const keyed = await held(OrderView, await correct(admin, order.id, { emergency: true }, true));
    expect([keyed.emergency, keyed.events.at(-1)!.ground]).toEqual([true, "admin"]);
    const caution = await held(OrderView, await correct(moderator, order.id, { sectionC: true }));
    expect([caution.sectionC, caution.withholdFromAuthor, caution.events.at(-1)!.ground]).toEqual([true, true, "caution"]);
    expect(await refusal(await correct(moderator, order.id, { openedBy: "x" } as never))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind but the audit rows", async () => {
    await moderation.settle();
    await removeOrders(migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(migrateDb, started);
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-clock.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, newTestStaff, raised, removeFixtures, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, nextValidity, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, removeOrderAlerts, orderForTest, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;

/**
 * The clock of a removal order (3f design, section 2 rows 4, 10 and 11, sections 6.2 and 7.5; invariants 10 and 26, the
 * view; LAB B on the real code). legal_order_clock starts at the earlier of the receipt and the sending time, and again
 * at the newest restart; an Annex III newer than that restart stops it; a fresh hour from a cease or a clarification,
 * never the rest of the old one; within_hour is null while an item is open and judges the last disabling afterwards, true
 * for one given while the clock was stopped. order_event_record holds the rule the console shows: a cease only after an
 * Annex III for force majeure, a clarification only after one on another ground, and a restart takes the later of the
 * message's time and the Annex III's. An order is opened once; an order without a message is accepted at any time, with
 * the channel the person picked, and one opened from a message is mailbox whatever was sent; a message a mail host stamps
 * ahead of the database's clock is stored at the clock's time, so an order opened from it at once meets no CHECK.
 *
 * The view's tests write the orders, items and events as the migrator, with the times they name, in transactions rolled
 * back; the function's run as the API role, rolled back too. What commits is removed, and the last test holds the file to
 * leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: an order's clock and its events", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staff: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    staff = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, staff);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    // Counted once the staff and the profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [staff.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A removal order of the migrator's in the transaction, received and sent at the times given (minutes ago, or none). */
  async function orderIn(tx: DbTx, times: { received?: number | null; sent?: number | null; kind?: string } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const at = (minutes: number | null | undefined) => (minutes === null || minutes === undefined ? null : new Date(Date.now() - minutes * MIN).toISOString());
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, received_at, sent_at, opened_by, opened_via)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${times.kind ?? "tco_removal"}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`C-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true,
              ${at(times.received === undefined ? 10 : times.received)}::timestamptz, ${at(times.sent)}::timestamptz, ${staff.id}::uuid, 'cli')
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  }
  /** An item of the order, disabled or closed `minutes` ago when asked. */
  async function itemIn(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, position: number, state: { disabled?: number; closed?: number } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const at = (minutes: number | undefined) => (minutes === undefined ? null : new Date(Date.now() - minutes * MIN).toISOString());
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, post_id, added_at, disabled_at, closed_at, closed_reason)
      values (${orderId}::uuid, ${position}, ${`https://elsewhere.example/${position}`}, null, now(), ${at(state.disabled)}::timestamptz, ${at(state.closed)}::timestamptz,
              ${state.closed === undefined ? null : "no_post"})
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  }
  /** An event of the migrator's at a time `minutes` ago, effective at another when given. */
  const eventIn = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string, kind: string, minutes: number, ground: string | null = null, effective?: number) =>
    tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, effective_at, via)
                   values (${orderId}::uuid, ${kind}, ${ground}, now() - make_interval(secs => ${minutes * 60}), ${effective === undefined ? null : new Date(Date.now() - effective * MIN).toISOString()}::timestamptz, 'cli')`);
  /** The clock's row, its times as minutes from now (negative in the past), rounded. */
  async function clock(tx: DbTx, orderId: string) {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
      select c.stopped, c.items_open, c.within_hour,
             round(extract(epoch from c.clock_start - now()) / 60)::int as start, round(extract(epoch from c.deadline_at - now()) / 60)::int as deadline,
             round(extract(epoch from c.target_at - now()) / 60)::int as target, round(extract(epoch from c.first_effect_at - now()) / 60)::int as first,
             round(extract(epoch from c.last_effect_at - now()) / 60)::int as last
        from public.legal_order_clock c where c.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
    return row;
  }

  test("the clock starts at the earlier of the receipt and the sending time; its deadline and target are hour_minutes and target_minutes on", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const received = await orderIn(tx, { received: 10 });
      expect(await clock(tx, received)).toMatchObject({ stopped: false, start: -10, deadline: ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - 10, target: ORDER_RULES.targetMinutes - 10, items_open: 0, within_hour: null });
      const sentEarlier = await orderIn(tx, { received: 10, sent: 25 });
      expect(await clock(tx, sentEarlier)).toMatchObject({ start: -25, deadline: ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - 25 });
      const none = await orderIn(tx, { received: null });
      expect(await clock(tx, none)).toMatchObject({ start: null, deadline: null, stopped: false });
      // A DSA order has no clock: the view lists removal orders alone.
      expect(await clock(tx, await orderIn(tx, { kind: "dsa_art9" }))).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  test("an Annex III stops the clock with no deadline; a clarification effective after it starts a fresh hour from its effective time, never the rest of the old one", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = await orderIn(tx, { received: 70 });
      // Received 70 minutes ago: overdue.
      expect((await clock(tx, order))!.deadline).toBe(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - 70);
      await eventIn(tx, order, "annex3_sent", 30, "insufficient_information");
      expect(await clock(tx, order)).toMatchObject({ stopped: true, deadline: null, target: null });
      await eventIn(tx, order, "clarification_received", 0, null, 5);
      expect(await clock(tx, order)).toMatchObject({ stopped: false, start: -5, deadline: ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - 5 });
      // A second Annex III stops it again; a cease after it restarts it from the cease.
      await eventIn(tx, order, "annex3_sent", -1, "force_majeure");
      expect((await clock(tx, order))!.stopped).toBe(true);
      await eventIn(tx, order, "grounds_ceased", -2, null);
      expect(await clock(tx, order)).toMatchObject({ stopped: false, start: 2, deadline: ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 2 });
    });
  });

  test("the hour is the order's: within_hour is null while an item is open, judges the last disabling once none is, and is true for a disabling given while the clock was stopped", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const partial = await orderIn(tx, { received: 30 });
      await itemIn(tx, partial, 1, { disabled: 20 });
      await itemIn(tx, partial, 2);
      expect(await clock(tx, partial)).toMatchObject({ items_open: 1, first: -20, last: -20, within_hour: null, deadline: ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - 30 });
      const inside = await orderIn(tx, { received: 30 });
      await itemIn(tx, inside, 1, { disabled: 20 });
      await itemIn(tx, inside, 2, { closed: 10 });
      expect(await clock(tx, inside)).toMatchObject({ items_open: 0, within_hour: true });
      const outside = await orderIn(tx, { received: 100 });
      await itemIn(tx, outside, 1, { disabled: 30 });
      expect(await clock(tx, outside)).toMatchObject({ items_open: 0, within_hour: false });
      // Stopped at minute 30 and given effect at minute 90 with no restart: not outside its hour.
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, { received: 90 });
      await eventIn(tx, stopped, "annex3_sent", 60, "force_majeure");
      await itemIn(tx, stopped, 1, { disabled: 1 });
      expect(await clock(tx, stopped)).toMatchObject({ items_open: 0, within_hour: true });
      // An item that names nothing is open until a person closes it.
      const unnamed = await orderIn(tx, { received: 5 });
      await itemIn(tx, unnamed, 1);
      expect(await clock(tx, unnamed)).toMatchObject({ items_open: 1, within_hour: null });
    });
  });

  /** An order opened as the API role, in the API's transaction, with its message when given. */
  const apiOrder = (tx: DbTx, kind: "tco_removal" | "dsa_art9" = "tco_removal") => orderForTest(tx, staff, { kind, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/x"] });
  /** order_event_record as the API role, by the account given; answers the refusal's code, or null. */
  async function record(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, kind: string, ground: string | null, messageId: string | null = null, by: TestStaff = staff): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      await tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.order_event_record(${orderId}::uuid, ${kind}, ${ground}, ${messageId}::uuid, ${by.id}::uuid)`));
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      return raised(err)?.message ?? String(err);
    }
  }

  test("order_event_record holds the rule the console shows: every Annex III has exactly one restart, by its ground", async () => {
    const message = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - MIN), "inbox");
    messages.push(message);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = (await apiOrder(tx)).id;
      // No restart while the clock runs; an Annex III needs a ground of its list.
      expect(await record(tx, order, "grounds_ceased", null)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "clarification_received", null, message)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", null)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", "withdrawn")).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error")).toBeNull();
      // Stopped: a second Annex III is refused, and so is the restart of the other ground.
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", "force_majeure")).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "grounds_ceased", null)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      // A clarification names its message.
      expect(await record(tx, order, "clarification_received", null)).toBe("order_needs_message");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "clarification_received", null, randomUUID())).toBe("order_needs_message");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "clarification_received", null, message)).toBeNull();
      // The message was not handled: it is now, as a clarification, by the acting account.
      const [handled] = await tx.execute<{ disposition: string; handled_by: string; stamped: boolean }>(
        sql`select disposition, handled_by, handled_at is not null as stamped from public.contact_messages where id = ${message}::uuid`,
      );
      expect(handled).toEqual({ disposition: "clarification", handled_by: staff.id, stamped: true });
      // Running again: Annex II waits for an effect; receipt_confirmed is a DSA order's.
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex2_sent", null)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "receipt_confirmed", null)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      // A force-majeure Annex III is ceased, with or without a message.
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", "force_majeure")).toBeNull();
      expect(await record(tx, order, "clarification_received", null, message)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "grounds_ceased", null)).toBeNull();
      const events = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; ground: string | null; via: string; by: string }>(
        sql`select kind, ground, via, by_staff as by from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order}::uuid order by at, id`,
      );
      expect(events.map((e) => [e.kind, e.ground, e.via])).toEqual([
        ["opened", null, "console"],
        ["annex3_sent", "manifest_error", "console"],
        ["clarification_received", null, "console"],
        ["annex3_sent", "force_majeure", "console"],
        ["grounds_ceased", null, "console"],
      ]);
      expect(new Set(events.map((e) => e.by))).toEqual(new Set([staff.id]));
    });
  });

  test("a restart takes the later of its message's time and the Annex III's, and nothing is refused for its time", async () => {
    // The clarification arrived before the Annex III was recorded: the clock restarts at the Annex III's time.
    const early = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 10 * MIN), "inbox");
    messages.push(early);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = (await apiOrder(tx)).id;
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", "insufficient_information")).toBeNull();
      const [annex] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select at::text from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order}::uuid and kind = 'annex3_sent'`);
      expect(await record(tx, order, "clarification_received", null, early)).toBeNull();
      const [restart] = await tx.execute<{ effective: string; same: boolean }>(sql`
        select effective_at::text as effective, effective_at = ${annex!.at}::timestamptz as same from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order}::uuid and kind = 'clarification_received'`);
      expect(restart!.same).toBe(true);
      const [view] = await tx.execute<{ stopped: boolean; same: boolean }>(
        sql`select stopped, clock_start = ${annex!.at}::timestamptz as same from public.legal_order_clock where order_id = ${order}::uuid`,
      );
      expect(view).toEqual({ stopped: false, same: true });
    });
  });

  test("closing, reopening and the extension are an admin's; a closed order takes no event but its reopening", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = (await apiOrder(tx)).id;
      expect(await record(tx, order, "closed_without_effect", "withdrawn")).toBe("admin_required");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "closed_without_effect", "force_majeure", null, admin)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "reopened", null, null, admin)).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "closed_without_effect", "not_addressed", null, admin)).toBeNull();
      expect(await record(tx, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error")).toBe("order_closed");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "reopened", null)).toBe("admin_required");
      expect(await record(tx, order, "reopened", null, null, admin)).toBeNull();
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ closed: boolean }>(sql`select closed_at is not null as closed from public.legal_orders where id = ${order}::uuid`);
      expect(row!.closed).toBe(false);
      // An extension: only with Section C (none here), only on a removal order, by an admin, with a message.
      expect(await record(tx, order, "hold_extended", null, null, admin)).toBe("order_needs_message");
      const dsa = (await apiOrder(tx, "dsa_art9")).id;
      expect(await record(tx, dsa, "receipt_confirmed", null)).toBeNull();
      expect(await record(tx, dsa, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error")).toBe("order_event_refused");
    });
  });

  test("an order is opened once; one without a message is accepted with the channel picked, and one from a message is mailbox whatever was sent", async () => {
    const message = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - MIN), "junk");
    messages.push(message);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const insert = (channel: string, messageId: string | null) =>
        tx.execute<{ id: string; channel: string; received: boolean; via: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'BKA', ${`O-${randomUUID()}`}, ${channel}, ${messageId}::uuid, false, false, false, false, ${staff.id}::uuid)
          returning id, channel, received_at is not null as received, opened_via as via`);
      for (const channel of ["mailbox", "portal", "post", "other"]) {
        const [row] = await insert(channel, null);
        expect([row!.channel, row!.received, row!.via], channel).toEqual([channel, false, "console"]);
      }
      const [fromMessage] = await insert("portal", message);
      expect([fromMessage!.channel, fromMessage!.received]).toEqual(["mailbox", true]);
      // The trigger reads no row of notify_state: the watcher's state never decides whether an order may be opened.
      const [definition] = await tx.execute<{ text: string }>(sql`select pg_get_functiondef('public.legal_orders_insert'::regproc) as text`);
      expect(definition!.text).not.toMatch(/notify_state/);
      // A second opening of one order is refused by the unique key.
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind) values (${fromMessage!.id}::uuid, 'opened')`);
      const second = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind) values (${fromMessage!.id}::uuid, 'opened')`))
        .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.code);
      expect(second).toBe("23505");
    });
  });

  test("a message stamped ahead of the database's clock is stored at the clock's time, and an order opened from it at once meets no check", async () => {
    const ahead = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() + 5 * MIN), "inbox", { uidvalidity: nextValidity() });
    messages.push(ahead);
    const [row] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ at_or_before: boolean }>(sql`select received_at <= clock_timestamp() as at_or_before from public.contact_messages where id = ${ahead}::uuid`);
    expect(row!.at_or_before).toBe(true);
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { messageId: ahead, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/ahead"] });
    orders.push(order.id);
    expect(order.channel).toBe("mailbox");
    expect(order.receivedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(Date.parse(order.receivedAt!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.parse(order.openedAt));
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
