```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { OrderCorrectFacts, OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { ModerationError, createBackground } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { correctOrderRecord } from "../../src/moderation/orders";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, moderationDeps, newTestStaff, raised, removeFixtures, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, outboxSince, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, removeOrderAlerts, disableItemForTest, orderConfig, orderConfirmation, orderForTest, removeOrders, sessionOf } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * Correcting what a person entered (3f design, section 2 rows 7 and 25, sections 6.2 and 7.4; invariants 25 before any
 * effect and 26's closings). Before any item is disabled any staff member corrects every member the form took (the rule
 * entry): the event corrected, the plain audit row order_corrected with the changed members, and the forced columns as at
 * the insert. Once an item is disabled, setting "must not be told" and nothing else is anyone's without a key (caution),
 * and everything else is an admin's under the step-up (admin), which "step_up_required" answers without one, keeping
 * nothing. A channel is corrected only on an order opened without a message. An item is closed with one of three reasons
 * while it is open. A correction onto another order's state, authority and reference is order_exists; a closed order
 * takes none. Every correction raises order_corrected. The disabling an effect will write (Task 3) is set here by the
 * migrator, on committed orders the last test removes.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: correcting an order's record", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    // Counted once the staff and the profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A correction through the module, by the account given, with the key's confirmation when asked; answers the outcome or the refusal's code. */
  async function correct(db: Db | DbTx, by: TestStaff, orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts, keyed = false): Promise<OrderView | string> {
    const background = createBackground(pino({ level: "silent" }));
    const deps = moderationDeps(db, { config: orderConfig(), background });
    try {
      const outcome = await correctOrderRecord(deps, sessionOf(by), orderId, facts, keyed ? orderConfirmation(by, "order_corrected", orderId, { facts }) : null, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
      await background.settle();
      return outcome;
    } catch (err) {
      return err instanceof ModerationError ? err.code : `${String(err)} ${String((err as { cause?: unknown }).cause)}`;
    }
  }
  const view = (outcome: OrderView | string): OrderView => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`refused: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome;
  };
  const lastAudit = async (db: Db | DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    (await db.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; step_up: unknown; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, step_up, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${orderId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    ))[0]!;

  test("before any effect, any staff member corrects every member the form took, without a key: the event corrected under entry, the plain audit row with what changed, the forced columns, and the alert", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", channel: "portal", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c1"], withholdFromAuthor: false, memberState: "DE" });
      const corrected = view(
        await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { kind: "tco_removal", memberState: "FR", authority: "Office central", reference: "FR-2026-9", channel: "post", emergency: true }),
      );
      expect([corrected.kind, corrected.memberState, corrected.crossBorder, corrected.authority, corrected.reference, corrected.channel, corrected.emergency]).toEqual([
        "tco_removal",
        "FR",
        true,
        "Office central",
        "FR-2026-9",
        "post",
        true,
      ]);
      // A removal order withholds and preserves, by force.
      expect([corrected.withholdFromAuthor, corrected.preserve]).toEqual([true, true]);
      expect(corrected.events.map((e) => [e.kind, e.ground, e.via])).toEqual([
        ["opened", null, "console"],
        ["corrected", "entry", "console"],
      ]);
      const audit = await lastAudit(tx, order.id);
      expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.step_up]).toEqual(["order_corrected", moderator.id, null]);
      expect(audit.metadata.rule).toBe("entry");
      expect(audit.metadata.eventId).toBe(corrected.events[1]!.id);
      // The members the request changed, and crossBorder, which the API sets with memberState; what the database forces
      // follows them and is no member of the request.
      expect((audit.metadata.changed as { member: string }[]).map((c) => c.member).sort()).toEqual(["authority", "channel", "crossBorder", "emergency", "kind", "memberState", "reference"]);
      expect(audit.metadata.changed).toContainEqual({ member: "kind", from: "dsa_art9", to: "tco_removal" });
      const alerts = await outboxSince(tx, "order_corrected", since);
      expect(alerts.map((a) => [a.priority, a.scope, a.facts.count])).toEqual([[3, "all", 7]]);
      // Section C set forces the withholding.
      const dsa = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c2"], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      expect(view(await correct(tx, moderator, dsa.id, { sectionC: true })).withholdFromAuthor).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  test("a channel is corrected only on an order opened without a message; a member outside the list is refused", async () => {
    const m = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 60_000), "inbox");
    messages.push(m);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const fromMessage = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { messageId: m, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c3"] });
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, fromMessage.id, { channel: "portal" })).toBe("invalid_request");
      const below = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.order_correct(${fromMessage.id}::uuid, '{"openedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}'::jsonb, ${moderator.id}::uuid)`))
        .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message);
      expect(below).toBe("invalid_request");
    });
  });

  test("an item is closed with one of three reasons while it is open; another word, a closed item and another order's item are refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/i1", "https://elsewhere.example/i2", "https://elsewhere.example/i3", "https://elsewhere.example/i4"] });
      const other = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/o1"] });
      const [a, b, c, d] = order.items.map((i) => i.id);
      const closed = view(
        await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, {
          closeItems: [
            { itemId: a!, reason: "no_post" },
            { itemId: b!, reason: "not_named" },
            { itemId: c!, reason: "withdrawn" },
          ],
        }),
      );
      expect(closed.items.map((i) => i.closedReason)).toEqual(["no_post", "not_named", "withdrawn", null]);
      expect(closed.clock!.itemsOpen).toBe(1);
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { closeItems: [{ itemId: a!, reason: "no_post" }] })).toBe("invalid_request");
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { closeItems: [{ itemId: other.items[0]!.id, reason: "no_post" }] })).toBe("invalid_request");
      const word = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.order_correct(${order.id}::uuid, ${JSON.stringify({ closeItems: [{ itemId: d, reason: "wrong_item" }] })}::jsonb, ${moderator.id}::uuid)`))
        .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message);
      expect(word).toBe("invalid_request");
    });
  });

  test("onto another order's state, authority and reference: order_exists with the order that stands; a closed order takes no correction", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const first = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { reference: "SAME-1", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/s1"] });
      const second = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { reference: "SAME-2", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/s2"] });
      const background = createBackground(pino({ level: "silent" }));
      const refused = await correctOrderRecord(moderationDeps(tx, { config: orderConfig(), background }), sessionOf(moderator), second.id, { reference: "SAME-1" }, null, { requestId: "r" }).then(
        () => null,
        (err: unknown) => (err instanceof ModerationError ? { code: err.code, details: err.details } : String(err)),
      );
      expect(refused).toEqual({ code: "order_exists", details: { orderId: first.id } });
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.order_event_record(${second.id}::uuid, 'closed_without_effect', 'withdrawn', null, ${admin.id}::uuid)`);
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, second.id, { emergency: true })).toBe("order_closed");
    });
  });

  test("once an item is disabled: Section C set alone is caution, anyone's without a key; anything else is admin: refused to a moderator, step_up_required without the key, and confirmed with it", async () => {
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/e1", "https://elsewhere.example/e2"], withholdFromAuthor: false });
    orders.push(order.id);
    await disableItemForTest(w.migrateDb, order.items[0]!.id);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const caution = view(await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { sectionC: true }));
      expect(caution.events.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: "corrected", ground: "caution" });
      expect([caution.sectionC, caution.withholdFromAuthor, caution.mayCorrect]).toEqual([true, true, "caution"]);
      expect((await lastAudit(tx, order.id)).step_up).toBeNull();
    });
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { emergency: true })).toBe("admin_required");
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { sectionC: true, emergency: true })).toBe("admin_required");
      expect(await correct(tx, moderator, order.id, { closeItems: [{ itemId: order.items[1]!.id, reason: "no_post" }] })).toBe("admin_required");
      // A disabled item is never closed: a wrong one is reinstated (Task 3).
      expect(await correct(tx, admin, order.id, { closeItems: [{ itemId: order.items[0]!.id, reason: "not_named" }] }, true)).toBe("invalid_request");
      // Without the key the admin's correction keeps nothing.
      expect(await correct(tx, admin, order.id, { emergency: true })).toBe("step_up_required");
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ emergency: boolean; events: number }>(
        sql`select o.emergency, (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id) as events from public.legal_orders o where o.id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      expect(row).toEqual({ emergency: false, events: 1 });
      const confirmed = view(await correct(tx, admin, order.id, { emergency: true, kind: "tco_removal" }, true));
      expect(confirmed.events.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: "corrected", ground: "admin" });
      expect([confirmed.emergency, confirmed.kind, confirmed.preserve, confirmed.withholdFromAuthor]).toEqual([true, "tco_removal", true, true]);
      const audit = await lastAudit(tx, order.id);
      expect(audit.step_up).not.toBeNull();
      expect(audit.metadata).toMatchObject({ rule: "admin", params: { facts: { emergency: true, kind: "tco_removal" } } });
    });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-fixtures.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { OrderChannel, OrderKind, OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../../src/auth";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import pino from "pino";
import { createBackground } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { openOrder } from "../../src/moderation/orders";
import { hex64, moderationDeps, uuids, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * Fixtures of order records (3f design, section 12): `orderForTest` opens an order through the route's own code, from a
 * message or without one, and `ageOrderForTest` moves an order's times back, as the migrator: every time is forced by a
 * trigger, and no setting shortens a number of order_rules(), so it is the only way a test meets a deadline, a reminder
 * or a hold's end. The integration files that write orders add ORDER_TABLES to their row counts.
 */

/** The three tables of order records, which a suite that writes them adds to its row counts. */
export const ORDER_TABLES = ["legal_orders", "legal_order_items", "legal_order_events"] as const;

/** The configuration the order flows read: the test environment's, with Germany as the home state. */
export function orderConfig(overrides: Partial<Config> = {}): Config {
  return { ...loadConfig(), HOME_STATE: "DE", ...overrides };
}

/** A staff session as the staff routes hand one to the moderation module, for a test staff account. */
export function sessionOf(staff: TestStaff): ActiveStaffSession {
  const now = new Date();
  return {
    sessionId: hex64(),
    handle: randomUUID(),
    userId: staff.id,
    keyId: staff.keyId,
    role: staff.role,
    createdAt: now,
    lastUsedAt: now,
    idleExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * 60_000),
    absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 12 * 60 * 60_000),
    browser: "Firefox on Linux",
  };
}

/**
 * A made-up confirmation of an order's action, as requireStaffStepUp hands it on: the hash and the assertion are
 * placeholders, so the audit row it leads to is only ever written in a transaction a test rolls back.
 */
export function orderConfirmation(staff: TestStaff, action: "order_event_recorded" | "order_corrected", orderId: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): StaffStepUpConfirmed {
  return {
    action,
    target: { type: "order", id: orderId },
    params,
    actionHash: hex64(),
    keyId: staff.keyId,
    assertion: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
  } as StaffStepUpConfirmed;
}

/** What an order opened for a test names; every member has a default. */
export interface OrderForTest {
  kind?: OrderKind;
  sectionC?: boolean;
  /** The posts its links name, by their pages on the app's origin. */
  posts?: readonly string[];
  /** Other links, as named. */
  links?: readonly string[];
  /** The message it came in, or null for "The message is not listed". */
  messageId?: string | null;
  channel?: OrderChannel;
  memberState?: "DE" | "FR" | "AT";
  authority?: string;
  reference?: string;
  withholdFromAuthor?: boolean;
  emergency?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Opens an order through the route's own code (openOrder), as the staff account, on the pool or the transaction given: on
 * a pool it commits, and the test removes it (removeOrders); on a transaction that the test rolls back nothing stays.
 * What follows the commit (the alert order_opened's row and its mail, which no address takes here) is awaited, so its row
 * is written before the answer and on the transaction while it is open.
 */
export async function orderForTest(db: Db | DbTx, staff: TestStaff, options: OrderForTest = {}): Promise<OrderView> {
  const config = orderConfig();
  const background = createBackground(pino({ level: "silent" }));
  const kind = options.kind ?? "tco_removal";
  const sectionC = options.sectionC ?? false;
  const links = [...(options.posts ?? []).map((id) => `${config.APP_ORIGIN}/post/${id}`), ...(options.links ?? [])];
  const messageId = options.messageId === undefined ? null : options.messageId;
  const view = await openOrder(
    moderationDeps(db, { config, background }),
    sessionOf(staff),
    {
      messageId,
      channel: options.channel ?? (messageId === null ? "portal" : "mailbox"),
      kind,
      memberState: options.memberState ?? "DE",
      authority: options.authority ?? "Bundeskriminalamt",
      reference: options.reference ?? `T-${randomUUID()}`,
      links,
      sectionC,
      emergency: options.emergency ?? false,
      withholdFromAuthor: options.withholdFromAuthor ?? (kind === "tco_removal" || sectionC),
    },
    { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` },
  );
  await background.settle();
  return view;
}

/**
 * Moves an order's times back by whole minutes, as the migrator: the order's own times, its items', its events', its
 * decisions', its message's and the outbox rows that name either. A test that ages committed rows runs it on the
 * migrator's pool; one inside a migrator's transaction that it rolls back, on that transaction.
 */
export async function ageOrderForTest(migrate: Db | DbTx, orderId: string, minutes: number): Promise<void> {
  const by = sql`make_interval(mins => ${minutes})`;
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = received_at - ${by}, sent_at = sent_at - ${by}, issued_at = issued_at - ${by},
                                  due_at = due_at - ${by}, authority_hold_until = authority_hold_until - ${by}, hold_ended_at = hold_ended_at - ${by},
                                  tell_person_at = tell_person_at - ${by}, opened_at = opened_at - ${by}, verified_at = verified_at - ${by},
                                  closed_at = closed_at - ${by}, imported_at = imported_at - ${by}
                             where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set added_at = added_at - ${by}, disabled_at = disabled_at - ${by}, preserve_until = preserve_until - ${by},
                                  preserve_ended_at = preserve_ended_at - ${by}, reinstated_at = reinstated_at - ${by}, closed_at = closed_at - ${by}
                             where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_events set at = at - ${by}, effective_at = effective_at - ${by} where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.decisions set decided_at = decided_at - ${by}, informed_at = informed_at - ${by}
                             where order_item_id in (select id from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid)`);
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages m set received_at = m.received_at - ${by}, seen_at = m.seen_at - ${by}, handled_at = m.handled_at - ${by}
                             from public.legal_orders o where o.id = ${orderId}::uuid and m.id = o.message_id`);
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - ${by}
                             where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid or message_id = (select message_id from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid)`);
}

/** Removes orders with their events, items and outbox rows, and the messages they came in with theirs, as the migrator. */
export async function removeOrders(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, orderIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (orderIds.length === 0) return;
  const ids = uuids(orderIds);
  const messages = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select message_id as id from public.legal_orders where id = any(${ids}) and message_id is not null`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where order_id = any(${ids})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.legal_order_events where order_id = any(${ids})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.legal_order_items where order_id = any(${ids})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.legal_orders where id = any(${ids})`);
  const messageIds = uuids(messages.map((row) => row.id));
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where message_id = any(${messageIds})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.contact_messages m where m.id = any(${messageIds}) and not exists (select 1 from public.legal_orders o where o.message_id = m.id)`);
}

/**
 * Removes the rows of the alerts an order's flows raised since a time, which name no subject (order_opened and
 * order_corrected, written by staffAlert after the commit), as the migrator: the files run one after another, so the rows
 * of a kind written since the file began are its own.
 */
export async function removeOrderAlerts(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, since: Date): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('order_opened', 'order_corrected') and order_id is null and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz`);
}

/** Marks an item disabled at a time, as the migrator: before the ledger's functions of Task 3 nothing else gives an order effect. */
export async function disableItemForTest(migrate: Db | DbTx, itemId: string, at: Date = new Date()): Promise<void> {
  await migrate.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set disabled_at = ${at.toISOString()}::timestamptz where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-grants.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_CHANNELS, ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS, ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES, ORDER_EVENT_GROUNDS, ORDER_EVENT_KINDS, ORDER_EVENT_VIA, ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS, ORDER_KINDS, HOLD_END_REASONS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { appendConfirmedAudit } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../../src/staff";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, hex64, newTestStaff, raised, removeFixtures, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, removeOrderAlerts, disableItemForTest, orderForTest, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * The grants and the binding of a console's event to its audit row (3f design, sections 6.2 and 6.7; invariants 12 and
 * 24, events and a correction before effect). As korbat_api: SELECT and the console's columns on an order, never an
 * update; an item's link, and its intake item alone afterwards; an event's insert, of which the trigger takes `opened`
 * alone; no update of a decision's informed_at. Each call that a key must cover (order_event_record for a closing, an
 * Annex III, a reopening and an extension; order_correct under each of its three rules), committed without the matching
 * audit row as the transaction's head, with another order's row, without a step-up where one is needed, or under another
 * account, is refused at commit (order_event_refused), leaving nothing; with its row it stands, and by_staff is the row's
 * actor. Each closed list's CHECK is its contracts' constant.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the grants of order records and the binding of their console events", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    // Counted once the staff profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  const privileges = async (table: string) =>
    (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ p: string }>(sql`
      select p from unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER']) p
       where has_table_privilege('korbat_api', ${`public.${table}`}, p) order by p`)).map((r) => r.p);
  const columns = async (table: string, privilege: string) =>
    (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ column_name: string }>(sql`
      select column_name from information_schema.columns
       where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = ${table} and has_column_privilege('korbat_api', ${`public.${table}`}, column_name, ${privilege})
       order by ordinal_position`)).map((r) => r.column_name);
  const checkValues = async (table: string, name: string) =>
    [...((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ d: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) as d from pg_constraint where conname = ${name} and conrelid = ${`public.${table}`}::regclass`))[0]!.d.matchAll(/'([a-z_0-9]+)'/g))].map((m) => m[1]!);

  test("korbat_api: an order is read and inserted with the console's columns, never updated; an item's link, then its intake item alone; an event inserted; a decision's informed_at never", async () => {
    // A table's privilege counts only a grant on the whole table: the order's and the item's inserts are by column.
    expect(await privileges("legal_orders")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await columns("legal_orders", "INSERT")).toEqual(["id", "kind", "member_state", "authority", "reference", "channel", "message_id", "section_c", "emergency", "cross_border", "withhold_from_author", "opened_by"]);
    expect(await columns("legal_orders", "UPDATE")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await privileges("legal_order_items")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await columns("legal_order_items", "INSERT")).toEqual(["id", "order_id", "position", "link", "post_id"]);
    expect(await columns("legal_order_items", "UPDATE")).toEqual(["intake_item_id"]);
    expect(await privileges("legal_order_events")).toEqual(["INSERT", "SELECT"]);
    expect(await columns("legal_order_events", "UPDATE")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await privileges("legal_order_clock")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await columns("decisions", "UPDATE")).toEqual(["author_mail", "author_mail_at"]);
    expect(await columns("decision_actions", "UPDATE")).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("korbat_api: an event other than opened is refused by the trigger, a command line's as order_event_cli_only; an update of an order or of informed_at is refused by the grants", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/g1"] });
      const tried = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) =>
        tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(statement)).then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => {
            const found = raised(err);
            return found?.code === "P0001" ? found.message : found?.code;
          },
        );
      for (const kind of ["verified", "received_set", "texts_recorded", "reopened", "hold_extended", "imported"]) {
        expect(await tried(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, via) values (${order.id}::uuid, ${kind}, 'cli')`), kind).toBe("order_event_cli_only");
      }
      for (const kind of ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect", "corrected", "effect_given", "notice_released"]) {
        expect(await tried(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, via) values (${order.id}::uuid, ${kind}, null, 'console')`), kind).toBe("order_event_refused");
      }
      expect(await tried(sql`update public.legal_orders set section_c = true where id = ${order.id}::uuid`)).toBe("42501");
      expect(await tried(sql`update public.legal_orders set verified_at = now() where id = ${order.id}::uuid`)).toBe("42501");
      expect(await tried(sql`update public.legal_order_items set disabled_at = now() where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`)).toBe("42501");
      expect(await tried(sql`update public.decisions set informed_at = null where false`)).toBe("42501");
      expect(await tried(sql`insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by, verified_at)
                             values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'B', ${`V-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true, ${moderator.id}::uuid, now())`)).toBe("42501");
    });
  });

  /** Runs `write` in a savepoint, then the deferred check of a console's event at once: null when it stood, else the refusal. */
  async function atCommit(tx: DbTx, write: (sp: DbTx) => Promise<void>): Promise<string | null> {
    const outcome = await tx
      .transaction(async (sp) => {
        await write(sp);
        await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.legal_order_events_confirmed immediate`);
      })
      .then(
        () => null,
        (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? String(err),
      );
    await tx.execute(sql`set constraints public.legal_order_events_confirmed deferred`);
    return outcome;
  }
  const record = async (sp: DbTx, orderId: string, kind: string, ground: string | null, messageId: string | null, by: TestStaff) =>
    (await sp.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select public.order_event_record(${orderId}::uuid, ${kind}, ${ground}, ${messageId}::uuid, ${by.id}::uuid) as id`))[0]!.id;
  const correct = async (sp: DbTx, orderId: string, facts: Record<string, unknown>, by: TestStaff) =>
    (await sp.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select public.order_correct(${orderId}::uuid, ${JSON.stringify(facts)}::jsonb, ${by.id}::uuid) as id`))[0]!.id;
  const confirmedRow = (sp: DbTx, by: TestStaff, action: "order_event_recorded" | "order_corrected", orderId: string, eventId: string) =>
    appendConfirmedAudit(sp, {
      actorId: by.id,
      keyId: by.keyId,
      action,
      targetType: "order",
      targetId: orderId,
      metadata: { params: {}, eventId },
      staffSession: randomUUID(),
      actionHash: hex64(),
      stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
      requestId: "req-grants",
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
    });
  const plainRow = (sp: DbTx, by: TestStaff, action: string, orderId: string, eventId: string) =>
    appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: by.id, action, targetType: "order", targetId: orderId, requestId: "req-grants", metadata: { eventId } });

  test("each clock event, closing, reopening and extension stands only with its confirmed audit row, on this order, naming this event, by its account", async () => {
    const m = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 60_000), "inbox");
    messages.push(m);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = (await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { sectionC: true, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/b1"] })).id;
      const other = (await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/b2"] })).id;
      // Without a row; with another order's; with a plain row; under another account: each refused at commit.
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => record(sp, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error", null, moderator).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, moderator, "order_event_recorded", other, await record(sp, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error", null, moderator))))).toBe(
        "order_event_refused",
      );
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await plainRow(sp, moderator, "order_event_recorded", order, await record(sp, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error", null, moderator))))).toBe(
        "order_event_refused",
      );
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, admin, "order_event_recorded", order, await record(sp, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error", null, moderator))))).toBe(
        "order_event_refused",
      );
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, moderator, "order_corrected", order, await record(sp, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error", null, moderator))))).toBe(
        "order_event_refused",
      );
      // With it: stored, by the row's actor.
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, moderator, "order_event_recorded", order, await record(sp, order, "annex3_sent", "manifest_error", null, moderator))))).toBeNull();
      // The admin's three: an extension, a closing and a reopening, each refused without its row and standing with it.
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => record(sp, order, "hold_extended", null, m, admin).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, admin, "order_event_recorded", order, await record(sp, order, "hold_extended", null, m, admin))))).toBeNull();
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => record(sp, other, "closed_without_effect", "withdrawn", null, admin).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, admin, "order_event_recorded", other, await record(sp, other, "closed_without_effect", "withdrawn", null, admin))))).toBeNull();
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => record(sp, other, "reopened", null, null, admin).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, admin, "order_event_recorded", other, await record(sp, other, "reopened", null, null, admin))))).toBeNull();
      const events = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; by: string }>(
        sql`select kind, by_staff as by from public.legal_order_events where order_id in (${order}::uuid, ${other}::uuid) and kind <> 'opened' order by at, id`,
      );
      expect(events.map((e) => [e.kind, e.by])).toEqual([
        ["annex3_sent", moderator.id],
        ["hold_extended", admin.id],
        ["closed_without_effect", admin.id],
        ["reopened", admin.id],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a correction stands only with its audit row order_corrected: a plain one under entry and caution, a confirmed one under admin", async () => {
    const effected = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c1"] });
    orders.push(effected.id);
    await disableItemForTest(w.migrateDb, effected.items[0]!.id);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = (await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c2"] })).id;
      // entry: without a row refused, with a plain row by the acting account standing.
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => correct(sp, order, { emergency: true }, moderator).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await plainRow(sp, admin, "order_corrected", order, await correct(sp, order, { emergency: true }, moderator))))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await plainRow(sp, moderator, "order_corrected", order, await correct(sp, order, { emergency: true }, moderator))))).toBeNull();
      // caution: the same, on an order given effect.
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => correct(sp, effected.id, { sectionC: true }, moderator).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await plainRow(sp, moderator, "order_corrected", effected.id, await correct(sp, effected.id, { sectionC: true }, moderator))))).toBeNull();
      // admin: a plain row in place of a confirmed one is refused; the confirmed one stands.
      expect(await atCommit(tx, (sp) => correct(sp, effected.id, { emergency: true }, admin).then(() => undefined))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await plainRow(sp, admin, "order_corrected", effected.id, await correct(sp, effected.id, { emergency: true }, admin))))).toBe("order_event_refused");
      expect(await atCommit(tx, async (sp) => void (await confirmedRow(sp, admin, "order_corrected", effected.id, await correct(sp, effected.id, { emergency: true }, admin))))).toBeNull();
      const grounds = await tx.execute<{ ground: string }>(sql`select ground from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${effected.id}::uuid and kind = 'corrected' order by at, id`);
      expect(grounds.map((g) => g.ground)).toEqual(["caution", "admin"]);
    });
  });

  test("each closed list's CHECK is its contracts' constant, in one spelling", async () => {
    expect(await checkValues("legal_orders", "legal_orders_kind")).toEqual([...ORDER_KINDS]);
    expect(await checkValues("legal_orders", "legal_orders_channel")).toEqual([...ORDER_CHANNELS]);
    expect(await checkValues("legal_orders", "legal_orders_hold_end")).toEqual([...HOLD_END_REASONS]);
    expect(await checkValues("legal_order_items", "legal_order_items_closed")).toEqual([...ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS]);
    expect((await checkValues("legal_order_events", "legal_order_events_kind")).sort()).toEqual([...ORDER_EVENT_KINDS].sort());
    expect(await checkValues("legal_order_events", "legal_order_events_via")).toEqual([...ORDER_EVENT_VIA]);
    const ground = (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ d: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) as d from pg_constraint where conname = 'legal_order_events_ground'`))[0]!.d;
    for (const [kind, grounds] of Object.entries(ORDER_EVENT_GROUNDS)) {
      for (const value of grounds) expect(ground, `${kind} ${value}`).toContain(`'${value}'`);
    }
    expect(await checkValues("decision_actions", "decision_actions_order_ground")).toEqual([...ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS].filter((g) => g !== "not_addressed"));
    expect(ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES.every((rule) => ground.includes(`'${rule}'`))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-hold-end.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * The end of a non-disclosure period (3f design, section 2 rows 24 and 46, section 6.2; invariant 4, the function; LAB E
 * on the real code). order_hold_end: the calendar date of the instant in UTC+3, plus hold_days (and hold_extension_days
 * once extended), at 00:00 in UTC-1; never earlier, in any of the eight zones of the lab, than the end of the same weekday
 * six weeks later (Reg. 1182/71 Art. 3), and at most 28 hours later; the same value in any session time zone; an
 * extension adds exactly 42 days. order_hold_until: null without Section C; a removal order's computed end, from its time
 * stamp, else its receipt, else its opening, or the authority's end when earlier; a DSA order's recorded end of any
 * length, and 'infinity' while none is recorded; a hold's recorded end once ended. order_preserve_until: six calendar
 * months in UTC and a day. Every order here is the migrator's, in a transaction that is rolled back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: an order's hold and preservation, the functions alone", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, ORDER_TABLES);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const ZONES = ["Atlantic/Azores", "Europe/Lisbon", "Europe/Dublin", "Europe/Berlin", "Europe/Paris", "Europe/Helsinki", "Europe/Athens", "Asia/Nicosia"];

  test("never early in eight zones of the EU's European territory, and at most 28 hours late: random instants of 2026 to 2030 and every minute around four clock changes and 43 days before them", async () => {
    const zones = sql.raw(`values ${ZONES.map((zone) => `('${zone}')`).join(", ")}`);
    const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ z: string; instants: number; early: number; least_late_h: number; most_late_h: number }>(sql`
      with zones(z) as (${zones}),
      t as (select timestamptz '2026-01-01 00:00+00' + random() * make_interval(days => 1826) as at from generate_series(1, 20000)
            union all select d + make_interval(mins => h) from unnest(array[timestamptz '2026-03-29 00:00+00', '2026-10-25 00:00+00', '2027-03-28 00:00+00', '2027-10-31 00:00+00']) d,
                      generate_series(-180, 1620, 1) h
            union all select (d - 43)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC' + make_interval(mins => h) from unnest(array[date '2026-03-29', '2026-10-25', '2027-03-28', '2027-10-31']) d,
                      generate_series(-180, 1620, 1) h)
      select z, count(*)::int as instants,
             (count(*) filter (where public.order_hold_end(at, false) < (((at at time zone z)::date + 43)::timestamp at time zone z)))::int as early,
             min(extract(epoch from public.order_hold_end(at, false) - (((at at time zone z)::date + 43)::timestamp at time zone z)) / 3600)::float as least_late_h,
             max(extract(epoch from public.order_hold_end(at, false) - (((at at time zone z)::date + 43)::timestamp at time zone z)) / 3600)::float as most_late_h
        from t cross join zones group by z order by z`);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.z).sort()).toEqual([...ZONES].sort());
    for (const row of rows) {
      expect(row.early, row.z).toBe(0);
      expect(row.least_late_h, row.z).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      expect(row.most_late_h, row.z).toBeLessThanOrEqual(28);
    }
  });

  test("the same value in three session time zones, and an extension adds exactly hold_extension_days", async () => {
    const values: string[] = [];
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      for (const zone of ["UTC", "Europe/Berlin", "America/New_York"]) {
        await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('timezone', ${zone}, true)`);
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ end: string }>(sql`select to_char(public.order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as end`);
        values.push(row!.end);
      }
    });
    // The lab's worked instant: the date in UTC+3 is 7 October, plus 43 days is 19 November, at 00:00 in UTC-1.
    expect(values).toEqual(["2026-11-19 01:00", "2026-11-19 01:00", "2026-11-19 01:00"]);
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ least: number; most: number }>(sql`
      select min(extract(epoch from public.order_hold_end(at, true) - public.order_hold_end(at, false)))::float as least,
             max(extract(epoch from public.order_hold_end(at, true) - public.order_hold_end(at, false)))::float as most
        from (select timestamptz '2026-01-01 00:00+00' + random() * make_interval(days => 1826) as at from generate_series(1, 2000)) t`);
    expect([row!.least, row!.most]).toEqual([ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays * 86_400, ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays * 86_400]);
  });

  /** An order of the migrator's, in the transaction: its kind, Section C and the times the test names. */
  async function order(tx: DbTx, kind: string, sectionC: boolean, times: Record<string, string | boolean | null> = {}): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author,
                                       received_at, issued_at, authority_hold_until, hold_extended, hold_ended_at, hold_end_reason, opened_at, opened_via)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${kind}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`H-${Math.random()}`}, 'portal', ${sectionC}::boolean, false, false, ${sectionC}::boolean,
              ${(times.received as string) ?? null}::timestamptz, ${(times.issued as string) ?? null}::timestamptz, ${(times.authority as string) ?? null}::timestamptz,
              ${(times.extended as boolean) ?? false}::boolean, ${(times.ended as string) ?? null}::timestamptz, ${times.ended ? "not_ordered" : null},
              ${(times.opened as string) ?? "2026-10-06T22:00:00Z"}::timestamptz, 'cli')
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  }
  const until = async (tx: DbTx, id: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ until: string | null }>(sql`select case when public.order_hold_until(${id}::uuid) = 'infinity' then 'infinity' else to_char(public.order_hold_until(${id}::uuid) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') end as until`))[0]!.until;

  test("order_hold_until: by the kind of order, from the time stamp, else the receipt, else the opening; the authority's end when earlier; a DSA order's end of any length or none; the recorded end once ended", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // Without Section C nothing is held.
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", false, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z" }))).toBeNull();
      // A removal order: from its receipt, never earlier; from its own time stamp once recorded; extended once.
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z" }))).toBe("2026-11-19 01:00");
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", issued: "2026-10-05T10:00:00Z" }))).toBe("2026-11-17 01:00");
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", true, { opened: "2026-10-06T22:00:00Z" }))).toBe("2026-11-19 01:00");
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", extended: true }))).toBe("2026-12-31 01:00");
      // The authority's written end counts when it is earlier, never when it is later: the Regulation's period caps it.
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", authority: "2026-10-20T00:00:00Z" }))).toBe("2026-10-20 00:00");
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "tco_removal", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", authority: "2027-03-01T00:00:00Z" }))).toBe("2026-11-19 01:00");
      // A DSA order: the authority's end, earlier or later than six weeks, and no end while none is recorded; the extension is not its.
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "dsa_art9", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z" }))).toBe("infinity");
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "dsa_art9", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", authority: "2027-03-01T00:00:00Z" }))).toBe("2027-03-01 00:00");
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "dsa_art10", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", authority: "2026-10-10T00:00:00Z", extended: true }))).toBe("2026-10-10 00:00");
      // A hold ended from the command line ends at that time, whatever the kind.
      expect(await until(tx, await order(tx, "dsa_art9", true, { received: "2026-10-06T21:30:00Z", ended: "2026-10-08T12:00:00Z" }))).toBe("2026-10-08 12:00");
    });
  });

  test("order_preserve_until: six calendar months in UTC and a day, as appeal_deadline counts months", async () => {
    const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ a: string; b: string }>(sql`
      select to_char(public.order_preserve_until('2026-10-06T21:30:00Z') at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as a,
             to_char(public.order_preserve_until('2026-08-31T10:00:00Z') at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as b`);
    expect(rows[0]).toEqual({ a: "2027-04-07 21:30", b: "2027-03-01 10:00" });
  });

  test("the functions hold no number of order_rules() and no interval literal; the API role may call each", async () => {
    const functions = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string; api: boolean }>(sql`
      select p.proname::text as name, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') as api
        from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('order_hold_end', 'order_hold_until', 'order_preserve_until') order by 1`);
    expect(functions.map((f) => [f.name, f.api])).toEqual([
      ["order_hold_end", true],
      ["order_hold_until", true],
      ["order_preserve_until", true],
    ]);
    for (const f of functions) {
      expect(f.definition, f.name).not.toMatch(/interval '/i);
      expect(f.definition, f.name).not.toMatch(/[^0-9_a-z](42|43|6) /);
    }
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, ORDER_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-records.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_ITEMS_MAX, ORDER_RULES, OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createBackground, ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { addItems, contactOverview, contactPage } from "../../src/moderation/orders";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, moderationDeps, newImageRow, newPostRow, newTestStaff, removeFixtures, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, outboxSince, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, orderConfig, orderForTest, removeOrderAlerts, removeOrders, sessionOf } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;

/**
 * Opening an order record (3f design, sections 2 rows 7, 8 and 43, 6.2 and 7.4; invariants 10, 12 and 26). The route's
 * own code opens an order with or without a message: the trigger forces when and how it was opened, its time of receipt
 * from the message, the withholding of a removal order and of an order whose author must not be told, and the
 * preservation; it nulls every column of the command line. Each link becomes an item, resolved and never fetched: a post's
 * page, an image's address (its post), a profile's page and another site (no post). The message's disposition becomes
 * order. The audit row order_opened names an item by its post or by its link's digest and length, never the link. The
 * day's limit is counted by the API and by the trigger. An order of the same state, authority and reference is
 * order_exists, with the order that stands. More links come up to ORDER_ITEMS_MAX, and an item added after the
 * verification is unverified. The contact point's page names the orders opened from a message, and the home screen's
 * deadline is an order's too. Every staff account is alerted that an order was opened.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: opening an order record", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staff: TestStaff;
  let author: { id: string };
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    staff = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, staff);
    author = await newProfile(w.apiDb);
    // Counted once the staff and the profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [staff.id, author.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  // Read on first use: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
  let loaded: ReturnType<typeof orderConfig> | undefined;
  const configOf = () => (loaded ??= orderConfig());
  const message = async (minutesAgo = 1) => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - minutesAgo * MIN), "inbox");
    messages.push(id);
    return id;
  };
  const rowOf = async (tx: DbTx, id: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.legal_orders where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;

  test("from a message: the receipt is the message's, the channel mailbox, the withholding and the preservation forced; the command line's columns null; the message handled as an order", async () => {
    const m = await message(3);
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const post = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
      const view = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { messageId: m, posts: [post], sectionC: false, withholdFromAuthor: true });
      expect(OrderView.parse(view)).toEqual(view);
      const row = await rowOf(tx, view.id);
      const [msg] = await tx.execute<{ received_at: Date; disposition: string; handled_by: string; stamped: boolean }>(
        sql`select received_at, disposition, handled_by, handled_at is not null as stamped from public.contact_messages where id = ${m}::uuid`,
      );
      // A row read with select * may hold its times as text: each is compared as an instant.
      expect(new Date(row.received_at as string | Date).getTime()).toBe(new Date(msg!.received_at).getTime());
      expect([row.channel, row.opened_via, row.withhold_from_author, row.preserve, row.opened_by]).toEqual(["mailbox", "console", true, true, staff.id]);
      for (const column of ["sent_at", "issued_at", "due_at", "authority_hold_until", "hold_basis", "verified_at", "reasons", "redress", "scope", "document_sha256", "closed_at", "imported_at"]) {
        expect(row[column], column).toBeNull();
      }
      expect([msg!.disposition, msg!.handled_by, msg!.stamped]).toEqual(["order", staff.id, true]);
      expect(view.items.map((i) => [i.position, i.linkKind, i.postId, i.unverified])).toEqual([[1, "post", post, true]]);
      expect(view.events.map((e) => [e.kind, e.via])).toEqual([["opened", "console"]]);
      expect(view.state).toBe("running");
      expect(view.clock!.deadlineAt).toBe(new Date(Date.parse(view.receivedAt!) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * MIN).toISOString());
    });
  });

  test("without a message: no receipt and no deadline (unknown_deadline), the channel as picked; a DSA order without Section C may show its post, and with Section C it is withheld by force", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const unknown = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { messageId: null, channel: "post", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/a"] });
      expect([unknown.receivedAt, unknown.channel, unknown.state, unknown.clock!.deadlineAt, unknown.owed.received]).toEqual([null, "post", "unknown_deadline", null, true]);
      const shown = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { kind: "dsa_art9", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/b"], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      expect([shown.withholdFromAuthor, shown.preserve, shown.clock, shown.state, shown.hold]).toEqual([false, false, null, "no_clock", null]);
      // Below the schema, an insert that holds a notice and does not withhold is withheld by the trigger.
      const id = randomUUID();
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
                           values (${id}::uuid, 'dsa_art9', 'FR', 'X', ${`R-${id}`}, 'other', true, false, true, false, ${staff.id}::uuid)`);
      expect((await rowOf(tx, id)).withhold_from_author).toBe(true);
      // An insert that leaves Section C out is refused: no default decides it for a person.
      const missing = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
                                            values (gen_random_uuid(), 'dsa_art9', 'FR', 'X', ${`R-${randomUUID()}`}, 'other', false, true, true, ${staff.id}::uuid)`))
        .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => String((err as { cause?: { code?: string } }).cause?.code));
      expect(missing).toBe("23502");
    });
  });

  test("each link is an item, resolved and never fetched: a post, an image (its post, the link kept as named), an account, another site; two links that name one post are refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const post = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
      const pictured = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
      const image = await newImageRow(tx, author.id, pictured);
      const imageLink = `${configOf().APP_ORIGIN}/api/media/${image}/large.webp`;
      const view = await orderForTest(tx, staff, {
        posts: [post],
        links: [imageLink, `${configOf().APP_ORIGIN}/u/someone`, "https://elsewhere.example/x", `${configOf().APP_ORIGIN}/post/${randomUUID()}`],
      });
      expect(view.items.map((i) => [i.linkKind, i.postId])).toEqual([
        ["post", post],
        ["image", pictured],
        ["account", null],
        ["other", null],
        ["other", null],
      ]);
      expect(view.items[1]!.link).toBe(imageLink);
      expect(view.items[0]!.post).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", images: 0 });
      expect(view.items[1]!.post).toMatchObject({ images: 1 });
      expect(view.clock!.itemsOpen).toBe(5);
      const twice = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { posts: [pictured], links: [imageLink] }).then(
        () => null,
        (err: unknown) => (err instanceof ModerationError ? [err.code, err.status] : String(err)),
      );
      expect(twice).toEqual(["invalid_request", 422]);
    });

  test("the audit row order_opened holds the order's facts and names each item by its post, or by its link's digest and length, never the link", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const post = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
      const link = `${configOf().APP_ORIGIN}/u/somebody_named`;
      const view = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { posts: [post], links: [link], reference: "AUDIT-1" });
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string; target_id: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
        sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${view.id} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
      );
      expect([row!.action, row!.actor_id, row!.target_type]).toEqual(["order_opened", staff.id, "order"]);
      expect(row!.metadata).toMatchObject({ kind: "tco_removal", memberState: "DE", reference: "AUDIT-1", via: "console", crossBorder: false, withholdFromAuthor: true, receivedAt: null });
      const items = row!.metadata.items as Record<string, unknown>[];

  test("every staff account is alerted that an order was opened: one row of order_opened, with the count of items and the deadline or that it is unknown", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {

    const first = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { reference: `DUP-${started.getTime()}`, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/d"] });

      () => null,

    );
    expect(again).toEqual({ code: "order_exists", status: 409, details: { orderId: first.id } });

  test("the day's limit: the API refuses the order after records_per_day with rate_limited and Retry-After; the trigger counts again under the account's lock", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {

      const [today] = await tx.execute<{ opened: number }>(

                         values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'BKA', ${`L-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true, ${staff.id}::uuid)`),

        .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => String((err as { cause?: { message?: string } }).cause?.message));
      expect(below).toBe("rate_limited");

  test("a named message that is not there is not_found; one that went between the read and the insert is order_needs_message", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const gone = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { messageId: randomUUID(), links: ["https://elsewhere.example/g"] }).then(
        () => null,

      );
      expect(gone).toBe("not_found");
      const below = await tx
        .transaction((sp) =>
          sp.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
                         values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'BKA', ${`M-${randomUUID()}`}, 'mailbox', ${randomUUID()}::uuid, false, false, false, true, ${staff.id}::uuid)`),
        )
        .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => String((err as { cause?: { message?: string } }).cause?.message));
      expect(below).toBe("order_needs_message");
    });
  });

  test("more links: up to ORDER_ITEMS_MAX, after the last position, with their audit row; an item added after the verification is unverified; a closed order takes none", async () => {
    const opened = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/m/0"] });
    orders.push(opened.id);
    // The check, as the command line records it.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set verified_at = now() where id = ${opened.id}::uuid`);
    const deps = moderationDeps(w.apiDb, { config: configOf(), background: createBackground(pino({ level: "silent" })) });
    const added = await addItems(deps, sessionOf(staff), opened.id, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/m/1"] }, { requestId: "req-items" });
    expect(added.items.map((i) => [i.position, i.unverified])).toEqual([
      [1, false],
      [2, true],

    expect(added.owed.verification).toBe(true);
    const [audit] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ action: string; items: number }>(
      sql`select action, jsonb_array_length(metadata -> 'items') as items from public.audit_log where target_id = ${opened.id} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(audit).toEqual({ action: "order_items_added", items: 1 });
    // Filled to ORDER_ITEMS_MAX, at most itemsPerAction links an addition.
    for (let filled = 2, round = 0; filled < ORDER_ITEMS_MAX; round++) {
      const take = Math.min(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction, ORDER_ITEMS_MAX - filled);
      await addItems(deps, sessionOf(staff), opened.id, { links: Array.from({ length: take }, (_, i) => `https://elsewhere.example/n/${round}/${i}`) }, { requestId: "req-items" });
      filled += take;
    }
    const over = await addItems(deps, sessionOf(staff), opened.id, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/over"] }, { requestId: "req-items" }).then(
      () => null,
      (err: unknown) => (err instanceof ModerationError ? [err.code, err.status] : String(err)),
    );
    expect(over).toEqual(["invalid_request", 422]);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${opened.id}::uuid`);
    const closed = await addItems(deps, sessionOf(staff), opened.id, { links: ["https://elsewhere.example/closed"] }, { requestId: "req-items" }).then(
      () => null,
      (err: unknown) => (err instanceof ModerationError ? err.code : String(err)),
    );
    expect(closed).toBe("order_closed");
  });

  test("the contact point names the orders opened from a message, and the home screen's deadline is the earliest of a message's and an order's with an open item", async () => {
    const m = await message(2);
    const early = await message(1);
    const opened = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { messageId: m, links: ["https://elsewhere.example/c"] });
    orders.push(opened.id);
    const deps = moderationDeps(w.apiDb, { config: configOf() });
    const page = await contactPage(deps, {});
    expect(page.items.find((item) => item.id === m)!.orders).toEqual([opened.id]);
    expect(page.items.find((item) => item.id === early)!.orders).toEqual([]);
    // The order's receipt is a minute before the open message's, so its deadline is the earlier one.
    const due = (await contactOverview(deps)).dueAt!;
    expect(Date.parse(due)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.parse(opened.clock!.deadlineAt!));
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
