```ts
      return recentPasskeyAdditions(userId, withinMs, limit);
    },
    async addPasskey(input: NewPasskey, limits: PasskeyLimits): Promise<AddPasskeyOutcome> {
      // As the real transaction: the account locked, both bounds checked again, then the row and its event, or nothing.
      const row = users.get(input.userId);
      if (!row || row.deletedAt !== null) return { ok: false, reason: "gone" };
      if (passkeys.filter((p) => p.userId === input.userId).length >= limits.passkeys) return { ok: false, reason: "cap" };
      const additions = recentPasskeyAdditions(input.userId, limits.windowMs, limits.additions);
      if (additions.count >= limits.additions) return { ok: false, reason: "daily", retryAfterSeconds: additions.retryAfterSeconds };
      // As the real unique index on credential_id: the driver error that the flow recognises through isUniqueViolation.
      if (passkeys.some((p) => p.credentialId === input.credentialId)) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error('duplicate key value violates unique constraint "passkeys_credential_idx"'), { code: "23505" });
      }
      const passkey: RecordedPasskey = { id: randomUUID(), lastUsedAt: null, suspectAt: null, ...input };
      passkeys.push(passkey);
      recordEvent({ userId: input.userId, type: "passkey_added", deviceId: input.createdDeviceId, metadata: { passkeyId: passkey.id } });
      return { ok: true, passkey: { ...passkey } };
    },
    async renamePasskey(id: string, userId: string, name: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const passkey = passkeys.find((p) => p.id === id && p.userId === userId);
      if (!passkey) return false;
      passkey.name = name;
      return true;
    },
    async deletePasskey(id: string, userId: string): Promise<{ name: string } | undefined> {
      const index = passkeys.findIndex((p) => p.id === id && p.userId === userId);
      if (index === -1) return undefined;
      const [removed] = passkeys.splice(index, 1);
      return { name: removed!.name };
    },
    async findPasskeyByCredentialId(credentialId: string): Promise<PasskeyRow | undefined> {
      // As the real lookup: any account's, and the flow refuses a deleted owner through findUserById.
      const passkey = passkeys.find((p) => p.credentialId === credentialId);
      return passkey ? { ...passkey } : undefined;
    },
    async findPasskeyByCredential(credentialId: string, userId: string): Promise<PasskeyRow | undefined> {
      const passkey = passkeys.find((p) => p.credentialId === credentialId && p.userId === userId);
      return passkey ? { ...passkey } : undefined;
    },
    async claimPasskeyUse(id: string, newCounter: number, backedUp: boolean, at: Date): Promise<boolean> {
      // As the real conditional update: a suspect passkey never matches, and the counter must move forward unless both are zero.
      const passkey = passkeys.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (!passkey || passkey.suspectAt !== null) return false;
      if (!((newCounter === 0 && passkey.counter === 0) || newCounter > passkey.counter)) return false;
      passkey.counter = newCounter;
      passkey.lastUsedAt = at;
      passkey.backedUp = backedUp;
      return true;
    },
    async suspectPasskey(id: string, at: Date): Promise<void> {
      const passkey = passkeys.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (passkey && passkey.suspectAt === null) passkey.suspectAt = at;
    },
    async findDevice(userId: string, deviceHashValue: string): Promise<DeviceRow | undefined> {
      const device = devices.find((d) => d.userId === userId && d.deviceHash === deviceHashValue && d.revokedAt === null);
      return device ? deviceRow(device) : undefined;
    },
    async createDevice(input: { userId: string; deviceHash: string; label: string; platform: string; ipHash: string | null }): Promise<DeviceRow> {
      const device: RecordedDevice = { id: randomUUID(), userId: input.userId, revokedAt: null, platform: input.platform as Platform, label: input.label, deviceHash: input.deviceHash };
      devices.push(device);
      return deviceRow(device);
    },
    async touchDevice(): Promise<void> {
      // The row's last-seen and ip are placeholders no flow reads here, so touching it changes nothing observable.
    },
    async createSession(input: {
      id: string;
      userId: string;
      deviceId: string;
      now: Date;
      expiresAt: Date;
      absoluteExpiresAt: Date;
      factors?: Record<string, number>;
      passkeyId?: string | null;
    }): Promise<void> {
      // As the real insert: the reauth time is the latest of the factors, and a fresh handle stands in for the column's default.
      const factors = input.factors ?? {};
      const times = Object.values(factors);
      sessions.push({
        id: input.id,
        userId: input.userId,
        revokedAt: null,
        deviceId: input.deviceId,
        handle: randomUUID(),
        factors,
        passkeyId: input.passkeyId ?? null,
        reauthAt: times.length > 0 ? new Date(Math.max(...times)) : input.now,
        createdAt: input.now,
        lastUsedAt: input.now,
        expiresAt: input.expiresAt,
        absoluteExpiresAt: input.absoluteExpiresAt,
      });
    },
    async findActiveSession(id: string, at: Date): Promise<ActiveSessionRow | undefined> {
      // As the real joins: the session, its account and its device must all be live.
      const row = sessions.find((s) => s.id === id && s.revokedAt === null && s.expiresAt > at && s.absoluteExpiresAt > at);
      if (!row) return undefined;
      const user = users.get(row.userId);
      if (!user || user.deletedAt !== null) return undefined;
      const device = devices.find((d) => d.id === row.deviceId && d.revokedAt === null);
      if (!device) return undefined;
      return {
        id: row.id,
        userId: row.userId,
        deviceId: row.deviceId,
        role: user.role,
        onboardedAt: user.onboardedAt,
        totpEnabledAt: user.totpEnabledAt,
        reauthAt: row.reauthAt,
        lastUsedAt: row.lastUsedAt,
        expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
        absoluteExpiresAt: row.absoluteExpiresAt,
        handle: row.handle,
        factors: row.factors,
        passkeyId: row.passkeyId,
      };
    },
    async rotateSession(id: string, newId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      // As the real statement: the primary key changes in place for a live row, and everything else stays.
      const row = sessions.find((s) => s.id === id && s.revokedAt === null);
      if (!row) return false;
      row.id = newId;
      return true;
    },
    async writeFactor(id: string, kind: string, at: Date): Promise<void> {
      // As the real statement: the kind's time is set or replaced and the reauth time follows it.
      const row = sessions.find((s) => s.id === id);
      if (!row) return;
      row.factors = { ...row.factors, [kind]: at.getTime() };
      row.reauthAt = at;
    },
    async claimTotpStep(userId: string, step: number): Promise<boolean> {
      // As the real conditional update: a step no later than the last accepted one is refused, so a code cannot be reused.
      const row = users.get(userId);
      if (!row || (row.totpLastStep !== null && row.totpLastStep >= step)) return false;
      row.totpLastStep = step;
      return true;
    },
    async revokeAllSessions(userId: string, at: Date): Promise<string[]> {
      const live = sessions.filter((s) => s.userId === userId && s.revokedAt === null);
      for (const s of live) s.revokedAt = at;
      return live.map((s) => s.id);
    },
    async listActiveSessions(userId: string, at: Date): Promise<SessionListRow[]> {
      // As the real statement: the user's sessions that are neither revoked nor expired, most recently used first, each with its device's label.
      return sessions
        .filter((s) => s.userId === userId && s.revokedAt === null && s.expiresAt > at && s.absoluteExpiresAt > at)
        .sort((a, b) => b.lastUsedAt.getTime() - a.lastUsedAt.getTime())
        .map((s) => {
          const device = devices.find((d) => d.id === s.deviceId);
          return { id: s.id, handle: s.handle, deviceLabel: device?.label ?? null, platform: device?.platform ?? "web", createdAt: s.createdAt, lastUsedAt: s.lastUsedAt };
        });
    },
    async markDeleted(userId: string, at: Date): Promise<void> {
      const row = users.get(userId);
      if (row && row.deletedAt === null) row.deletedAt = at;
    },
    async takeDown(userId: string, at: Date, deviceId: string | null): Promise<string[]> {
      // One transaction, as the real one: when it fails midway nothing it would have written lands.
      if (faults.has("takeDown")) throw new Error("the take-down transaction failed midway and was rolled back");
      const row = users.get(userId);
      if (row && row.deletedAt === null) row.deletedAt = at;
      const revoked = takeDownRows(userId, at);
      recordEvent({ userId, type: "account_deleted", deviceId, metadata: {} });
      return revoked;
    },
    async finishTakeDown(userId: string, at: Date): Promise<string[]> {
      // As the real statement: only a row marked deleted and not purged yet.
      const row = users.get(userId);
      if (!row || row.deletedAt === null || row.purgedAt !== null) return [];
      return takeDownRows(userId, at);
    },
    async finishPurge(userId: string, at: Date): Promise<void> {
      const row = users.get(userId);
      if (!row || row.deletedAt === null || row.purgedAt !== null) return;
      Object.assign(row, {
        email: `deleted:${userId}`,
        emailVerifiedAt: null,
        passwordHash: null,
        totpSecretEnc: null,
        totpEnabledAt: null,
        recoveryCodesHash: [],
        phoneHash: null,
        ageConfirmedAt: null,
        termsVersion: null,
        termsAcceptedAt: null,
        purgedAt: at,
      });
    },
  } satisfies Pick<
    AuthRepo,
    | "findUserById"
    | "findUserByEmail"
    | "setPasswordFailures"
    | "createEmailCode"
    | "findEmailCode"
    | "addCodeAttempt"
    | "consumeEmailCode"
    | "changeEmail"
    | "setPasswordHash"
    | "enableTotp"
    | "disableTotp"
    | "lockDown"
    | "setPhoneHash"
    | "appendEvent"
    | "findDeviceById"
    | "ensureWebauthnUserId"
    | "countPasskeys"
    | "listPasskeys"
    | "findPasskey"
    | "recentPasskeyAdditions"
    | "addPasskey"
    | "renamePasskey"
    | "deletePasskey"
    | "findPasskeyByCredentialId"
    | "findPasskeyByCredential"
    | "claimPasskeyUse"
    | "suspectPasskey"
    | "findDevice"
    | "createDevice"
    | "touchDevice"
    | "createSession"
    | "findActiveSession"
    | "rotateSession"
    | "writeFactor"
    | "claimTotpStep"
    | "revokeAllSessions"
    | "listActiveSessions"
    | "markDeleted"
    | "takeDown"
    | "finishTakeDown"
    | "finishPurge"
  >;
  const authRepo = repo as unknown as AuthRepo;
  const kv = new MemoryKv(() => t);
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  /** profiles.verified_at by account, as the badge flows set and clear it through the profile store. */
  const verified = new Map<string, Date | null>();
  /** 3e: the accounts whose suspension runs, as the profile store's predicate would read them; a test adds to it. */
  const suspended = new Set<string>();
  const config: AuthConfig = {
    appOrigin: "http://localhost:8081",
    allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:8081"],
    authHmacKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 3),
    ipHashKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 4),
    totpKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 5).toString("base64")}`),
    totpPreviousKeys: [],
    notifierKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 6).toString("base64")}`),
    notifierPreviousKeys: [],
    termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
    trustProxy: "none",
    verifyProvider: "dev",
    webauthn: { rpId: "localhost", rpName: "korbat", origins: ["http://localhost:8081"] },
    // The staff console is off: no flow this harness runs reaches it.
    console: null,
    homeState: null,
    contactPoint: null,
  };
  const deps: AuthDeps = {
    repo: authRepo,
    kv,
    sessions: createSessions({ repo: authRepo, kv, now }),
    lockout: createLockout({ repo: authRepo, kv, now }),
    mailer,
    turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    // The flows this harness runs create no profile; the badge flows only set and clear verified_at, kept above by
    // account, and the deletion flow reads the handle, kept by account as `user` registers it. No flow here changes the
    // Explore switch, which reads as the column's default.
    profiles: {
      create: async () => {
        throw new Error("the memory harness has no profile store");
      },
      find: async (id) => {
        const handle = handles.get(id);
        return handle === undefined ? null : { id, handle, displayName: handle, handleChangedAt: null, verified: (verified.get(id) ?? null) !== null, showInExplore: true };
      },
      // 3e: setting the badge is refused while the account's suspension runs, as the predicate refuses the real write.
      setVerified: async (id, at) => {
        if (at !== null && suspended.has(id)) return false;
        verified.set(id, at);
        return true;
      },
      suspended: async (id) => suspended.has(id),
    },
    // The development provider, which accepts exactly 000000; a test swaps it for null or a scripted one.
    verify: devProvider(),
    config,
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now,
  };
  const ctx: RequestContext = { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined };
  /**
   * A live session on a device of its own, both recorded as the deletion flow will find them. It proved an email code
   * just now unless given other factors, as a session behind requireFreshAuth has, and started from no passkey unless told so.
   * The device is a web browser labelled as the sign-in labels one, unless the test says otherwise.
   */
  const session = (userId: string, options: { factors?: Factors; passkeyId?: string | null; platform?: Platform; label?: string | null } = {}): Session => {
    const s: Session = {
      sessionId: sha256Hex(randomToken()),
      userId,
      deviceId: randomUUID(),
      role: "user",
      onboarded: true,
      mfaEnabled: false,
      reauthAt: now(),
      handle: randomUUID(),
      factors: options.factors ?? { email: t },
      passkeyId: options.passkeyId ?? null,
    };
    sessions.push({
      id: s.sessionId,
      userId,
      revokedAt: null,
      deviceId: s.deviceId,
      handle: s.handle,
      factors: s.factors,
      passkeyId: s.passkeyId,
      reauthAt: s.reauthAt,
      createdAt: now(),
      lastUsedAt: now(),
      expiresAt: new Date(t + SESSION_IDLE_MS),
      absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(t + SESSION_ABSOLUTE_MS),
    });
    devices.push({ id: s.deviceId, userId, revokedAt: null, platform: options.platform ?? "web", label: options.label === undefined ? "Chrome on Windows" : options.label });
    return s;
  };
  return {
    deps,
    kv,
    mailer,
    ctx,
    users,
    codes,
    events,
    sessions,
    devices,
    passkeys,
    verified,
    suspended,
    faults,
    now,
    advance(ms: number) {
      t += ms;
    },
    /** Another session of an existing account, on another device. */
    session,
    /**
     * A passkey of an existing account, created at `createdAt` (now unless given) with the row's defaults (a plain,
     * unnamed synced key added from no device) unless overridden; answers its id.
     */
    passkey(userId: string, createdAt: Date = now(), overrides: Partial<Omit<RecordedPasskey, "id" | "userId" | "createdAt">> = {}): string {
      const id = randomUUID();
      passkeys.push({
        id,
        userId,
        createdAt,
        credentialId: randomToken(),
        publicKey: "cose-key",
        counter: 0,
        transports: [],
        backedUp: false,
        name: "Passkey",
        lastUsedAt: null,
        aaguid: null,
        backupEligible: false,
        uvInitialized: false,
        createdDeviceId: null,
        suspectAt: null,
        ...overrides,
      });
      return id;
    },
    /**
     * An onboarded account holding a verified address, with a session that just proved a credential, as a route
     * behind requireFreshAuth passes it on. Its profile's handle is the address's local part unless given.
     */
    user(email: string, handle: string = email.split("@")[0]!.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, "_")): { user: UserRow; session: Session } {
      const id = randomUUID();
      const user: UserRow = {
        id,
        email,
        emailVerifiedAt: now(),
        phoneHash: null,
        passwordHash: null,
        totpSecretEnc: null,
        totpEnabledAt: null,
        recoveryCodesHash: [],
        failedLogins: 0,
        lockedUntil: null,
        createdAt: now(),
        deletedAt: null,
        role: "user",
        ageConfirmedAt: now(),
        termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
        termsAcceptedAt: now(),
        onboardedAt: now(),
        passwordChangedAt: null,
        totpLastStep: null,
        purgedAt: null,
        webauthnUserId: null,
      };
      users.set(id, user);
      handles.set(id, handle);
      return { user, session: session(id) };
    },
  };
}

export type MemoryFlowHarness = ReturnType<typeof memoryFlowHarness>;
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { authConfigFrom } from "../src/auth/context";
import { loadConfig } from "../src/config";

const key = Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64");

const good = {
  DATABASE_URL_API: "postgres://korbat_api:x@localhost:5432/korbat",
  DATABASE_URL_AUTH: "postgres://korbat_auth:x@localhost:5432/korbat",
  REDIS_URL: "redis://localhost:6379",
  APP_ORIGIN: "http://localhost:8081",
  AUTH_HMAC_KEY: key,
  IP_HASH_KEY: key,
  TOTP_ENC_KEY: `v1:${key}`,
  NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: `v1:${key}`,
  TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: "1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA",
  SMTP_URL: "smtp://localhost:1025",
  MAIL_FROM: "korbat <no-reply@korbat.local>",
  TERMS_VERSION: "draft-2026-09",
};

describe("loadConfig", () => {
  test("applies defaults", () => {
    const c = loadConfig(good);
    expect(c.PORT).toBe(3000);
    expect(c.NODE_ENV).toBe("development");
    expect(c.TRUSTED_ORIGINS).toEqual([]);
  });
  test("parses trusted origins list", () => {
    expect(loadConfig({ ...good, TRUSTED_ORIGINS: "http://a.test, http://b.test" }).TRUSTED_ORIGINS).toEqual(["http://a.test", "http://b.test"]);
  });
  test("fails loudly on a missing database url", () => {
    expect(() => loadConfig({ REDIS_URL: good.REDIS_URL })).toThrow(/DATABASE_URL_API/);
  });
  test("rejects keys shorter than 32 bytes", () => {
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, AUTH_HMAC_KEY: Buffer.alloc(16).toString("base64") })).toThrow(/AUTH_HMAC_KEY/);
  });
  test("TOTP key must be versioned and exactly 32 bytes", () => {
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, TOTP_ENC_KEY: key })).toThrow(/TOTP_ENC_KEY/);
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, TOTP_ENC_KEY: `v1:${Buffer.alloc(33).toString("base64")}` })).toThrow(/TOTP_ENC_KEY/);
  });
  test("the notifier key must be versioned and exactly 32 bytes, as the TOTP key is", () => {
    expect(loadConfig(good).NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY).toBe(`v1:${key}`);
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: key })).toThrow(/NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY/);
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: `v1:${Buffer.alloc(33).toString("base64")}` })).toThrow(/NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY/);
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: "" })).toThrow(/NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY/);
  });
  test("previous notifier keys are optional, comma-separated and each versioned", () => {
    expect(loadConfig(good).NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS).toEqual([]);
    expect(loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS: "" }).NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS).toEqual([]);
    expect(loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS: `v0:${key}, v1:${key}` }).NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS).toEqual([`v0:${key}`, `v1:${key}`]);
    expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS: key })).toThrow(/NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS/);
  });
  test("the auth configuration holds the notifier key and the keys it replaced, parsed", () => {
    const older = Buffer.alloc(32, 9).toString("base64");
    const auth = authConfigFrom(loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: `v2:${key}`, NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS: `v1:${older}` }));
    expect(auth.notifierKey).toEqual({ version: "v2", key: Buffer.alloc(32, 7) });
    expect(auth.notifierPreviousKeys).toEqual([{ version: "v1", key: Buffer.alloc(32, 9) }]);
    expect(authConfigFrom(loadConfig(good)).notifierPreviousKeys).toEqual([]);
  });
  describe("the moderation settings", () => {
    test("MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR is an hour of the UTC day, 7 unless set; a blank value is the default", () => {
      expect(loadConfig(good).MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR).toBe(7);
      for (const blank of ["", "   "]) expect(loadConfig({ ...good, MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR: blank }).MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, JSON.stringify(blank)).toBe(7);
      for (const [written, hour] of [["0", 0], ["7", 7], ["23", 23], [" 12 ", 12]] as const) {
        expect(loadConfig({ ...good, MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR: written }).MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, written).toBe(hour);
      }
      for (const refused of ["24", "-1", "7.5", "yes"]) {

      }

      expect(loadConfig(good).MODERATION_RETENTION).toBe("on");
      // Compose passes an empty line of infra/.env as an empty value: a blank must never read as "off", which stops every erasure.
      for (const blank of ["", " ", "   "]) expect(loadConfig({ ...good, MODERATION_RETENTION: blank }).MODERATION_RETENTION, JSON.stringify(blank)).toBe("on");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, MODERATION_RETENTION: "on" }).MODERATION_RETENTION).toBe("on");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, MODERATION_RETENTION: "off" }).MODERATION_RETENTION).toBe("off");
      for (const refused of ["yes", "no", "true", "false", "1", "0", "ON", "Off", "paused"]) {

      // A member state whose facts are not filled in, a code that is no member state, and a lower-case one are refused.
      for (const refused of ["AT", "US", "de"]) expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, HOME_STATE: refused }), refused).toThrow(/HOME_STATE/);
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, HOME_STATE: "DE", CONTACT_POINT: "orders@korbat.example" }).CONTACT_POINT).toBe("orders@korbat.example");
      expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, CONTACT_POINT: "orders@korbat.example" })).toThrow(/HOME_STATE/);
      expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, HOME_STATE: "DE", CONTACT_POINT: "not an address" })).toThrow(/CONTACT_POINT/);
    });

    test("3f: NOTIFY is off by default outside production and on in production; a blank value is the default, and nothing but on and off is taken", () => {
      expect(loadConfig(good).NOTIFY).toBe("off");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFY: " " }).NOTIFY).toBe("off");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFY: "on" }).NOTIFY).toBe("on");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, NODE_ENV: "test" }).NOTIFY).toBe("off");
      for (const refused of ["yes", "1", "ON", "Off"]) expect(() => loadConfig({ ...good, NOTIFY: refused }), refused).toThrow(/NOTIFY/);
    });

    test("MODERATION_DEFER_UNPROVEN is off unless set to on; a blank value is the default and nothing else is taken", () => {
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

import { ALERT_KINDS, ORDER_RULES, renderAlert, type AlertFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { StaffMessage } from "../../src/auth";
import { alertTick, channelHealth, staffAlert } from "../../src/moderation/alerts";
import { overview } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { ageMessageForTest, closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, nextValidity, outboxOf, outboxSince, removeMessages, type OutboxRow } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { newStaffKey, newStaffSession, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;

/**
 * The alert channel's time-driven alerts and its two legs (3f design, sections 6.1, 7.2 and 12.1; invariants 14 and 15):
 * alert_steps() writes an escalation at escalate_minutes and the deadline's two reminders, each once, and stops them when
 * the message is handled; a person already at work in the console is not absent; the daily test is written once a day.
 * The alert tick mails every row whose mail is its sentence once, never one of 3c's or 3e's kinds, and with NOTIFY on
 * judges the channel's health with its own alarms, once in 24 hours. staffAlert writes the row of every kind of 3c and
 * 3e and marks it mailed either way.
 *
 * The steps run inside transactions of the migrator that end in a rollback: there the test sets the times it needs and
 * pushes every staff session back a day, so that the sessions earlier files of the run opened do not count as someone at
 * work. The tick commits, as the server's does; its rows and messages are removed by id, and the file's last test holds
 * it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the alert steps and the alert tick", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staffEmail: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
    // A live staff account with a key and a session: the address the staff mails of this file go to, and a session a
    // test can mark as used.
    const staff = await newStaffKey(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    staffEmail = staff.user.email;
    await newStaffSession(w.authDb, staff.user.id, staff.key.id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  }, 60_000);
  afterEach(async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A message inside the migrator's transaction, received `minutes` ago: the migrator keeps the time it supplies. */
  const messageIn = async (tx: DbTx, minutes: number, extra: { stale?: boolean } = {}) => {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at, seen_at, stale)
      values ('inbox', ${nextValidity()}, 1, now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), ${extra.stale ?? false}) returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  };
  /** Every staff session pushed a day back, its lifetime with it: nobody is at work in the console. */
  const nobodyAtWork = (tx: DbTx) =>
    tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day', last_used_at = last_used_at - interval '1 day', idle_expires_at = idle_expires_at - interval '1 day', absolute_expires_at = absolute_expires_at - interval '1 day'`);
  const steps = async (tx: DbTx) => Number((await tx.execute<{ written: number }>(sql`select public.alert_steps() as written`))[0]!.written);
  const kinds = (rows: OutboxRow[]) => rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.step]);

  test("an unanswered message is escalated to every phone once, escalate_minutes after it arrived, and not before", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes - 1);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(kinds((await outboxOf(tx, early)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated"))).toEqual([]);
      const escalated = (await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated");
      expect(kinds(escalated)).toEqual([["contact_mail_escalated", 0]]);
      expect([escalated[0]!.priority, escalated[0]!.scope]).toEqual([5, "all"]);
      expect(Object.keys(escalated[0]!.facts).sort()).toEqual(["dueAt", "receivedAt"]);
      // Once a message: a second call writes nothing for it.
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toHaveLength(1);
    });
  });

  test("a person already signed in who acts in the console is not absent: a staff session created or used since the message arrived stops the escalation", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const [session] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from auth.staff_sessions limit 1`);
      expect(session, "a staff session of this run").toBeDefined();
      await tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set last_used_at = now() where id = ${session!.id}`);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_due for a message: one row at remind_minutes and one at the deadline, each once, with the deadline and the minutes left", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      const reminded = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = async (id: string) => (await outboxOf(tx, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due");
      expect(await due(early)).toEqual([]);
      const [first] = await due(reminded);
      expect([first!.step, first!.priority, first!.scope]).toEqual([0, 5, "all"]);
      expect(first!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      expect(renderAlert("order_due", first!.facts, new Date()).title).toBe(`${first!.facts.minutesLeft} minutes left`);
      // Past the deadline only the deadline's row: the later of the two that has passed.
      expect((await due(late)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([[0, 0]]);
      // Each once: a second call writes nothing; the deadline's row comes when the deadline passes.
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await due(reminded)).toHaveLength(1);
      await ageMessageForTest(tx, reminded, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await due(reminded)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([
        [0, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1],
        [1, 0],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("handling a message ends its steps, and a stale message never has any", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const handled = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral', handled_at = now() where id = ${handled}::uuid`);
      const stale = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { stale: true });
      await steps(tx);
      // The handled message keeps the first push its insert wrote, and gets nothing more.
      expect(kinds(await outboxOf(tx, handled))).toEqual([["contact_mail", 0]]);
      expect(await outboxOf(tx, stale)).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("the daily test is written once in 24 hours, pushed only", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
      await steps(tx);
      const [test] = await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at);
      expect([test!.priority, test!.scope, test!.step, Object.keys(test!.facts)]).toEqual([3, "all", 0, ["at"]]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_test.legs).toEqual(["push"]);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at)).toHaveLength(1);
      // A day later the next one, with the next step.
      // The transaction's own clock stands still: the row moves back a day and a minute.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await tx.execute<{ step: number }>(sql`select step from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test' order by step`)).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
    });
  });

  test("two calls at once write a step once: the unique key drops the second", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await ageMessageForTest(w.migrateDb, id, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
    await Promise.all([w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`), w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`)]);
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tick

  const tickDeps = (notify: "on" | "off") => ({ ...w.deps, config: { ...w.deps.config, NOTIFY: notify } });
  const mailsOf = (template: string) => w.mailer.to(staffEmail, template);

  test("the tick's mail leg mails a row whose mail is its sentence once, to every staff account, and marks it", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    const sent = mailsOf("contact_mail").length;
    const report = await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(report.channel).toBeNull();
    const [row] = await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id);
    expect(row!.mailed_at).not.toBeNull();
    const mails = mailsOf("contact_mail").slice(sent);
    expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(mails[0]!.data).toMatchObject({ receivedAt: row!.facts.receivedAt, dueAt: row!.facts.dueAt });
    // Mailed once: the next round finds nothing owed.
    await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(mailsOf("contact_mail").slice(sent)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("a row whose mail no address took is tried again next round", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    w.mailer.mode = "fail";
    try {
      await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    } finally {
      w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
    }
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id))[0]!.mailed_at).toBeNull();
    await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id))[0]!.mailed_at).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("staffAlert writes the row of each kind of 3c and 3e, with its counts and times, and marks it mailed whether or not an address took the mail; the tick never mails it again", async () => {
    const at = new Date();
    const messages: StaffMessage[] = [
      { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 2, oldest: at },
      { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [{ lane: 1, count: 3, oldest: at }], interim: 0 },
      { template: "moderation_burst", handle: "mod_anna", count: 20 },
      { template: "moderation_reads", handle: "mod_anna", limit: 200 },
      { template: "moderation_reveal", handle: "mod_anna", at, count: 1, limit: 10 },
      { template: "moderation_csam_lifted", handle: "mod_anna", at, what: "unsealed" },
    ];
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    for (const [index, message] of messages.entries()) {
      // Every other one finds no address that takes its mail.
      w.mailer.mode = index % 2 === 0 ? "deliver" : "fail";
      try {
        expect(await staffAlert(w.deps, `alerts-steps-${randomUUID()}`, MIN, message), message.template).toBe("sent");
      } finally {
        w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
      }
    }
    for (const message of messages) {
      const rows = await outboxSince(w.migrateDb, message.template, since);
      expect(rows, message.template).toHaveLength(1);
      const [row] = rows;
      expect([row!.priority, row!.scope, row!.step, row!.mailed_at !== null], message.template).toEqual([ALERT_KINDS[message.template].priority, ALERT_KINDS[message.template].scope, null, true]);
      // The push names nobody: the handle of the staff mail is not among its facts.
      expect(JSON.stringify(row!.facts), message.template).not.toContain("mod_anna");
    }
    const mailed = messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length);
    await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length)).toEqual(mailed);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind like 'moderation_%' and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz`);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the channel's health

  const beat = (beatMinutesAgo: number | null, mailboxMinutesAgo: number | null) =>
    w.migrateDb.execute(sql`
      insert into public.notify_state (id, beat_at, mailbox_ok_at, push_ok_at)
      values (1, case when ${beatMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${beatMinutesAgo}::int) end,
                 case when ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int) end, now())
      on conflict (id) do update set beat_at = excluded.beat_at, mailbox_ok_at = excluded.mailbox_ok_at`);
  const alarms = (since: Date) => w.migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: AlertFacts; mailed: boolean }>(sql`select kind, facts, mailed_at is not null as mailed from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable') and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz order by id`);
  const clearAlarms = () => w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);

  test("with NOTIFY off the channel is off, its check is skipped, and the tick still writes and mails the steps", async () => {
    await beat(null, null);
    expect(await channelHealth(tickDeps("off"))).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
    const at = new Date();
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("off"))).raised).toEqual([]);
    expect(await alarms(at)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a beat older than channel_down_minutes is down: alert_channel_down once in 24 hours, mailed by the next round, and the home screen says so", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1, 0);
    const health = await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"));
    expect(health.channel).toBe("down");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual(["alert_channel_down"]);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual([]);
    const rows = await alarms(at);
    expect(rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["alert_channel_down", true]]);
    expect(Date.parse(String(rows[0]!.facts.since))).toBe(health.since!.getTime());
    expect(mailsOf("alert_channel_down").length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    // Mailed only: the watcher publishes no row of this kind.
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_channel_down.legs).toEqual(["mail"]);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("on"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.alerts.channel).toBe("down");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a push still owed for longer than channel_down_minutes reads as down, and a row past push_owed_minutes no longer counts", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(0, 0);
    // Rows other files left owed are not this test's to judge: a working watcher would have pushed them.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where pushed_at is null`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    // Every other row still owed is pushed meanwhile, as a working watcher would have: this file judges its own row.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where pushed_at is null and message_id is distinct from ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("down");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.pushOwedMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a fresh beat with a mailbox not read for channel_down_minutes is mailbox_unreachable, pushed and mailed, once in 24 hours", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(0, ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1);
    // Rows other files left owed are not this test's to judge: a working watcher would have pushed them.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where pushed_at is null`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("mailbox");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual(["mailbox_unreachable"]);
    await alertTick(tickDeps("on"));
    expect((await alarms(at)).map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["mailbox_unreachable", true]]);
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.mailbox_unreachable.legs).toEqual(["push", "mail"]);
    await clearAlarms();
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  });

  test("the home screen counts the messages nobody handled, stale ones included, with the oldest and the earliest deadline", async () => {
    const first = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 60 * MIN));
    const second = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 2 * MIN));
    made.push(first, second);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("off"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.contact.open).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    const [stored] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ received_at: string }>(sql`select received_at from public.contact_messages where id = ${first}::uuid`);
    expect(home.contact.oldestAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(Date.parse(home.contact.oldestAt!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.parse(stored!.received_at));
    expect(Date.parse(home.contact.dueAt!)).toBe(Date.parse(home.contact.oldestAt!) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * MIN);
    expect(home.alerts).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3f, Task 2: an order's steps (section 6.1, the rows marked 0025)

  /** A removal order of the migrator's in the transaction, received `minutes` ago, with an item open or disabled. */
  async function orderIn(tx: DbTx, minutes: number, options: { disabled?: boolean; open?: boolean; kind?: string; verified?: boolean; reasons?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, received_at, opened_at, opened_via,
                                       verified_at, reasons)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${options.kind ?? "tco_removal"}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`S-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true,
              now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), 'cli',
              ${options.verified ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${options.reasons ? "the authority's reasons" : null})
      returning id`);
    if (options.open ?? true) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 1, 'https://elsewhere.example/open')`);
    if (options.disabled) {
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, added_at, disabled_at) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 2, 'https://elsewhere.example/done', now() - make_interval(hours => 2), now() - make_interval(mins => 1))`);
    }
    return row!.id;
  }
  const orderRows = async (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ kind: string; step: number; scope: string; priority: number; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select kind, step, scope, priority, facts from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by id`,
    )).map((r) => ({ ...r }));
  const restart = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string, annexMinutes: number, clarifiedMinutes: number) =>
    tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'manifest_error', now() - make_interval(mins => ${annexMinutes}), 'cli'),
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'clarification_received', null, now() - make_interval(mins => ${clarifiedMinutes}), 'cli')`);

  test("order_due for an order: at remind_minutes and at the deadline while an item is open, the clock runs and the order is not closed; never for one given effect in full, stopped or closed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const remind = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      const partial = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1, { disabled: true });
      const full = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { disabled: true, open: false });
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now() - make_interval(mins => 30), 'cli')`);
      const closed = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${closed}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = (rows: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof orderRows>>) => rows.filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due").map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.itemsOpen, r.scope, r.priority]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, late))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, late))[0]!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(0);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, partial))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      for (const none of [full, stopped, closed]) expect(due(await orderRows(tx, none))).toEqual([]);
      // The deadline passes for the order reminded at remind_minutes: the second reminder, once.
      // The order and its first reminder an hour further back, as the hour would have passed.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = received_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}), opened_at = opened_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where order_id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([
        [0, 1, "all", 5],
        [1, 1, "all", 5],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a restart of an order's clock rings the phone on call again, as a message's first push, once a restart; a second restart alerts again", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = await orderIn(tx, 50);
      await restart(tx, order, 40, 10);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const first = (await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail");
      expect(first.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "on_call", 5, ["dueAt"]]]);
      // The first restart's row was written when it came, nine minutes before the second.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => 9) where order_id = ${order}::uuid`);
      await restart(tx, order, 5, 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail").map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // A stopped clock does not ring.
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, 50);
      await restart(tx, stopped, 40, 10);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now(), 'cli')`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, stopped)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_unverified, daily: one count for orders given effect and not verified (or with an item added after the check), one for missing reasons, one for holds without an end", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'order_unverified'`);
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: true });
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: true, verified: true, reasons: true });
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: false });
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "order_unverified", since);
      // The verified order's disabled item was added two hours before its check: it counts as verified.
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, r.facts.textsMissing, r.facts.holdsOpen, typeof r.facts.oldestAt])).toEqual([[0, "all", 5, 1, 1, 0, "string"]]);
    });
  });
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { MeProfile } from "@korbat/contracts";
import pino from "pino";
import type { AuthConfig, AuthDeps, ProfileStore, RequestContext } from "../../src/auth/context";
import { decrypt, parseVersionedKey, randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { signIn } from "../../src/auth/flows/signin";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createLockout } from "../../src/auth/lockout";
import { hashPassword } from "../../src/auth/passwords";
import type { AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { createSessions } from "../../src/auth/sessions";
import { currentStep, hotp } from "../../src/auth/totp";
import { devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { fakeClock } from "./auth-fixtures";

/**
 * Handles unique per store, like the real public.profiles index. A new profile has never changed its handle, holds no
 * badge and shows its posts in Explore, as the column's default has it.
 */
export function memoryProfiles(): ProfileStore {
  const byHandle = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  const byId = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      if (byHandle.has(handle) || byId.has(id)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
      const profile = { id, handle, displayName, handleChangedAt: null, verified: false, showInExplore: true };
      byHandle.set(handle, profile);
      byId.set(id, profile);
      return { ok: true, profile: { id, handle, displayName } };
    },
    async find(id) {
      return byId.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      const profile = byId.get(id);
      if (profile) profile.verified = at !== null;
      return true;
    },
    // No account of these suites is suspended: the real store and its predicate are http-badge.test.ts's.
    async suspended() {
      return false;
    },
  };
}

export const TEST_TERMS = "draft-test";
export const CHROME_WINDOWS = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/139.0.0.0 Safari/537.36";

/**
 * Real auth repository (Postgres) with an in-memory key-value store, mailer and profile store, a fake
 * clock shared by all of them, Turnstile that fails only for the token "fail", and a breach checker
 * that flags passwords containing "breached". A suite whose profiles live in the public schema (the
 * deletion flow compares the typed handle with the profile's) passes the real profile store instead. The staff
 * console is off unless a suite names its origin and relying party ID, as the staff suites do (3a design, section 12).
 */
export function flowHarness(repo: AuthRepo, options: { profiles?: ProfileStore; console?: { origin: string; rpId: string } } = {}) {
  const clock = fakeClock();
  const kv = new MemoryKv(clock.ms);
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const config: AuthConfig = {
    appOrigin: "http://localhost:8081",
    allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:8081"],
    authHmacKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 3),
    ipHashKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 4),
    totpKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 5).toString("base64")}`),
    totpPreviousKeys: [],
    notifierKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 6).toString("base64")}`),
    notifierPreviousKeys: [],
    termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
    trustProxy: "none",
    verifyProvider: "dev",
    webauthn: { rpId: "localhost", rpName: "korbat", origins: ["http://localhost:8081"] },
    console: options.console ?? null,
    homeState: null,
    contactPoint: null,
  };
  const deps: AuthDeps = {
    repo,
    kv,
    mailer,
    config,
    now: clock.now,
    sessions: createSessions({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    lockout: createLockout({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    turnstile: { verify: async (token) => token !== "fail" },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async (password) => password.includes("breached") },
    profiles: options.profiles ?? memoryProfiles(),
    verify: devProvider(),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
  };
  const ctx: RequestContext = { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: CHROME_WINDOWS };
  return { deps, clock, kv, mailer, ctx };
}

export type FlowHarness = ReturnType<typeof flowHarness>;

export const newTestEmail = (prefix = "flow") => `${prefix}-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
export const newTestDevice = () => ({ deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" as const });
export const wrongCode = (code: string) => String((Number(code) + 1) % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");

/** An onboarded account, optionally with a password, signed in on one web device. */
export async function onboardedUser(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, options: { password?: string } = {}) {
  const email = newTestEmail("account");
  const created = await repo.createUser({ email, termsVersion: TEST_TERMS, now: new Date() });
  await repo.markOnboarded(created.id, new Date());
  if (options.password) await repo.setPasswordHash(created.id, await hashPassword(options.password), new Date());
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(created.id))!;
  const device = newTestDevice();
  const signed = await signIn(h.deps, user, device, h.ctx, { alertNewDevice: false, factors: { email: h.clock.ms() }, method: "email" });
  return { email, user, device, session: signed.issued.session, token: signed.issued.token };
}

export type OnboardedUser = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof onboardedUser>>;

/** The TOTP code for a user's stored secret at the harness clock. */
export async function currentTotpCode(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, userId: string): Promise<string> {
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(userId))!;
  const secret = new Uint8Array(decrypt(user.totpSecretEnc!, [h.deps.config.totpKey]));
  return hotp(secret, currentStep(h.clock.ms()));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Every method of the media repository, in one record (3c design, section 12). A method that deletes image rows is run
 * against a frozen post below; a method that gives an image, or what an image is, to someone is run against sealed

 * them at run time, so a method added to createMediaRepo fails this file until whoever adds it has said which it is,
 * and a new deleter or reader fails it until it has a run of its own.
 */
type Role = { is: "deleter" } | { is: "reader" } | { is: "neither"; why: string };
const METHODS: Record<keyof MediaRepo, Role> = {
  accountCreatedAt: { is: "neither", why: "reads when an account was onboarded, and no image row" },
  pendingCount: { is: "neither", why: "counts an account's uploads that are on no post" },

  purgeOwner: { is: "deleter" },

  readyImages: { is: "reader" },

  processingIds: { is: "neither", why: "lists uploads that are still processing, which are on no post" },

  dropDisposable: async (f: Frozen) => {
```
