      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report about the post itself places its case's hold and freezes the post.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update media_holds set released_at = now() where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        const [row] = await w.tx.execute<{ held: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until is not null as held from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(row).toEqual({ held: false });
        await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
        for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
          await run({ repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds });
          expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), name).toEqual(p.mediaIds);
        }
      }, migrateDb);
    });
  });

  describe("gate K through the flows: the author's deletion, the purge, the sweeper and the reconcile pass", () => {
    /** Each kind of reach through a real report of child sexual abuse material; it answers nothing, the post is frozen. */
    const REPORTS: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "its own item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(post.postId), "csam"),
      "its author's account's item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam"),
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId })), "csam"),
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(REPORTS))("a post frozen through %s: its rows outlive every flow that deletes, no file of them is requested, and no reader shows them once the post is deleted", async (kind) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const frozen = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await REPORTS[kind]!(w, { postId: frozen.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        // A case about the account reaches every post of the account, so there the other post's image is kept too.
        const kept = kind === "its author's account's item" ? [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds] : frozen.mediaIds;
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => kept.includes(id));

        // The author deletes the post, through the flow: the post is a tombstone, and its image rows stay.
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId);
        expect(await rejection(getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // No reader shows a kept image of a deleted post, to its owner either, so the freeze tells the author nothing.
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [ada.id, null]) expect((await ask(w, id, viewer)).kind, `serve ${String(viewer)}`).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.find(id)).toBeNull();
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(ada.id, id)).toBe(false);
        }
        expect((await w.repo.forPosts([frozen.postId])).size).toBe(0);
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(ada.id)).toEqual([...free.mediaIds, upload]);
        // The reconcile pass asks which ids have a row: the kept rows are seen, so their files are no orphans.
        expect(await w.repo.existing(frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(new Set(frozen.mediaIds));

        // The export names no image under the deleted post, holds no file of it, and lists none as missing.
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`, `media/${upload}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === frozen.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", media: [] });
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === free.postId)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(free.mediaIds);
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

        // The sweeper two days on, with its reconcile pass: every stored file is old by then, and none of the kept rows'
        // files is taken for an orphan.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The account is purged, by the request and then again by the job: the kept rows stay, unserved, and only the
        // files of the rows that went are requested.
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds, upload])).toEqual(sorted(kept));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: {
            forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)),
            exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")),
            takeDownDue: async () => ({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 }),
          },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // 3e: the strike it gives counts all the same (a strike never has a no_effect): what counts is the breach.
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([
          ["remove", "deleted"],
          ["strike", null],
        ]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never, social: socialForModeration(w.tx as unknown as Db) }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {
          expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
        }
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper's reconcile pass leaves the retained rows' files alone.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
      });
    });
  });

  describe("gates S and V: every reader, for a frozen post and for sealed images", () => {
    /** An author with an image post, a reply of their own with an image and a post Explore ranks, and a reader who follows them. */
    async function scene(w: World) {
      // Explore ranks as of a past this file has to itself, so no other suite's post is in the ranking read below.
      const asOf = new Date(Date.UTC(2019, 0, 10, 12));
      const [author, other, ...fans] = await accounts(w.tx as unknown as Db, asOf, 5);
      const top = await w.h.postWithImages(author!.id, 2);
      const strangerReply = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply by someone else", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const reply = await newPost(w.s.repo, author!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply with an image", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const replyImage = await w.h.readyImage(author!.id);
      await w.tx.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${reply}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'a reply image' where id = ${replyImage}::uuid`);
      const quoting = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "look at this", { quoteOfId: top.postId });
      const ranked = await newPostRow(w.tx, author!.id, { createdAt: sql`${earlier(asOf, 2 * HOUR).toISOString()}::timestamptz` });
      const rankedImage = await newImageRow(w.tx, author!.id, ranked, 0);
      await likedBy(w.s.repo, ranked, fans as { id: string }[], earlier(asOf, HOUR));
      // A round writes nothing while a ranking as new as its own time exists, and other suites leave theirs behind:
      // inside this transaction, which is rolled back, there is none.
      await w.tx.execute(sql`delete from explore_runs`);
      await rank(w.s.repo, asOf);
      for (const reader of [author!, other!]) {
        expect(await w.s.repo.like(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
        expect(await w.s.repo.bookmark(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(await w.s.repo.follow(other!.id, author!.id, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      return { author: author!, other: other!, top, strangerReply, reply, replyImage, quoting, ranked, rankedImage };
    }
    type Scene = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>;
    type Listed = (MediaView | HiddenMedia)[] | undefined;

    /**
     * Every list a post's images are read through, each as the viewer gets it: the images of the named post in that list.
     * `signedIn` marks the lists only an account has; Following is read by the one who follows the author.
     */
    function lists(w: World, f: Scene): { name: string; images: string[]; signedIn?: boolean; onlyFor?: string; read: (viewer: string | null) => Promise<Listed> }[] {
      const top = [...f.top.mediaIds];
      const inItems = (items: { post: PostView }[], id: string) => items.find((item) => item.post.id === id)?.post.media;
      const inPosts = (items: PostView[], id: string) => items.find((post) => post.id === id)?.media;
      return [
        { name: "the single post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId)).media },
        { name: "a thread's own post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).post.media },
        { name: "a thread's ancestor", images: top, read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.strangerReply, page)).ancestors as PostView[], f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a thread's reply", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).replies.items, f.reply) },
        { name: "the Latest timeline", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await latestTimeline(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the Following timeline", images: top, signedIn: true, onlyFor: f.other.id, read: async (v) => inItems((await followingTimeline(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "Explore", images: [f.rankedImage], read: async (v) => inItems((await explorePage(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.ranked) },
        { name: "the profile's posts", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await profilePosts(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the profile's replies", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await profileReplies(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.reply) },
        { name: "likes", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await likedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "bookmarks", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await bookmarkedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a quote embed", images: top, read: async (v) => { const quote = (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.quoting)).quoteOf; return quote && "media" in quote ? quote.media : undefined; } },
      ];
    }
    /** Runs every list for every viewer it has, and hands each answer to `check`. */
    async function everyList(w: World, f: Scene, check: (answer: Listed, images: string[], viewer: string | null, label: string) => void) {
      for (const list of lists(w, f)) {
        for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) {
          if (viewer === null && list.signedIn) continue;
          if (list.onlyFor && viewer !== list.onlyFor) continue;
          check(await list.read(viewer), list.images, viewer, `${list.name}, read by ${viewer === f.author.id ? "the author" : viewer === null ? "nobody signed in" : "another account"}`);
        }
      }
    }
    test("a frozen post whose images are not sealed: staff are refused, and every other reader is unchanged", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const f = await scene(w);
        await report(w.tx, anAccount(f.author.id, f.author.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, f.top.postId)).toBe(true);

        let read = 0;
        await everyList(w, f, (answer, images, _viewer, label) => {
          read++;
          expect(answer, label).toEqual(images.map(whole));
          expect(answer!.some((image) => "hidden" in image), label).toBe(false);
        });
        // Twelve lists: nine for every reader, likes and bookmarks for the two accounts, Following for the one who follows.
        expect(read).toBe(9 * 3 + 2 * 2 + 1);
        for (const id of f.top.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) expect(await ask(w, id, viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "public, max-age=300" });
          expect(await status(w.h.deps, f.author.id, id)).toMatchObject({ status: "ready", blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" });
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(f.author.id, id)).toBe(true);
        }

      await inWorld(async (w) => {

        expect(row!.state).toBe(state);

        expect((await getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, p.postId)).media).toEqual([{ id: p.mediaIds[0], hidden: true, sealed: true }]);
        // A post that is only withheld or removed, with an image that is not sealed, still shows it to its author alone.

        await decideIn(w.tx, mod, other.caseId, state === "withheld" ? { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] } : { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        expect(await ask(w, plain.mediaIds[0]!, ada.id)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "private, no-store" });

        expect("moderation" in view).toBe(false);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("an image that is itself withheld or removed", () => {
    test("its author gets it with its state and is served it; anyone else gets a placeholder that does not say which, and is not served it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const [ada, bob] = [await w.s.established(), await w.s.established()];
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 3);

        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "rule");
        const media = async (viewer: string | null) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, viewer, p.postId)).media;

        await decideIn(w.tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold_media", first)] });
        expect(await media(ada.id)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: first, moderation: "withheld", alt: "image 1", large: mediaPath(first, "large") }), whole(second), whole(third)]);
        for (const viewer of [bob.id, null]) expect(await media(viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual([{ id: first, hidden: true }, whole(second), whole(third)]);
        expect(await ask(w, first, ada.id)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "private, no-store" });

        expect(await ask(w, second, null)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "public, max-age=300" });

        writeFileSync(w.h.files.store.image(second, "large"), webpBytes("VP8X", 2048, 1536));
        expect(await staffOpens(w, second)).toBe(true);
      });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no moderation row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    expect(await moderationCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(authCounts);
  });
});

    const names = new Set<string>();
    const collect = (value: unknown): void => {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) value.forEach(collect);
      else if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") for (const [name, member] of Object.entries(value)) (names.add(name), collect(member));
    };
    collect([page, view, whileDeciding]);
    // 3e Task 5: `reportingStanding` is where the author's own restriction of reporting stands, never a report about them.
    expect([...names].filter((name) => /report|intake|notice|notifier|sender|count$|items?$/i.test(name))).toEqual(["imageCount", "reportingStanding"]);
    expect(view.source).toBe("report");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place in its author's views: each image is a placeholder that tells the author alone that it is sealed, the post has no chip, and the sealing decision's view shows the text beside the sealed images", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const reader = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "text beside the images" });
    const images = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 0), await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 1)];
    const notice = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
    const seal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });

    const own = await postOf(author.b, postId);
    expect(own).toMatchObject({ id: postId, body: "text beside the images", state: "visible" });
    expect(own.media).toEqual(images.map((id) => ({ id, hidden: true, sealed: true })));
    // The post itself is neither withheld nor removed: it has no chip, and the decision is under Settings, Cases.
    expect("moderation" in own).toBe(false);
    for (const other of [reader.b, new Browser(app, origin)]) expect((await postOf(other, postId)).media).toEqual(images.map((id) => ({ id, hidden: true })));

    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: seal, kind: "interim", actions: ["seal_media"], ruleId: "R2", legal: false, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null }]);
    const view = await decisionOf(author.b, seal);
    expect(view.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }]);
    expect(view.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" });
    // Nothing of a sealed image is in the answer: no id, no path and no description.
    for (const part of [...images, "image 1", "image 2", "/api/media/"]) expect(JSON.stringify(view).includes(part), part).toBe(false);

    // An admin answers without a seal: the seal ends, and the decision's view lists the images for the app's own image route.
    const answer = await decided(admin, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, seal)).content).toEqual({
      kind: "post",
      body: "text beside the images",
      deletedByAuthor: false,
      images: images.map((id, index) => ({ id, alt: `image ${index + 1}`, width: 1200, height: 800, small: mediaPath(id, "small"), large: mediaPath(id, "large") })),
      imageCount: 2,
      imagesHidden: null,
    });
    // The author was told that what korbat did while deciding has ended: that decision is listed, above the seal's.
    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(page.decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: answer, kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], endedInterim: true, ruleId: null, legal: false, appealUntil: null }, { id: seal }]);
    const ended = await decisionOf(author.b, answer);
    // A decision without a measure tells its author neither its facts nor its reason: they are the case's record.
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] });
  });

  test("a decision about a post its author deleted since shows korbat's copy of the text and none of its images; one whose copy was erased says on which day, and whether the post itself is still there", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const kept = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "kept by its author" });
    const gone = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "deleted by its author" });
    const goneImage = await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, gone, 0);
    const decisions: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const postId of [kept, gone]) {
      const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
      decisions[postId] = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    }
    // The author deletes the second post, as the app's delete does: the row stays as a tombstone, and its image is held for the case.
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
    const deleted = await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!);
    expect(deleted.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "deleted by its author", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" });
    expect(JSON.stringify(deleted).includes(goneImage)).toBe(false);
    expect(deleted.post).toMatchObject({ id: gone });

    // The retention job's erasure, done here as the migrator does it: the content columns and the salt null, the day stamped.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = null, media = null, display_name = null, bio = null, salt = null, erased_at = now()
                            where id in (select snapshot_id from decisions where id = any(${`{${Object.values(decisions).join(",")}}`}::uuid[]))`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: true });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
    // Once an R4 redaction erased the content, every decision about the post says so, whichever is viewed.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set redacted_at = now() where id = ${decisions[kept]!}::uuid`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "r4_redacted" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
  });

  test("the chip names the decision of the strongest post measure in force: an interim decision as such, a removal before a withhold, the newest removal first; and it is the author's alone", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const reader = await signUp();
    // Withheld while korbat decides, under R4.
    const held = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const first = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(held)], { ruleId: "R4" }));
    const withhold = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await postOf(author.b, held)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: withhold, ruleId: "R4", legal: false, interim: true } });
    // Nobody else is shown a withheld post at all.
    expect((await reader.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${held}`)).status).toBe(404);

    // Removed twice, by the decisions of two cases: the newer removal is named.
    const twice = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const one = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(twice)]));
    await decided(moderator, one.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const two = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(twice)], { ruleId: "R3" }));
    const newer = await decided(moderator, two.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    // 3e: the post got its one strike from the R1 removal; the newer removal gives none, so its chip names no strike.
    expect((await postOf(author.b, twice)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: newer, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null });
    // A withhold while a third case is decided does not take the chip from the removal.
    const three = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(twice)], { ruleId: "R6" }));
    await decided(moderator, three.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await postOf(author.b, twice)).toMatchObject({ state: "removed", moderation: { decisionId: newer, ruleId: "R3", interim: false } });

    // The author's own lists carry the chip too; a visible post carries none.
    const fine = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const list = await read(author.b, `/api/profiles/${author.handle}/posts?limit=50`, TimelinePage);
    const listed = new Map(list.items.map((item) => [item.post.id, item.post]));
    expect(listed.get(held)?.moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: withhold, ruleId: "R4", legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null });
    expect(listed.get(twice)?.moderation).toMatchObject({ decisionId: newer });
    expect("moderation" in listed.get(fine)!).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3f: every read on the author's side takes the decisions its author was told of by one fragment, both halves; a decision held untold leaves the list, its view and the chip until it is told", async () => {
    // Both halves: a 3c decision whose author is told nothing (the silent one above) has informed_at set, and an order's
    // held notice (Task 3) has informed_at null.
    expect(new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(toldToAuthor("d")).sql).toBe("(d.author_mail <> 'none' and d.informed_at is not null)");
    const author = await signUp();
    const post = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(post)]));
    const removal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions.map((d) => d.id)).toContain(removal);
    expect((await postOf(author.b, post)).moderation).toMatchObject({ decisionId: removal });
    const [kept] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ informed_at: string; author_mail: string; author_mail_at: string | null }>(
      sql`select informed_at::text, author_mail::text, author_mail_at::text from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid`,
    );
    // Held untold, as order_correct makes a decision about a post whose order gains "must not be told".
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = null, author_mail = 'none' where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
    try {
      expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions.map((d) => d.id)).not.toContain(removal);
      expect((await author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${removal}`)).status).toBe(404);
      expect("moderation" in (await postOf(author.b, post))).toBe(false);
    } finally {
      await w.migrateDb.execute(
        sql`update decisions set informed_at = ${kept!.informed_at}::timestamptz, author_mail = ${kept!.author_mail}::delivery_state, author_mail_at = ${kept!.author_mail_at}::timestamptz where id = ${removal}::uuid`,
      );
    }
    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions.map((d) => d.id)).toContain(removal);
  });

  test("Your reports lists the account's own reports, newest first, each item under the link it named and silent until the daily release; then in the words of the mail, an account still under the handle the report named", async () => {
    const reporter = await signUp();

    const first = await sent(report([postTarget(postId), accountTarget(subject.handle)], { ruleId: "R3" }), reporter.session);
    // Someone signed out reports the same post: one decision answers both, and each sender reads the same words.
    const beside = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R3" }));
    const second = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(quoting)], { turnstileToken: undefined }), reporter.session);
    // On the path for child sexual abuse material korbat records no sender, the account included: it is listed nowhere.
    const elsewhere = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const anonymous = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(elsewhere)], { turnstileToken: undefined }), reporter.session);
    expect(anonymous.token).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
    await sent(report([postTarget(elsewhere)]), other.session);

    const silent = await reportsOf(reporter.b);
    expect(silent).toEqual({
      reports: [
        { ref: second.ref, receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/), items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${quoting}`, scope: null, ...reported }] },
        { ref: first.ref, receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/), items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, scope: null, ...reported }, { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, scope: "account", ...reported }] },
      ],
      nextCursor: null,
      reportMailStopped: false,
    });
    expect((await reportsOf(other.b)).reports).toHaveLength(1);

    // Decided, and still silent: nothing is told before the daily release.
    await decided(moderator, first.items[0]!.case_id!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await decided(moderator, first.items[1]!.case_id!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await decided(moderator, second.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident" });
    expect(await reportsOf(reporter.b)).toEqual(silent);
    // The account changes its handle after the report: the list keeps the handle the report named.
    const renamed = `r_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = ${renamed} where id = ${subject.id}::uuid`);
    await release();

    const after = await reportsOf(reporter.b);
    const rule = { id: "R3", title: getRule("R3")!.title };
    const until = expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T/);
    expect(after.reports).toEqual([
      { ref: second.ref, receivedAt: silent.reports[0]!.receivedAt, items: [{ ...reported, position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${quoting}`, scope: "quote", outcome: "not_evident", decidedOn: today(), reexamination: { open: true, until } }] },
      {
        ref: first.ref,
        receivedAt: silent.reports[1]!.receivedAt,
        items: [
          { ...reported, position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, scope: null, outcome: "restricted_rule", decidedOn: today(), rule },
          { ...reported, position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, scope: "account", outcome: "no_violation", decidedOn: today(), reexamination: { open: true, until } },
        ],
      },
    ]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(after).includes(renamed)).toBe(false);
    const words = after.reports.flatMap((row) => row.items.map(itemOutcomeWords));
    expect(words).toEqual([
      `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`,
      `access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R3 (${rule.title}).`,
      `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`,
    ]);
    // The status page of the signed-out report beside it carries the same facts, and so reads the same words.
    const status = await noticeStatus(w.deps, { ref: beside.ref, token: beside.token! }, w.sender().netHash);
    expect(status.items).toEqual([{ ...waiting, position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, scope: null, outcome: "restricted_rule", decidedOn: today(), rule }]);
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(status.items[0]!)).toBe(words[1]);

    // The line of the daily mail that is owed for the notice of illegality reads the list's words: one composition for both.
    const lineOf = async (ref: string) => updateLine(w.deps, (await pendingOutcomeLines(w.apiDb)).find((row) => row.ref === ref)!);
    expect((await lineOf(second.ref)).outcome).toBe(words[0]);

    // A notice about the post, now removed: the new removal changed nothing anyone sees, and the list and the mail's line say so.
    const again = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(postId)], { turnstileToken: undefined }), reporter.session);
    await decided(moderator, again.caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await release();
    const newest = (await reportsOf(reporter.b)).reports[0]!;
    expect(newest).toMatchObject({ ref: again.ref, items: [{ outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }] });
    expect("rule" in newest.items[0]!).toBe(false);
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(newest.items[0]!)).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.restricted_legal}. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect((await lineOf(again.ref)).outcome).toBe(itemOutcomeWords(newest.items[0]!));
  });

    const token = /#t=([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/.exec(w.mailer.to(reporter.email, "notice_received").at(-1)!.data.pageUrl!)![1]!;
    expect(await w.authForModeration.stopNotifier((await w.notice(signedOut.ref))!.contact_id!, token)).toBe(true);
    expect((await reportsOf(reporter.b)).reportMailStopped).toBe(true);
    expect((await reportsOf(other.b)).reportMailStopped).toBe(false);

    // Another account's resume lifts nothing of this one's.
    const resume = (b: Browser) => b.fetch("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST" });
    const none = await resume(other.b);
    expect([none.status, await none.text()]).toEqual([204, ""]);
    expect((await reportsOf(reporter.b)).reportMailStopped).toBe(true);
    const lifted = await resume(reporter.b);
    expect([lifted.status, await lifted.text()]).toEqual([204, ""]);
    expect((await reportsOf(reporter.b)).reportMailStopped).toBe(false);
    expect(await w.authForModeration.accountReportMailStopped(reporter.id)).toBe(false);
    expect((await resume(reporter.b)).status).toBe(204);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await w.cleanUp();
    await d.close();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });

/**
 * Rows for the database tests of the moderation tables (3c design, sections 6.1 and 6.2), written as SQL the way the
 * intake transaction writes them: an insert names only what the API supplies, and the triggers of migrations 0015 and
 * 0016 force the rest. The helpers take a pool or a transaction, so a test chooses the role and whether anything commits.
 * The suites share one database, so a test leaves nothing behind: it runs inside a transaction that is rolled back, or,
 * where a second session must see its rows, it commits them and removes them again with removeFixtures.
 */
export type Runner = Db | DbTx;
export type TargetType = "post" | "account";

export const TC = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";
export const MINORS = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS";
export const SPEECH = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH";

/** 32 random bytes as lower-case hex: a salt, a digest's stand-in or a token's hash. */
export const hex64 = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

/** A public reference as the API makes it: N- and ten base32 characters. */
export function newRef(): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  return `N-${Array.from(randomBytes(10), (byte) => alphabet[byte % 32]).join("")}`;
}

/** Null as SQL, any other value as a parameter. */
const orNull = (value: string | null | undefined, cast: string): SQL => (value === null || value === undefined ? sql`null` : sql`${value}::${sql.raw(cast)}`);

/** Ids as one uuid[] parameter. */
export const uuids = (ids: readonly string[]): SQL => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

/**
 * A post row straight in the table: these tests need the row, not the flow and its counters. It is dated a month back.
 * The suites share one database, and others read the public Latest timeline from its newest post down and Explore's
 * 48-hour window: a visible post dated now would stand among theirs, and dozens of them push theirs off the first page.
 */
export async function newPostRow(db: Runner, authorId: string, options: { quoteOfId?: string; replyToId?: string; body?: string; createdAt?: SQL } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, quote_of_id, reply_to_id, created_at)
        values (${authorId}::uuid, ${options.body ?? "a post"}, ${orNull(options.quoteOfId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(options.replyToId, "uuid")}, ${options.createdAt ?? sql`now() - interval '30 days'`})
        returning id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/**
 * A ready image of the account, on the post when one is given. The row is inserted on no post, which is the only way the
 * database takes one, and then attached with one update of post_id, position and alt text, as the media repository's
 * attach does.
 */
export async function newImageRow(db: Runner, ownerId: string, postId: string | null, position = 0): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) values (${ownerId}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL') returning id`,
  );
  if (postId) await db.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${postId}::uuid, position = ${position}, alt_text = ${`image ${position + 1}`} where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
  return row!.id;
}

export interface IntakeInput {

/** Inserts an intake with the ground's columns, as step 4.2 of the intake transaction does, and answers its id. */
export async function insertIntake(db: Runner, input: IntakeInput): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    insert into intakes (kind, ref, lookup_hash, channel, reporter_id, finding_by, contact_id, rule_id, alleges_illegal, csam, category, category_keyword, cited_law, explanation, bona_fide)
    values (${input.kind ?? "user"}::intake_kind, ${input.ref ?? newRef()}, ${orNull(input.lookupHash, "text")}, ${input.channel ?? "signed_in"}::intake_channel,
            ${orNull(input.reporterId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.findingBy, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.contactId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.ruleId, "text")},
            ${input.allegesIllegal ?? false}, ${input.csam ?? false}, ${input.category ?? TC}, ${orNull(input.categoryKeyword, "text")},
            ${orNull(input.citedLaw, "text")}, ${orNull(input.explanation, "text")}, ${input.bonaFide ?? false})
    returning id`);
  return row!.id;
}

/** A signed-in report under a korbat rule. */
export const ruleReport = (db: Runner, reporterId: string, ruleId = "R1") => insertIntake(db, { kind: "user", channel: "signed_in", reporterId, ruleId, category: TC });

/** A signed-in notice that the target is illegal, with its explanation and good-faith statement. */

/** A notice on the path for child sexual abuse material: signed out, no account, no contact, only the token's hash. */

/**
 * The target's open case, opened when there is none: the insert that does nothing on a conflict and the read of the
 * open case, as step 4.3 of the intake transaction runs them.
 */
export async function openCase(db: Runner, targetType: TargetType, targetId: string): Promise<string> {

  if (!row) throw new Error("the target has no open case");
  return row.id;
}

/** An item as the database stores it, with the columns these tests read. A raw read hands every time over as PostgreSQL's text. */
export interface ItemRow {

  intake_id: string;
  position: number;
  target_type: TargetType;
  target_id: string;
  named_handle: string | null;

/** Inserts one item and answers the row as the attach trigger left it. */
export async function insertItem(db: Runner, input: ItemInput): Promise<ItemRow> {
  const extra = Object.entries(input.extra ?? {});
  const names = extra.map(([name]) => sql.raw(`, ${name}`));
  const values = extra.map(([, value]) => sql`, ${value}`);
  const [row] = await db.execute<ItemRow & Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    insert ${sql.raw(input.marker ? `/* ${input.marker} */` : "")} into intake_items (intake_id, case_id, target_type, target_id, position, lane, named_handle, outcome, reexamines_item_id${sql.join(names, sql``)})
    values (${input.intakeId}::uuid, ${orNull(input.caseId, "uuid")}, ${input.targetType ?? "post"}::moderation_target, ${input.targetId}::uuid, ${input.position ?? 1}, ${input.lane ?? 2},
            ${orNull(input.namedHandle, "text")}, ${orNull(input.outcome, "item_outcome")}, ${orNull(input.reexaminesItemId, "uuid")}${sql.join(values, sql``)})
    returning *`);
  return row!;
}

/** A case's derived columns. */
export interface CaseRow {
