```ts
  test("post_media gains its own moderation state, the time a hold retains it until and an erasure time", () => {
    const state = column("post_media", "moderation_state");
    expect(state?.getSQLType()).toBe("media_moderation_state");
    expect(state?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(state?.default).toBe("visible");
    // Only an image is ever sealed.
    expect(schema.mediaModerationState.enumValues).toEqual(["visible", "withheld", "removed", "sealed"]);
    for (const name of ["hold_until", "erased_at"]) {
      expect(column("post_media", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe("timestamp with time zone");
      expect(column("post_media", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(false);
      expect(column("post_media", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("media_holds keeps a case's hold on an image row and goes with the row", () => {
    expect(shape("media_holds")).toEqual([
      ["id", "bigint", true],
      ["media_id", "uuid", true],
      ["case_id", "uuid", true],
      ["held_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["until", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["released_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    expect(column("media_holds", "id")?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    expect(foreignKeys("media_holds")).toEqual({
      media_id: { table: "post_media", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      case_id: { table: "cases", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
    });
    expect(predicate(index("media_holds", "media_holds_media_idx"))).toBe("released_at is null");
    expect(predicate(index("media_holds", "media_holds_case_idx"))).toBe("released_at is null");
  });

  test("staff texts and snapshots are held to their digests and erasable; the access log numbers its rows", () => {
    expect(checks("staff_texts")).toEqual(["staff_texts_digest", "staff_texts_text_len"]);
    expect(uniques("staff_texts")).toEqual([["staff_texts_digest_unique", ["digest"]]]);
    expect(predicate(index("staff_texts", "staff_texts_open_idx"))).toBe("confirmed_at is null and erased_at is null");
    expect(checks("evidence_snapshots")).toEqual(["evidence_erased"]);
    expect(column("evidence_snapshots", "media")?.getSQLType()).toBe("jsonb");
    expect(column("evidence_snapshots", "post_state")?.getSQLType()).toBe("post_state");
    expect(indexColumns(index("evidence_snapshots", "evidence_snapshots_target_idx"))).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(index("evidence_snapshots", "evidence_snapshots_unerased_idx"))).toBe("erased_at is null");
    expect(column("case_access_log", "id")?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    expect(predicate(index("case_access_log", "case_access_log_reveals_idx"))).toBe("kind = 'identity_revealed'");
    expect(checks("moderation_limits")).toEqual(["moderation_limits_single_row"]);
  });

  test("the four new auth tables live in the auth schema, each with row level security and one policy", () => {
    for (const name of AUTH_TABLES) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name);
      expect(cfg, name).toBeDefined();
      expect(cfg!.schema, name).toBe("auth");
      expect(cfg!.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const name of ["notifier_contacts", "notifier_confirmations", "notifier_suppressions"]) {
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual([[`${name}_auth_all`, "all", authRole]]);
    }
    // The auth role holds nothing on the staff links (migration 0015 revokes all); its one policy lets it see no row.
    const none = byName.get("staff_personal_accounts")!.policies;
    expect(none.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to])).toEqual([["staff_personal_accounts_auth_none", "select", authRole]]);
    expect(new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(none[0]!.using!).sql).toBe("false");
  });

  test("a notifier's contact is kept encrypted, with a keyed hash of the address and the day it is forgotten", () => {
    expect(shape("notifier_contacts")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["name_enc", "text", false],
      ["email_enc", "text", false],
      ["email_hash", "text", false],
      ["mail_token_enc", "text", false],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["forget_after", "timestamp with time zone", true],
    ]);
    // The moderation module chooses the id: the public intake row names it before the contact is stored.
    expect(column("notifier_contacts", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(column("notifier_contacts", "id")?.hasDefault).toBe(false);
    expect(shape("notifier_confirmations")).toEqual([
      ["email_hash", "text", true],
      ["confirmed_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("notifier_confirmations", "email_hash")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(shape("notifier_suppressions")).toEqual([
      ["email_hash", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("notifier_suppressions", "email_hash")?.primary).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a staff link pairs a staff account with a personal account that is not the same one, and stops either from being deleted", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_personal_accounts")).toEqual([
      ["staff_user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["personal_user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["linked_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
    ]);
    expect(byName.get("staff_personal_accounts")!.primaryKeys.map((k) => k.columns.map((c) => c.name))).toEqual([["staff_user_id", "personal_user_id"]]);
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_personal_accounts")).toEqual({
      staff_user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      personal_user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
    });
    expect(checks("staff_personal_accounts")).toEqual(["staff_personal_accounts_differ"]);
  });
});

describe("the contact point and the alert channel 3f", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const checkSql = (table: string, name: string) => new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(byName.get(table)!.checks.find((c) => c.name === name)!.value).sql;
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);
  const uniques = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name)]);
  const indexes = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name), i.config.where ? new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(i.config.where).sql : null])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
  const TABLES = ["contact_messages", "alert_outbox", "notify_state", "notify_folders"];

  test("the four tables are public, with row level security and one allow-all policy for each role granted anything on them", () => {
    for (const name of TABLES) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name);
      expect(cfg, name).toBeDefined();
      expect(cfg!.schema, name).toBeUndefined();
      expect(cfg!.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual([
        [`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole],
        [`${name}_notify_all`, "all", notifyRole],
      ]);
    }
    expect(notifyRole.name).toBe("korbat_notify");
  });

  test("a message at the contact point holds no sender, no subject and no content: its folder, its two numbers and its times", () => {
    expect(shape("contact_messages")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["folder", "text", true],
      ["uidvalidity", "bigint", true],
      ["uid", "bigint", true],
      ["received_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["seen_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["stale", "boolean", true],
      ["disposition", "text", false],
      ["handled_by", "uuid", false],
      ["handled_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    expect(column("contact_messages", "id")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    expect(uniques("contact_messages")).toEqual([["contact_messages_uid_key", ["folder", "uidvalidity", "uid"]]]);
    expect(checks("contact_messages")).toEqual(["contact_messages_disposition", "contact_messages_folder", "contact_messages_handled"]);
    expect(checkSql("contact_messages", "contact_messages_folder")).toBe(`"contact_messages"."folder" in ('inbox', 'junk')`);
    expect(checkSql("contact_messages", "contact_messages_disposition")).toBe(
      `"contact_messages"."disposition" in ('order', 'referral', 'first_order_notice', 'preservation_request', 'scrutiny_decision', 'clarification', 'not_an_order')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("contact_messages", "contact_messages_handled")).toBe(`("contact_messages"."disposition" is null) = ("contact_messages"."handled_at" is null)`);
    const fk = byName.get("contact_messages")!.foreignKeys.map((k) => [k.reference().columns.map((c) => c.name), getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, k.onDelete]);
    expect(fk).toEqual([[["handled_by"], "profiles", "restrict"]]);
    expect(indexes("contact_messages")).toEqual([
      ["contact_messages_open_idx", ["received_at"], "disposition is null"],
      ["contact_messages_received_idx", ["received_at", "id"], null],
    ]);
    for (const c of byName.get("contact_messages")!.columns) expect(c.name).not.toMatch(/sender|subject|from|email|address|body/i);
  });

  test("an alert's row: its kind, priority, scope and step, its facts, its subject without a key, and its two legs", () => {
    expect(shape("alert_outbox")).toEqual([
      ["id", "bigint", true],
      ["kind", "text", true],
      ["priority", "smallint", true],
      ["scope", "text", true],
      ["step", "smallint", false],
      ["facts", "jsonb", true],
      ["message_id", "uuid", false],
      ["order_id", "uuid", false],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["pushed_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["mailed_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["push_attempts", "integer", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("alert_outbox", "id")?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    // No foreign keys: a record's erasure never waits for an alert's row.
    expect(byName.get("alert_outbox")!.foreignKeys).toEqual([]);
    expect(checks("alert_outbox")).toEqual(["alert_outbox_facts", "alert_outbox_kind", "alert_outbox_priority", "alert_outbox_scope", "alert_outbox_step"]);
    expect(checkSql("alert_outbox", "alert_outbox_kind")).toContain("'contact_mail', 'contact_mail_escalated', 'order_due'");
    expect(checkSql("alert_outbox", "alert_outbox_kind")).toContain("'moderation_reveal', 'moderation_csam_lifted')");
    expect(checkSql("alert_outbox", "alert_outbox_priority")).toBe(`"alert_outbox"."priority" in (3, 5)`);
    expect(checkSql("alert_outbox", "alert_outbox_scope")).toBe(`"alert_outbox"."scope" in ('on_call', 'all')`);
    // Counts and times only: an object of at most six members, each a number or an instant in UTC.
    const facts = checkSql("alert_outbox", "alert_outbox_facts");
    expect(facts).toContain(`jsonb_typeof("alert_outbox"."facts") = 'object'`);
    expect(facts).toContain("<= 6");
    expect(facts).toContain("like_regex");
    // The step key is made by hand in the migration (drizzle cannot write NULLS NOT DISTINCT on a partial index).
    expect(indexes("alert_outbox")).toEqual([
      ["alert_outbox_mail_idx", ["created_at"], "mailed_at is null"],
      ["alert_outbox_push_idx", ["created_at"], "pushed_at is null"],
    ]);
  });

  test("the watcher's state: one row, its error one of eight words; and one row a folder", () => {
    expect(shape("notify_state")).toEqual([
      ["id", "smallint", true],
      ["beat_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["mailbox_ok_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["push_ok_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["error", "text", false],
    ]);
    expect(checks("notify_state")).toEqual(["notify_state_error", "notify_state_single_row"]);
    expect(checkSql("notify_state", "notify_state_error")).toBe(
      `"notify_state"."error" in ('imap_connect', 'imap_timeout', 'imap_tls', 'imap_login', 'imap_folder', 'imap_protocol', 'push_connect', 'push_refused')`,
    );
    expect(shape("notify_folders")).toEqual([
      ["folder", "text", true],
      ["uidvalidity", "bigint", false],
      ["last_uid", "bigint", false],
    ]);
    expect(column("notify_folders", "folder")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(checks("notify_folders")).toEqual(["notify_folders_folder"]);
  });
});

describe("order records 3f", () => {

      .get(table)!
      .indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name), i.config.unique ?? false, i.config.where ? new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(i.config.where).sql : null])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));

      .get(table)!

    // An image follows its post's state in every reader: media_moderation_state gains nothing.
    expect(schema.mediaModerationState.enumValues).toEqual(["visible", "withheld", "removed", "sealed"]);
  });

  test("an order's row: the console's columns, the forced ones, the command line's; Section C without a default", () => {
```

```tsx
  SCRUTINY_OUTCOME_LABELS,
  STATE_FACTS,
  type ContactMessage,
  type MemberState,
  type OrderConsoleEvent,
  type OrderCorrectFacts,
  type OrderEventRecordedParams,
  type OrderItemCloseReason,
  type OrderItemView,
  type OrderView,
  type StaffMe,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { describeError, ORDER_WORDS } from "../messages";
import type { OrderId } from "../router";
import { correctOrderWithKey, recordOrderEventWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { clockLine, OrderFacts } from "./Orders";

/**
 * An order (3f design, section 8.5), in Task 2's blocks: 1 the clock, refreshed every 20 seconds; 2 the check; 3 the
 * items, with "Close this item without effect" and "Add links"; 5 what was sent and received, each confirmed by the key;
 * 6 the forms' values as text; 7 what the command line owes; 8 the author's notice; 9 the events; 10 "Correct what the
 * order shows". Block 4 ("Disable for an order") and "Extension received" are Task 3's. The authority, the reference and
 * each link are an outsider's words and drawn as such; no image and no text of a post that is not public is shown.
 */

const W = ORDER_WORDS.order;

/** Block 2: the check, worded by the order's kind, with the home state's register entries. */
export function CheckBlock({ order, me }: { order: OrderView; me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState"> }) {
  const facts = me.homeState === null ? undefined : STATE_FACTS[me.homeState as MemberState];
  const state = EU_MEMBER_STATES[order.memberState];
  if (order.kind !== "tco_removal") {
    return (
      <section className="block">
        <p>{W.registerDsa}</p>
        {!order.verified ? <p className="notice">{W.verifyFirst}</p> : null}
      </section>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <p>
        {W.register(state).before}
        <UserText>{order.authority}</UserText>
        {W.register(state).after}
      </p>
      <p className="notice">{W.doubt}</p>
      {facts !== undefined ? (
        <ul className="blocks">
          {facts.authorities.map((authority) => (
            <li key={authority.id}>{W.entry(authority.name, authority.registerEntry ?? W.stateUnknown)}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}

/** What an item resolved to and what became of it (block 3). */
function ItemFacts({ item }: { item: OrderItemView }) {
  return (
    <>
      {item.post !== null ? (
        <p>
          {W.resolved(bothTimes(item.post.createdAt), item.post.images).before}
          <UserText>{item.post.authorHandle ?? ""}</UserText>
          {W.resolved(bothTimes(item.post.createdAt), item.post.images).after}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {item.post !== null && item.post.preview !== null ? (
        <figure className="frame">
          <p>
            <UserText>{item.post.preview}</UserText>
          </p>
        </figure>
      ) : null}
      {item.linkKind === "image" ? <p className="hint">{W.image}</p> : null}
      {item.linkKind === "account" ? <p className="notice">{W.account}</p> : null}
      {item.linkKind === "other" ? <p className="notice">{W.missing}</p> : null}
      {item.post?.deletedOn ? <p>{W.deleted(item.post.deletedOn)}</p> : null}
      <p>
        {item.closedAt !== null && item.closedReason !== null
          ? W.closedItem(bothTimes(item.closedAt), ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[item.closedReason])
          : item.disabledAt !== null
            ? W.disabledAt(bothTimes(item.disabledAt))
            : W.notDisabled}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

/** One item's block, with its closing while it is open. */
function ItemBlock({
  item,
  order,
  reason,
  busy,
  onReason,
  onClose,
}: {
  item: OrderItemView;
  order: OrderView;
  reason: OrderItemCloseReason | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onReason(reason: OrderItemCloseReason): void;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const open = item.disabledAt === null && item.closedAt === null;
  return (
    <li className="block">
      <p>{W.item(item.position)}</p>
      <figure className="frame">
        <figcaption>{ORDER_WORDS.orders.frame}</figcaption>
        <p>
          <UserText>{item.link}</UserText>
        </p>
      </figure>
      <ItemFacts item={item} />
      {item.unverified && order.verified ? <p className="notice">{W.unchecked(bothTimes(item.addedAt))}</p> : null}
      {open && order.mayCorrect !== null ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>{W.closeItem}</legend>
          <ul className="choices">
            {ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS.map((value) => (
              <li key={value}>
                <label className="choice">
                  <input type="radio" name={`close-${item.id}`} checked={reason === value} disabled={busy} onChange={() => onReason(value)} />
                  {ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[value]}
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {reason === "withdrawn" ? <p className="hint">{W.withdrawnHint}</p> : null}
          <p className="hint">{W.closeItemHint}</p>
          <button type="button" disabled={busy || reason === null} onClick={onClose}>
            {W.closeItem}
          </button>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/** The words of each console event the screen offers (block 5), with what it records. */
const EVENT_WORDS: Record<Exclude<OrderConsoleEvent, "hold_extended">, { button: string; what: string }> = {
  annex3_sent: { button: W.annex3, what: W.annex3What },
  grounds_ceased: { button: W.ceased, what: W.ceasedWhat },
  clarification_received: { button: W.clarified, what: W.clarifiedWhat },
  annex2_sent: { button: W.annex2, what: W.annex2What },
  receipt_confirmed: { button: W.informed, what: W.informedWhat },
  closed_without_effect: { button: W.close, what: W.closeWhat },
  reopened: { button: W.reopen, what: W.reopenWhat },
};

/** Block 5: each event the database would take now, with its choice of ground or message, confirmed by the key. */
export function EventsBlock({
  order,
  messages,
  busy,
  onRecord,
}: {
  order: OrderView;
  messages: ContactMessage[];
  busy: boolean;
  onRecord(params: OrderEventRecordedParams): void;
}) {
  const [ground, setGround] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const offered = order.mayEvents.filter((kind): kind is Exclude<OrderConsoleEvent, "hold_extended"> => kind !== "hold_extended");
  if (offered.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.eventsTitle}</h3>
      {offered.map((kind) => {
        const grounds: readonly string[] | null = kind === "annex3_sent" ? ANNEX3_GROUNDS : kind === "closed_without_effect" ? ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS : null;
        const needsMessage = kind === "clarification_received";
        const chosen = grounds === null ? null : (ground[kind] ?? null);
        const ready = (grounds === null || chosen !== null) && (!needsMessage || message !== null);
        return (
          <fieldset key={kind}>
            <legend>{EVENT_WORDS[kind].button}</legend>
            <p className="hint">{EVENT_WORDS[kind].what}</p>
            {grounds !== null ? (
              <ul className="choices">
                {grounds.map((value) => (
                  <li key={value}>
                    <label className="choice">
                      <input type="radio" name={`ground-${kind}`} checked={chosen === value} disabled={busy} onChange={() => setGround((g) => ({ ...g, [kind]: value }))} />
                      {kind === "annex3_sent" ? ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS[value as (typeof ANNEX3_GROUNDS)[number]] : ORDER_GROUND_LABELS[value as (typeof ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS)[number]]}
                    </label>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
            {needsMessage ? (
              <ul className="choices">
                {messages.map((m) => (
                  <li key={m.id}>
                    <label className="choice">
                      <input type="radio" name="clarification-message" checked={message === m.id} disabled={busy} onChange={() => setMessage(m.id)} />
                      {`${ORDER_WORDS.contact.received(bothTimes(m.receivedAt))}, ${ORDER_WORDS.contact.folders[m.folder]}`}
                    </label>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || !ready} onClick={() => onRecord({ kind, ground: chosen as OrderEventRecordedParams["ground"], messageId: needsMessage ? message : null })}>
              {`${EVENT_WORDS[kind].button}: ${W.confirmKey}`}
            </button>
          </fieldset>
        );
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

/** A time as the forms ask for it: in UTC with its offset written out ("2026-10-10 01:00:12 +00:00"). */
export function utcWithOffset(iso: string): string {
  return `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 19)} +00:00`;
}

/** Block 6: the forms' values as text, for a removal order. */
export function FormsBlock({ order, me }: { order: OrderView; me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState" | "contactPoint"> }) {
  if (order.kind !== "tco_removal") return null;
  const copy = me.homeState === null ? null : (STATE_FACTS[me.homeState as MemberState]?.annexCopy ?? null);
  const ground = order.clock?.stopGround ?? null;
  const state = `${EU_MEMBER_STATES[order.memberState]} (${order.memberState})`;
  const lines = W.annex3Text(order.reference, order.authority, state, order.receivedAt === null ? "" : utcWithOffset(order.receivedAt), ground === null ? "" : ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS[ground]);
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.formsTitle}</h3>
      <pre className="form-values">
        <UserText>{[...lines, W.contactLine(me.contactPoint ?? W.stateUnknown), W.sendTo(copy ?? W.stateUnknown)].join(String.fromCharCode(10))}</UserText>
      </pre>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Block 7: what the command line still owes, one line each. */
export function OwedBlock({ order }: { order: OrderView }) {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const added = order.items.filter((item) => item.unverified).length;
  if (order.owed.verification) lines.push(order.verified && added > 0 ? W.owesVerifyAgain(added) : W.owesVerify);
  if (order.owed.issuedAt) lines.push(W.owesIssued);
  if (order.owed.holdUntil) lines.push(W.owesHoldUntil);
  if (order.owed.texts) lines.push(order.kind === "dsa_art9" && !order.items.some((i) => i.disabledAt !== null) ? W.owesTextsDsa : W.owesTexts);
  if (order.owed.tellPerson) lines.push(W.owesTellRule);
  if (order.owed.document) lines.push(W.owesDocument);
  if (order.owed.scrutinyUntil !== null) lines.push(ORDER_WORDS.orders.scrutinyUntil(bothTimes(order.owed.scrutinyUntil)));
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.owesTitle}</h3>
      {lines.map((line) => (
        <p key={line}>{line}</p>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Block 8: the author's notice: told, or held until when and on which rule, and released or ended. */
export function NoticeBlock({ order }: { order: OrderView }) {
  const hold = order.hold;
  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (hold === null) {
    for (const item of order.items) if (item.disabledAt !== null) lines.push(W.toldAt(bothTimes(item.disabledAt)));
  } else if (hold.open) lines.push(W.holdOpen);
  else if (hold.until !== null) lines.push(hold.basis === "regulation" ? W.holdUntil(bothTimes(hold.until), order.issuedAt === null ? "receipt" : "order", hold.extended) : W.holdAuthority(bothTimes(hold.until)));
  if (hold?.releasedAt) lines.push(W.released(bothTimes(hold.releasedAt)));
  if (hold?.endedAt && hold.endReason) lines.push(W.ended(bothTimes(hold.endedAt), HOLD_END_REASON_LABELS[hold.endReason]));
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.noticeTitle}</h3>
      {lines.map((line) => (
        <p key={line}>{line}</p>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Every ground's words, for an event's phrase. */
const GROUND_WORDS: Record<string, string> = { ...ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS, ...ORDER_GROUND_LABELS, ...HOLD_END_REASON_LABELS, ...SCRUTINY_OUTCOME_LABELS, ...ORDER_CORRECTION_RULE_WORDS };

/** One event's words (W.1), filled from the event. */
export function eventWords(order: OrderView, event: OrderView["events"][number]): string {
  const position = order.items.find((item) => item.id === event.itemId)?.position ?? 0;
  const ground = event.ground === null ? "" : (GROUND_WORDS[event.ground] ?? event.ground);
  const at = bothTimes(event.effectiveAt ?? event.at);
  return ORDER_EVENT_WORDS[event.kind]
    .replace("{ground}", ground)
    .replace("{reason}", ground)
    .replace("{rule}", ground)
    .replace("{outcome}", ground)
    .replace("{effectiveAt}", at)
    .replace("{n}", String(position))
    .replace("{until}", "");
}

/** Block 9: the events, newest first, each with who wrote it. */
export function EventsList({ order }: { order: OrderView }) {
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.eventsList}</h3>
      <ul className="blocks">
        {[...order.events].reverse().map((event) => (
          <li key={event.id}>
            <p>{`${bothTimes(event.at)}: ${eventWords(order, event)}`}</p>
            <p className="hint">
              {event.via === "console" && event.by !== null ? (
                <>
                  @<UserText>{event.by}</UserText>, console
                </>
              ) : event.via === "cli" ? (
                W.byCli
              ) : (
                W.bySystem
              )}
            </p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

/** What block 10 holds while it is filled in: every member the form took, as the order shows it now. */
interface CorrectionState {
  kind: OrderView["kind"];
  memberState: MemberState;
  authority: string;
  reference: string;
  channel: OrderView["channel"];
  sectionC: boolean;
  emergency: boolean;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
}

const correctionOf = (order: OrderView): CorrectionState => ({
  kind: order.kind,
  memberState: order.memberState,
  authority: order.authority,
  reference: order.reference,
  channel: order.channel,
  sectionC: order.sectionC,
  emergency: order.emergency,
  withholdFromAuthor: order.withholdFromAuthor,
});

/** The members that changed, and only those: the correction sends what changes and nothing else. */
export function changedFacts(order: OrderView, state: CorrectionState): OrderCorrectFacts {
  const facts: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const before = correctionOf(order);
  for (const key of Object.keys(state) as (keyof CorrectionState)[]) if (state[key] !== before[key]) facts[key] = state[key];
  // A channel is the console's only for an order opened without a message.
  if (order.messageId !== null) delete facts.channel;
  return facts as OrderCorrectFacts;
}

/**
 * Block 10, "Correct what the order shows": the controls the rule allows (mayCorrect). Under caution only "the author must
 * not be told" from no to yes; under entry and admin every member, an admin's with the key.
 */
export function CorrectBlock({ order, busy, onCorrect }: { order: OrderView; busy: boolean; onCorrect(facts: OrderCorrectFacts): void }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CorrectionState>(() => correctionOf(order));
  useEffect(() => setState(correctionOf(order)), [order]);
  if (order.mayCorrect === null) return null;
  const set = (patch: Partial<CorrectionState>) => setState((current) => ({ ...current, ...patch }));
  const facts = changedFacts(order, state);
  if (order.mayCorrect === "caution") {
    if (order.sectionC) return null;
    return (
      <section className="block">
        <h3>{W.correctTitle}</h3>
        <p className="hint">{W.correctSilence}</p>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onCorrect({ sectionC: true })}>
          {ORDER_WORDS.form.sectionCChoices.tco[0]}
        </button>
      </section>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.correctTitle}</h3>
      <p className="hint">{W.correctWhat}</p>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.kind}
        <select value={state.kind} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ kind: event.target.value as CorrectionState["kind"] })}>
          {ORDER_KINDS.map((kind) => (
            <option key={kind} value={kind}>
              {ORDER_KIND_LABELS[kind]}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.state}
        <select value={state.memberState} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ memberState: event.target.value as MemberState })}>
          {(Object.keys(EU_MEMBER_STATES) as MemberState[]).map((code) => (
            <option key={code} value={code}>
              {`${EU_MEMBER_STATES[code]} (${code})`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.authority}
        <input type="text" value={state.authority} maxLength={400} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ authority: event.target.value })} />
      </label>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.reference}
        <input type="text" value={state.reference} maxLength={400} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ reference: event.target.value })} />
      </label>
      {order.messageId === null ? (
        <label className="field">
          {ORDER_WORDS.form.channel}
          <select value={state.channel} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ channel: event.target.value as CorrectionState["channel"] })}>
            {ORDER_CHANNELS.map((channel) => (
              <option key={channel} value={channel}>
                {ORDER_CHANNEL_LABELS[channel]}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      ) : null}
      <label className="choice">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={state.sectionC} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ sectionC: event.target.checked, withholdFromAuthor: event.target.checked || state.withholdFromAuthor })} />
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.sectionCChoices.tco[0]}
      </label>
      {state.sectionC && !order.sectionC ? <p className="hint">{W.correctSilence}</p> : null}
      {!state.sectionC && order.sectionC ? <p className="hint">{W.correctUnsilence}</p> : null}
      <label className="choice">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={state.emergency} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ emergency: event.target.checked })} />
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.emergency}
      </label>
      {state.kind === "dsa_art9" ? (
        <label className="choice">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={state.withholdFromAuthor || state.sectionC} disabled={busy || state.sectionC} onChange={(event) => set({ withholdFromAuthor: event.target.checked })} />
          {ORDER_WORDS.form.withhold}
        </label>
      ) : null}
      <button type="button" disabled={busy || Object.keys(facts).length === 0} onClick={() => onCorrect(facts)}>
        {order.mayCorrect === "admin" ? `${W.correctButton}: ${W.confirmKey}` : W.correctButton}
      </button>
    </section>
  );
}

export interface OrderPageProps {
  order: OrderView;
  me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState" | "contactPoint">;
  now: number;
  messages: ContactMessage[];
  busy: boolean;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  /** The reason chosen to close each open item. */
  reasons: Readonly<Record<string, OrderItemCloseReason>>;
  links: string;
  onReason(itemId: string, reason: OrderItemCloseReason): void;
  onCloseItem(itemId: string): void;
  onLinks(text: string): void;
  onAddLinks(): void;
  onRecord(params: OrderEventRecordedParams): void;
  onCorrect(facts: OrderCorrectFacts): void;
}

/** The order's page, blocks in order; at 360 px the first screenful holds the clock. */
export function OrderPage(props: OrderPageProps) {
  const { order, me, now, messages, busy, notice, error, reasons, links } = props;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="order-title">
      <h2 id="order-title">{ORDER_KIND_LABELS[order.kind]}</h2>
      <p className={order.state === "overdue" || order.state === "unknown_deadline" ? "error" : "notice"}>{clockLine({ ...order, items: order.items.length }, now)}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <OrderFacts order={order} />
      <CheckBlock order={order} me={me} />
      <section className="block">
        <h3>{W.itemsTitle}</h3>
        <ul className="blocks items">
          {order.items.map((item) => (
            <ItemBlock
              key={item.id}
              item={item}
              order={order}
              reason={reasons[item.id] ?? null}
              busy={busy}
              onReason={(reason) => props.onReason(item.id, reason)}
              onClose={() => props.onCloseItem(item.id)}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
        {order.closedAt === null && order.kind !== "dsa_art10" ? (
          <label className="field">
            {W.addLinks}
            <textarea value={links} rows={3} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => props.onLinks(event.target.value)} />
            <span className="hint">{W.added}</span>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || links.trim() === ""} onClick={props.onAddLinks}>
              {W.addLinks}
            </button>
          </label>
        ) : null}
      </section>
      <EventsBlock order={order} messages={messages} busy={busy} onRecord={props.onRecord} />
      <FormsBlock order={order} me={me} />
      <OwedBlock order={order} />
      <NoticeBlock order={order} />
      <EventsList order={order} />
      <CorrectBlock order={order} busy={busy} onCorrect={props.onCorrect} />
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * The order's screen: read on opening and every 20 seconds without the mark; each action reads it again from its answer.
 * An event is confirmed by the key; a correction too under the rule admin, and without one under entry and caution.
 */
export function Order({ id, api, me, credentials, opened }: { id: OrderId; api: StaffApi; me: StaffMe; credentials: CredentialsLike; opened: { unsure: boolean } | null }) {
  const [order, setOrder] = useState<Loadable<OrderView>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ContactMessage[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(opened === null ? null : opened.unsure ? `${ORDER_WORDS.form.done} ${ORDER_WORDS.form.unsure}` : ORDER_WORDS.form.done);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reasons, setReasons] = useState<Record<string, OrderItemCloseReason>>({});
  const [links, setLinks] = useState("");
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    const read = async (activity: boolean) => {
      try {
        const value = await api.order(id, { activity });
        if (alive.current) {
          setOrder({ state: "ready", value });
          setNow(Date.now());
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (alive.current) setOrder({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
      }
    };
    void read(true);
    void api.contact(null, false, { activity: true }).then(
      (page) => alive.current && setMessages(page.items),
      () => undefined,
    );
    const timer = setInterval(() => void read(false), 20_000);
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [api, id]);

  /** Runs an action, then shows the order as its answer stands. */
  const act = async (run: () => Promise<OrderView>, done: string | null) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const value = await run();
      if (alive.current) {
        setOrder({ state: "ready", value });
        setNow(Date.now());
        if (done !== null) setNotice(done);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const deps = { api, credentials };
  const correct = (value: OrderView, facts: OrderCorrectFacts) =>
    act(() => (value.mayCorrect === "admin" ? correctOrderWithKey(deps, id, facts) : api.correctOrder(id, { facts }, { activity: true })), W.corrected);

  return (
    <Loaded
      value={order}
      render={(value) => (
        <OrderPage
          order={value}
          me={me}
          now={now}
          messages={messages}
          busy={busy}
          notice={notice}
          error={error}
          reasons={reasons}
          links={links}
          onReason={(itemId, reason) => setReasons((current) => ({ ...current, [itemId]: reason }))}
          onCloseItem={(itemId) => {
            const reason = reasons[itemId];
            if (reason !== undefined) void correct(value, { closeItems: [{ itemId, reason }] });
          }}
          onLinks={setLinks}
          onAddLinks={() => {
            const list = links.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map((line) => line.trim()).filter((line) => line !== "");
            void act(() => api.addOrderItems(id, { links: list }, { activity: true }), null).then(() => setLinks(""));
          }}
          onRecord={(params) => void act(() => recordOrderEventWithKey(deps, id, params), null)}
          onCorrect={(facts) => void correct(value, facts)}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {
  ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS,
  EU_MEMBER_STATES,
  ORDER_CHANNELS,
  ORDER_CHANNEL_LABELS,
  ORDER_GROUND_LABELS,
  ORDER_KINDS,
  ORDER_KIND_LABELS,
  ORDER_RULES,
  OrderOpenRequest,
  STATE_FACTS,
  type ContactMessage,
  type MemberState,
  type OrderChannel,
  type OrderKind,
  type OrderSummary,
  type OrderView,
  type OrdersPage,
  type StaffMe,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ApiError, type StaffApi } from "../api";
import { describeError, ORDER_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { OrderLink } from "../nav";
import { parseOrderId, type OrderId } from "../router";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";

/**
 * Orders (3f design, section 8.4): the orders that are not closed, the nearest deadline first, then those closed in the
 * last 30 days, each a block with its kind, the issuing state, the authority and the reference in their frame (an
 * outsider's words, drawn as such), one clock line and a link to its page; and the form "Open an order", which restricts
 * nothing, copies nothing and tells no author, so it needs no key. The list reads again every 20 seconds without the mark.
 */

const W = ORDER_WORDS;
const MIN = 60_000;

/** Whole minutes from now to an instant, never below zero. */
const minutesTo = (iso: string, now: number) => Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(iso) - now) / MIN));

/** An order's clock line (8.4's table), from its summary alone. */
export function clockLine(order: OrderSummary, now: number): string {
  if (order.closedAt !== null) return order.closeGround === null ? W.clock.closed(bothTimes(order.closedAt)) : W.clock.closedGround(bothTimes(order.closedAt), ORDER_GROUND_LABELS[order.closeGround]);
  const clock = order.clock;
  if (order.kind !== "tco_removal" || clock === null) return order.dueAt === null ? W.clock.dsaNone : W.clock.dsaDue(bothTimes(order.dueAt));
  if (order.state === "given_effect" && clock.lastEffectAt !== null) {
    const elapsed = clock.clockStart === null ? 0 : Math.round((Date.parse(clock.lastEffectAt) - Date.parse(clock.clockStart)) / MIN);
    // An effect given while the clock was stopped is inside its hour; the view says so with within_hour true and no deadline.
    const whileStopped = clock.withinHour === true && clock.clockStart !== null && Date.parse(clock.lastEffectAt) > Date.parse(clock.clockStart) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * MIN;
    return W.clock.effect(bothTimes(clock.lastEffectAt), elapsed, clock.withinHour, whileStopped);
  }
  if (clock.stopped) return W.clock.stopped(clock.stoppedAt === null ? "" : bothTimes(clock.stoppedAt), clock.stopGround === null ? "" : ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS[clock.stopGround]);
  if (clock.clockStart === null || clock.deadlineAt === null) return W.orders.deadlineUnknown;
  const done = order.items - clock.itemsOpen;
  if (Date.parse(clock.deadlineAt) < now) return W.clock.overdue(bothTimes(clock.deadlineAt), clock.itemsOpen, order.items);
  if (clock.firstEffectAt !== null && clock.itemsOpen > 0) return W.clock.partial(done, order.items, bothTimes(clock.firstEffectAt), clock.itemsOpen, bothTimes(clock.deadlineAt));
  return W.clock.running(bothTimes(clock.deadlineAt), minutesTo(clock.deadlineAt, now), clock.targetAt === null ? "" : bothTimes(clock.targetAt));
}

/** The authority and the reference, in the frame of an outsider's words, with the kind and the issuing state. */
export function OrderFacts({ order }: { order: Pick<OrderSummary, "kind" | "memberState" | "authority" | "reference"> }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p>{ORDER_KIND_LABELS[order.kind]}</p>
      <p>{W.orders.state(`${EU_MEMBER_STATES[order.memberState]} (${order.memberState})`)}</p>
      <figure className="frame">
        <figcaption>{W.orders.frame}</figcaption>
        <p>
          <UserText>{order.authority}</UserText>
        </p>
        <p>
          <UserText>{order.reference}</UserText>
        </p>
      </figure>
    </>
  );
}

/** One order's block on the list. */
function OrderBlock({ order, now, onOpenOrder }: { order: OrderSummary; now: number; onOpenOrder(id: OrderId): void }) {
  const id = parseOrderId(order.id);
  return (
    <li className="block">
      <OrderFacts order={order} />
      <p className={order.state === "overdue" || order.state === "unknown_deadline" ? "error" : undefined}>{clockLine(order, now)}</p>
      {id !== null ? (
        <OrderLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenOrder}>
          {W.orders.openLink}
        </OrderLink>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/** The list (8.4): the open orders, then those closed in the last 30 days. */
export function OrdersList({ page, now, onOpenOrder }: { page: OrdersPage; now: number; onOpenOrder(id: OrderId): void }) {
  return (
    <>
      {page.open.length === 0 && page.closed.length === 0 ? <p>{W.orders.empty}</p> : null}
      {page.open.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="blocks orders">
          {page.open.map((order) => (
            <OrderBlock key={order.id} order={order} now={now} onOpenOrder={onOpenOrder} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {page.closed.length > 0 ? (
        <>
          <h3>{W.orders.closedTitle}</h3>
          <ul className="blocks orders">
            {page.closed.map((order) => (
              <OrderBlock key={order.id} order={order} now={now} onOpenOrder={onOpenOrder} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** The form's three answers to "Must the author not be told?": none is preselected, and "I cannot tell" holds like a tick. */
type SectionCChoice = "yes" | "no" | "unsure";

/** What the form holds while it is filled in. */
export interface OrderFormState {
  /** A message's id, "none" for "The message is not listed", or null while nothing is picked. */
  message: string | null;
  channel: OrderChannel | null;
  kind: OrderKind | null;
  memberState: MemberState | null;
  /** An authority's id from the state's facts, "other", or null. */
  authorityChoice: string | null;
  otherAuthority: string;
  reference: string;
  links: string;
  sectionC: SectionCChoice | null;
  emergency: boolean;
  withhold: boolean;
}

export const emptyOrderForm = (message: string | null = null): OrderFormState => ({
  message,
  channel: null,
  kind: null,
  memberState: null,
  authorityChoice: null,
  otherAuthority: "",
  reference: "",
  links: "",
  sectionC: null,
  emergency: false,
  withhold: false,
});

/** The member states, the home state first, then by name. */
function statesInOrder(home: MemberState | null): MemberState[] {
  const all = (Object.keys(EU_MEMBER_STATES) as MemberState[]).sort((a, b) => EU_MEMBER_STATES[a].localeCompare(EU_MEMBER_STATES[b]));
  return home === null ? all : [home, ...all.filter((code) => code !== home)];
}

/**
 * The request the form sends, or the reason it is not sent: Section C untouched is never sent, and the request is held
 * to the contracts' schema, which refuses a held notice on a post its author sees.
 */
export function orderRequest(form: OrderFormState): { ok: true; request: OrderOpenRequest } | { ok: false; problem: string } {
  if (form.sectionC === null) return { ok: false, problem: W.form.untouched };
  const facts = form.memberState === null ? undefined : STATE_FACTS[form.memberState];
  const authority = form.authorityChoice === "other" ? form.otherAuthority : (facts?.authorities.find((a) => a.id === form.authorityChoice)?.name ?? "");
  const sectionC = form.sectionC !== "no";
  const kind = form.kind;
  const withhold = kind === "tco_removal" || sectionC || (kind === "dsa_art9" && form.withhold);
  const parsed = OrderOpenRequest.safeParse({
    messageId: form.message === null || form.message === "none" ? null : form.message,
    channel: form.message !== null && form.message !== "none" ? "mailbox" : form.channel,
    kind,
    memberState: form.memberState,
    authority,
    reference: form.reference,
    links: kind === "dsa_art10" ? [] : form.links.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map((line) => line.trim()).filter((line) => line !== ""),
    sectionC,
    emergency: kind === "tco_removal" && form.emergency,
    withholdFromAuthor: withhold,
  });
  if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, problem: describeError(new ApiError(0, "invalid_request")) };
  return { ok: true, request: parsed.data };
}

export interface OrderFormProps {
  me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState">;
  form: OrderFormState;

}
```
