.lanes,
.reveals,
.today,
.history,
.seal-list {
  padding-left: 1.25rem;
}

.plain {

}

.item,
.decision,
.snapshot {
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
}

/* A banner stands above the evidence and is read before it. */
.banner {

}

 * the border keeps the two apart.
 */
.frame {
  margin: 0.5rem 0;

}

.frame-label {

}

}

.placeholder {

/* The decision composer: its choices, the rule beside its examples, and the statement its author will receive. */
.composer {

With no reply the suspension starts by itself, ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent the mail, on your signature: nobody acts at the start. korbat cannot see whether the mail reached the person; the app always shows the notice.`,

    /** [suspend.rule] */

  /** 8.3: a termination, announced or at once. */
  terminate: {
    announceLabel: "Announce a termination",
    atOnceLabel: "Terminate at once",

Nothing is deleted while its appeal or its reply, on time or late, is unanswered. Then korbat deletes it, and keeps nothing to recognise a new account of the person by; images that korbat sealed stay for the authorities.",
    /** [terminate.notYet] */
    notYet: `Not open: an announced termination needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderDays.length} suspensions under the ladder decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days, whatever their length, and ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes of which one is newer than the last of them.`,
    /** [terminate.noRepeat] */
    noRepeat: `Not open: a termination at once needs a second direct threat after a suspension for the first. "day" : "days"}, from the moment you confirm; the warning was its notice, and the restriction ends with it if the warning is lifted. At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days. The person who sent it sees the mark on their own list of reports once this answer is released to them, and can ask for a re-examination.`,

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
  // 3f (design, section 8.9): a message at the contact point that someone else closed meanwhile; and the refusals of
  // Task 2's order routes.
  "message_handled",
  "order_needs_message",
  "order_exists",
  "order_closed",
  "order_event_refused",
  "already_released",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** 3f [open.duplicate]: an order of this state, authority and reference is recorded already (order_exists). */
const OPEN_DUPLICATE =
  "An order of this authority with this reference is already recorded. If that record is wrong, correct it on its screen; if it is closed, an admin reopens it there. Do not open the order a second time under a changed reference.";

/** The console's words for each of them. A recusal reads the same whether the conflict concerns the author or a reporter. */
export const MODERATION_MESSAGES: Record<ConsoleModerationCode, string> = {
  notice_link_invalid: "That link does not name a post or a profile on korbat.",
  notice_link_offsite: "That link leads to another site. A case is opened only on a post or a profile of this korbat.",
  case_changed: "The case changed since this page read it. Read it again, check it and decide again.",
  case_closed: "The case changed at that moment. Try again.",
  staff_recused:
    "You cannot open or decide this case: an account linked to you takes part in it, or follows, blocks, mutes or replied to someone who does, or the post replies to or quotes a post of an account linked to you. Another staff member must handle it.",
  staff_target: "A final decision cannot restrict a staff account: staff are disciplined by demotion. A measure taken while deciding can.",
  admin_required: "Only an admin can take this decision.",
  reviewer_conflict: "You cannot review this appeal: you made a decision in its case, or opened a finding in it. Another staff member must review it.",
  decision_cap: "You have reached the limit on decisions one staff account may confirm for now. Try again later.",
  profile_changed: "The profile changed since the snapshot was taken. Take a fresh snapshot and decide again.",
  snapshot_mismatch: "The snapshot is not the one this case holds. Read the case again.",
  snapshot_erased: "That snapshot was erased under korbat's retention rules. Take a fresh snapshot and decide again.",
  text_invalid: "This text cannot be saved as it is: it is longer than 5000 characters, or holds a control character or an invisible direction or spacing character.",
  text_quotes_user: "This text quotes what someone wrote about this case. Describe it in your own words, never copy it.",
  text_not_found: "A text of this action is not saved any more, or was used already. Save it again.",
  invalid_decision: "This decision cannot stand as it is.",
  image_refused: "That image is not shown.",
  reveal_refused: "Nobody can be revealed for this item: it names no sender, or its sender's name is no longer kept.",
  strike_mismatch: "The strike rule changed for this post since this page read it. Read the case again and decide again.",
  standing_conflict: STANDING_CONFLICT,
  ground_not_established: STANDING_TERMINATE_R2,
  reply_not_open: "This measure takes no reply: it has ended or was lifted.",
  reporting_restricted: "That account's reports under the rules are restricted.",
  message_handled: "That message was already handled. Read Contact point again.",
  order_needs_message: 'Pick the message this came in and try again. For a new order whose message is not in the list, choose "The message is not listed".',
  order_exists: OPEN_DUPLICATE,
  order_closed: "This order is closed. Nothing more is recorded on it from here; an admin can reopen it.",
  order_event_refused:
    "That cannot be recorded now: the order is not in the state this page showed (for example, a second extension, or the grounds ceasing while no Annex III stands). Read the order again.",
  already_released: "The author's notice of this order was already released, or its hold was ended: an extension can no longer be recorded. Tell the operator at once.",
};

/** A small number as a word, as the design's sentences write it; a larger one in digits. */
const inWords = (n: number): string => ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"][n] ?? String(n);

/** A removal order's hour (ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes) in the words the console's sentences use. */
const HOUR_WORDS = ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes === 60 ? "one hour" : `${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes`;
/** The last choice of the form "Open an order" (Task 2), which every sentence that sends a person there names. */
const NOT_LISTED = '"The message is not listed"';

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 8.2, 8.3 and 18): the console's sentences of authorities' orders, each under the design's key
 * (`home.contact` is [home.contact]). Every number in one is printed from the answer or from ORDER_RULES, never typed, and
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by bothTimes. Later tasks of 3f add their keys here.
 */
export const ORDER_WORDS = {
  home: {
    title: "Authorities",
    /** [home.contact], in three parts: the words before the link to Contact point, the link's own words, and the rest. */
    contact: (oldestAt: string, open: number) => ({
      before: `Mail at the authorities' contact point since ${oldestAt}: ${open} ${open === 1 ? "message" : "messages"} nobody has handled. Read it in the mail host's app, then open `,

While one message's alarm is less than ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes old, further mail is listed here and raises no new alarm of its own: read every message listed, not only the first. A message that is in the mailbox and not listed here (the watcher was down, or the mail host filed it in another folder) is opened as an order all the same: Orders, "Open an order", ${NOT_LISTED}.`,
    reply: "Never answer an authority from korbat, and never open an attachment on a device that holds a staff key before you have checked the sender against the register.",
    received: (at: string) => `Received ${at}`,
    folders: { inbox: "Inbox", junk: "Junk folder" } as Record<"inbox" | "junk", string>,

    staleClosed: (n: number) => `${n} stale messages closed.`,
    loadOlder: "Load older",

/**

 */

/** The case page's own read: the day's limit on different cases, and an address that names no case. */

export const OUTCOME_WORDS: Record<ItemOutcome, string> = {

/** The four kinds of decision, as the case page and its history name them. */

/**

export const APPEAL_WORDS = {

} as const;

/** What a decision that lifted the protection of reported images did, as the home screen's list words it. */
export const PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS: Record<"unsealed" | "dismissed", string> = {
  unsealed: "Lifted a seal",
  dismissed: "Answered a report of child sexual abuse material without a seal",

/** The two kinds of decision the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_KINDS: Record<"interim" | "final", string> = {
  interim: "While deciding",
  final: "Decide the case",
};

/** The three outcomes the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_OUTCOMES: Record<"restricted" | "no_violation" | "not_evident", string> = {
  restricted: "Restrict",
  no_violation: "No breach",
  not_evident: "Illegality not evident",
};

/**
 * The composer's sentences beside its texts and its preview. The rule on personal data is the design's sentence in three
 * parts, so that each part is written once: the rule itself, and where the text goes, which differs for a decision
 * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",
  staysInRecord: "The author never receives this text: a decision without a measure tells them at most that what korbat did while deciding has ended. It stays in the case's record, for staff.",
  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}

```tsx
import type { MouseEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { caseHref, orderHref, type CaseId, type ConsolePath, type OrderId } from "./router";

/**
 * A link to one of the console's own pages. Its address is one of the constants ConsolePath lists, never built from
 * data; a plain click moves inside the page through the store, any other click (a new tab, a new window) is the
 * browser's, as on any link.
 */
export function NavLink({ to, current = false, onNavigate, children }: { to: ConsolePath; current?: boolean; onNavigate(path: ConsolePath): void; children: ReactNode }) {
  const follow = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    onNavigate(to);
  };
  return (
    <a href={to} aria-current={current ? "page" : undefined} onClick={follow}>
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

/**
 * A link to a case's page in the console. Its address is built from a CaseId, which only parseCaseId makes, and from
 * nothing else: an id an answer carries is checked before it can become an address. No link leads into the app.
 */
export function CaseLink({ id, onOpen, children }: { id: CaseId; onOpen(id: CaseId): void; children: ReactNode }) {
  const follow = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    onOpen(id);
  };
  return (
    <a href={caseHref(id)} onClick={follow}>
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

/**
 * 3f: a link to an order's page in the console, built as a case's is: from an OrderId, which only parseOrderId makes, and
 * from nothing else.
 */
export function OrderLink({ id, onOpen, children }: { id: OrderId; onOpen(id: OrderId): void; children: ReactNode }) {
  const follow = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    onOpen(id);
  };
  return (
    <a href={orderHref(id)} onClick={follow}>
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

/**
 * The console's own router (3a design, section 9; 3c design, section 8): its fixed pages, a case by its id, an enrolment
 * link, and nothing else. The address bar is the only state it reads; the store pushes and replaces history entries
 * itself, so the page needs no routing library.
 */

/** The pages the console links to by name. Such a link is only ever one of these constants, never an address built from data. */
export type ConsolePath = "/" | "/audit" | "/signin" | "/queue" | "/appeals" | "/standing" | "/contact" | "/orders";

/** A uuid in the one spelling PostgreSQL writes: the only form an id takes in an address the console builds. */
const LOWER_UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/** Whether a text is a lower-case uuid, and nothing else. */
export const isLowerUuid = (text: string): boolean => LOWER_UUID.test(text);

declare const caseIdBrand: unique symbol;
/** A case's id that parseCaseId has checked: the only thing a case's address is ever built from. */
export type CaseId = string & { readonly [caseIdBrand]: true };

/** The case's id when the text is a lower-case uuid; null for anything else, which names no case. */
export function parseCaseId(text: string): CaseId | null {
  return isLowerUuid(text) ? (text as CaseId) : null;
}

/** A case's address in the console: the one address the console builds from a value, and only from a checked id. */
export const caseHref = (id: CaseId): string => `/cases/${id}`;

declare const orderIdBrand: unique symbol;
/** 3f: an order's id that parseOrderId has checked: the only thing an order's address is ever built from. */
export type OrderId = string & { readonly [orderIdBrand]: true };

/** The order's id when the text is a lower-case uuid; null for anything else, which names no order. */
export function parseOrderId(text: string): OrderId | null {
  return isLowerUuid(text) ? (text as OrderId) : null;
}

/** An order's address in the console, built from a checked id alone, as a case's is. */
export const orderHref = (id: OrderId): string => `/orders/${id}`;

export type Route =
  | { name: "home" }
  | { name: "audit" }
  | { name: "signin" }
  | { name: "queue" }
  | { name: "appeals" }
  | { name: "standing" }
  // 3f: the authorities' contact point, the orders and one order.
  | { name: "contact" }
  | { name: "orders" }
  | { name: "order"; id: OrderId }
  | { name: "case"; id: CaseId }
  | { name: "enroll"; token: string }
  | { name: "unknown" };

/**
 * The route an address names. A trailing slash names the same page. An enrolment link's token is kept exactly as written:
 * the enrolment page checks its shape before it sends it anywhere.
 */
export function parseRoute(pathname: string): Route {
  const path = pathname.length > 1 && pathname.endsWith("/") ? pathname.slice(0, -1) : pathname;
  if (path === "/") return { name: "home" };
  if (path === "/audit") return { name: "audit" };
  if (path === "/signin") return { name: "signin" };
  if (path === "/queue") return { name: "queue" };
  if (path === "/appeals") return { name: "appeals" };
  if (path === "/standing") return { name: "standing" };
  if (path === "/contact") return { name: "contact" };
  if (path === "/orders") return { name: "orders" };
  const order = /^[/]orders[/]([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/.exec(path);
  if (order) {
    const id = parseOrderId(order[1]!);
    if (id) return { name: "order", id };
  }
  const found = /^\/cases\/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/.exec(path);
  if (found) {
    const id = parseCaseId(found[1]!);
    if (id) return { name: "case", id };
  }
  const enroll = /^\/enroll\/([^/]+)$/.exec(path);
  if (enroll) return { name: "enroll", token: enroll[1]! };
  return { name: "unknown" };
}

import { CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS, DISPOSITION_LABELS, type ContactCloseRequest, type ContactMessage, type ContactPage, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { describeError, ORDER_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { OrderLink } from "../nav";
import { parseOrderId, type OrderId } from "../router";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import { OpenOrder, type Opened } from "./Orders";

/**
 * The Contact point screen (3f design, section 8.3): the messages the watcher recorded at the authorities' contact point,
 * newest first, 50 a page with "Load older". korbat records that a message arrived and when, never who sent it or what it
 * says: a person reads each in the mail host's own app. A message nobody handled is closed here as what it turned out to
 * be, one of six words, without a key, since closing restricts nothing and tells nobody; the stale ones an outage left are
 * closed together, one request each. "Open an order from this message" opens the form of the Orders screen with the
 * message picked (Task 2), and a message opened as an order links to it. Every list is a list of
 * blocks, label above value, usable at a phone's width.
 */

type CloseWord = ContactCloseRequest["disposition"];
const W = ORDER_WORDS.contact;

/** The choices of "Close as", each with its hint: radio buttons of one group, a group a message or one for the stale ones. */
function CloseChoices({ group, chosen, disabled, onChoose }: { group: string; chosen: CloseWord | null; disabled: boolean; onChoose(word: CloseWord): void }) {
  return (
    <ul className="choices">
      {CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS.map((word) => (
        <li key={word}>
          <label className="choice">
            <input type="radio" name={group} value={word} checked={chosen === word} disabled={disabled} onChange={() => onChoose(word)} />
            {DISPOSITION_LABELS[word]}
          </label>
          <p className="hint">{W.hints[word]}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** Who handled a message and when, or that nobody has; a message opened as an order links to it. */
function Handled({ message, onOpenOrder }: { message: ContactMessage; onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void }) {
  if (message.disposition === null) return <p>{W.notHandled}</p>;
  if (message.disposition === "order") {
    const id = message.orders.length > 0 ? parseOrderId(message.orders[0]!) : null;
    return (
      <p>
        {id !== null && onOpenOrder ? (
          <OrderLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenOrder}>
            {W.handledOrder}
          </OrderLink>
        ) : (
          W.handledOrder
        )}
      </p>
    );
  }
  const label = DISPOSITION_LABELS[message.disposition];
  const at = message.handledAt === null ? "" : bothTimes(message.handledAt);
  if (message.handledBy === null) return <p>{W.handledBySystem(label, at)}</p>;
  return (
    <p>
      {W.handledBefore(label)}
      <UserText>{message.handledBy}</UserText>
      {W.handledAfter(at)}
    </p>
  );
}

export interface ContactViewProps {
  page: Loadable<{ items: ContactMessage[]; nextCursor: string | null }>;
  /** The word chosen for each message, and for the stale ones together (key "stale"). */
  choices: Readonly<Record<string, CloseWord>>;
  /** The id of the message being closed, "stale" while the stale ones are, or null. */
  busy: string | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  loadingOlder: boolean;
  onChoose(key: string, word: CloseWord): void;
  onClose(id: string): void;
  onCloseStale(): void;
  onLoadOlder(): void;
  /** 3f, Task 2: the message whose form "Open an order" is open, the form itself, and how to open it and an order. */
  formFor?: string | null;
  form?: ReactNode;
  onOpenForm?: (id: string) => void;
  onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void;
}

export function ContactView({ page, choices, busy, notice, error, loadingOlder, onChoose, onClose, onCloseStale, onLoadOlder, formFor = null, form = null, onOpenForm, onOpenOrder }: ContactViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="contact-title">
      <h2 id="contact-title">{W.title}</h2>
      <p>{W.what}</p>
      <p className="hint">{W.reply}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <Loaded
        value={page}
        render={(value) => {
          const stale = value.items.filter((m) => m.stale && m.disposition === null);
          return (
            <>
              {stale.length > 1 ? (
                <fieldset className="stale-together">
                  <legend>{W.staleTogether(stale.length)}</legend>
                  <p className="hint">{W.staleAll(stale.length)}</p>

                  <button type="button" onClick={onCloseStale} disabled={busy !== null || choices.stale === undefined} aria-busy={busy === "stale"}>
                    {W.staleButton}
                  </button>
                </fieldset>
              ) : null}
              {value.items.length === 0 ? (
                <p>{W.empty}</p>
              ) : (

                    <li key={message.id} className="block">
                      <p>{W.received(bothTimes(message.receivedAt))}</p>

                      {message.stale ? <p className="notice">{W.stale}</p> : null}
                      <Handled message={message} onOpenOrder={onOpenOrder} />
                      {message.disposition === null && onOpenForm ? (
                        formFor === message.id ? (
                          form
                        ) : (
                          <button type="button" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => onOpenForm(message.id)}>
                            {ORDER_WORDS.openFromMessage}
                          </button>
                        )
                      ) : null}
                      {message.disposition === null ? (
                        <fieldset>
                          <legend>{W.closeAs}</legend>
                          <CloseChoices group={`close-${message.id}`} chosen={choices[message.id] ?? null} disabled={busy !== null} onChoose={(word) => onChoose(message.id, word)} />
                          <p className="hint">{W.close}</p>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => onClose(message.id)} disabled={busy !== null || choices[message.id] === undefined} aria-busy={busy === message.id}>
                            {W.closeButton}
                          </button>
                        </fieldset>
                      ) : null}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
              {value.nextCursor !== null ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={onLoadOlder} disabled={loadingOlder} aria-busy={loadingOlder}>
                  {W.loadOlder}
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </>
          );
        }}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

export function Contact({ api, me, onOpened, onOpenOrder }: { api: StaffApi; me: StaffMe; onOpened(opened: Opened): void; onOpenOrder(id: OrderId): void }) {
  const [formFor, setFormFor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState<Loadable<ContactPage>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [choices, setChoices] = useState<Record<string, CloseWord>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingOlder, setLoadingOlder] = useState(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  /** The first page, read again: after a close, and when the screen opens (a person's action, so marked). */
  const readFirst = async () => {
    try {
      const value = await api.contact(null, false, { activity: true });
      if (alive.current) setPage({ state: "ready", value });
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setPage({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void readFirst();
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const close = async (id: string) => {
    const word = choices[id];
    if (word === undefined) return;
    setBusy(id);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.closeContact(id, { disposition: word }, { activity: true });
      if (alive.current) setNotice(W.closed(DISPOSITION_LABELS[word]));
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) {
        setBusy(null);
        await readFirst();
      }
    }
  };

  /** The stale messages of the page, closed one request each with the word chosen for them all, then the page read again. */
  const closeStale = async () => {
    const word = choices.stale;
    if (word === undefined || page.state !== "ready") return;
    const stale = page.value.items.filter((m) => m.stale && m.disposition === null);
    setBusy("stale");
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    let closed = 0;
    try {
      for (const message of stale) {
        await api.closeContact(message.id, { disposition: word }, { activity: true });
        closed++;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) {
        if (closed > 0) setNotice(W.staleClosed(closed));
        setBusy(null);
        await readFirst();
      }
    }
  };

  const loadOlder = async () => {
    if (page.state !== "ready" || page.value.nextCursor === null) return;
    setLoadingOlder(true);
    try {
      const older = await api.contact(page.value.nextCursor, false, { activity: true });
      if (alive.current) setPage({ state: "ready", value: { items: [...page.value.items, ...older.items], nextCursor: older.nextCursor } });
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingOlder(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <ContactView
      page={page}
      choices={choices}
      busy={busy}
      notice={notice}
      error={error}
      loadingOlder={loadingOlder}
      onChoose={(key, word) => setChoices((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: word }))}
      onClose={(id) => void close(id)}
      onCloseStale={() => void closeStale()}
      onLoadOlder={() => void loadOlder()}
      formFor={formFor}
      form={formFor === null ? null : <OpenOrder key={formFor} api={api} me={me} message={formFor} onOpened={onOpened} onOpenOrder={onOpenOrder} />}
      onOpenForm={setFormFor}
      onOpenOrder={onOpenOrder}
    />
  );
}

import { OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX, type AuditEntry, type StaffKey, type StaffMe, type StaffOverview, type StaffSession } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, describeError, ORDER_WORDS, PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink, NavLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId, type ConsolePath } from "../router";
import { readSignInsAtOpening } from "../signins";
import { revokeSessionWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { bothTimes, clockTime, dateTime, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { counted, LANE_NAMES, waited } from "../words";

/**
 * One of the home screen's lists of the path for child sexual abuse material: each row with its time, its staff handle
 * as text, a link to its case built from a checked id, and the console's own words for what the row is. A list holds at
 * most OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX rows, and says how many there are when there are more.
 */
function StaffList<T extends { at: string; handle: string; caseId: string }>({ title, hint, empty, list, words, onOpenCase }: { title: string; hint: string; empty: string; list: { total: number; items: T[] }; words(item: T): ReactNode; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  return (
    <>
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      <p className="hint">{hint}</p>
      {list.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p>{empty}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="reveals">
          {list.items.map((item, index) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(item.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${item.at} ${item.caseId} ${index}`}>
                <time dateTime={item.at}>{dateTime(item.at)}</time> <UserText>{item.handle}</UserText>{" "}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}{" "}
                {words(item)}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {list.total > list.items.length ? <p>{`Showing the newest ${OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX} of ${list.total}.`}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The runbook's sentence for a count of decisions not released, in the words of the runbook's own bullet (3c design,
 * section 13, Task 12(a)). It is a constant of its own so that the test of the README's runbook can hold the two to the
 * same words: what the home screen tells staff is what the runbook tells the operator.
 */
export const RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK =
  "A count of decisions not released means the daily release keeps failing: notifiers are not told and re-examination windows do not open, so read the API log for moderation-dispatch and fix it the same day.";

/** The home screen's line when decided items wait for the daily release longer than it ever takes: the count, then the runbook's sentence for it. */
export const releaseOverdue = (n: number): string => `Decisions not released after 26 hours: ${n}. ${RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`;

/**
 * The runbook's sentence for a count of late erasures, in the words of the runbook's own bullet (3c design, section 13,
 * Task 12(a)), a constant of its own for the same reason as the one above.
 */
export const ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK =
  "A count of late erasures names the due rule whose step keeps failing, so evidence, an intake record or a notifier's name and address outlives its published period: read the API log for moderation-retention and for auth janitor: purge failed, and check that API_MODERATION_RETENTION was not left off after a restore (the API logs it at every start).";

/** What each count of late erasures counts, in the order the retention job's steps run; the two last are the image rows and the auth janitor's. */
export const ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS: Record<keyof StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"], string> = {
  drafts: "unconfirmed drafts",
  caseEvidence: "closed cases whose evidence is due",
  intakeRecords: "records of reports and notices",
  redactions: "R4 erasures",
  statements: "statements of deleted accounts",
  accessLog: "access log rows",
  images: "image rows nothing retains",
  contacts: "notifiers' contacts and confirmations",
};

/**
 * The home screen's line for what retention is late with by more than a day: each count above zero under its own words,
 * then the runbook's sentence. Null when nothing is late, and then the screen says nothing.
 */
export function erasureOverdue(counts: StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"]): string | null {
  const late = (Object.keys(ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS) as (keyof StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"])[]).filter((key) => counts[key] > 0).map((key) => `${ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS[key]}: ${counts[key]}`);
  return late.length === 0 ? null : `Erasures more than a day late: ${late.join("; ")}. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`;
}

/**
 * What every staff member sees of the cases (3c design, section 8): the lanes with their open cases and how long the
 * oldest has waited, the appeals waiting (with those this person may review and those nobody may review now), every reveal of a source in the last 30 days with its staff handle and its
 * case, the decisions that lifted the protection of reported images, the recorded choices not to seal and the seals
 * taken while deciding that are in force, what each staff account viewed and opened today, the mails that wait or were
 * given up, and the emergency switch. Counts, times, handles and case links only.
 */
/**
 * The home screen's appeals line (3c design, section 8): how many wait, how many of them the reading person may review,
 * and how many no staff account may review now.
 */
export function appealsLine(overview: Pick<StaffOverview, "appealsWaiting" | "appealsYouMayReview" | "appealsWithoutReviewer">): string {
  const { appealsWaiting: waiting, appealsYouMayReview: yours, appealsWithoutReviewer: without } = overview;
  if (waiting === 0) return "No appeal waits.";
  const parts = [waiting === 1 ? "1 appeal waits" : `${waiting} appeals wait`, `you may review ${yours === 0 ? "none" : yours}`];
  if (without > 0) parts.push(`${without} ${without === 1 ? "has" : "have"} no possible reviewer now`);
  return `${parts.join("; ")}.`;
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.8): the home screen's two lines, each shown when above zero and each a link to its list:
 * the replies waiting, with the oldest one's age, and the accounts at the ladder's number of strikes. Without a way to
 * move between pages (a test's rendering), each is plain text.
 */
function StandingLines({ overview, now, onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; now: number; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const { repliesWaiting, strikeAccounts } = overview;
  const line = (text: string, to: ConsolePath) => (onNavigate ? <NavLink to={to} onNavigate={onNavigate}>{text}</NavLink> : text);
  return (
    <>
      {repliesWaiting.count > 0 ? <p>{line(STANDING_WORDS.home.replies(repliesWaiting.count, repliesWaiting.oldestAt === null ? "" : waited(repliesWaiting.oldestAt, now)), "/queue")}</p> : null}
      {strikeAccounts > 0 ? <p>{line(STANDING_WORDS.home.strikes(strikeAccounts), "/standing")}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 3f (design, section 8.2): the block "Authorities" above the lanes, each line only while it applies, in the design's
 * order: mail at the contact point that nobody has handled, with a link to Contact point inside its sentence, and the
 * alert channel's state when it is not ok. Without a way to move between pages (a test's rendering), the link is text.
 */
export function AuthoritiesLines({ overview, now = Date.now(), onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; now?: number; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const W = ORDER_WORDS.home;
  const { contact, alerts } = overview;
  const since = alerts.since === null ? "" : bothTimes(alerts.since);
  const lines: ReactNode[] = [];
  if (contact.open > 0 && contact.oldestAt !== null) {
    const words = W.contact(bothTimes(contact.oldestAt), contact.open);
    lines.push(
      <p key="contact" className="error">
        {words.before}
        {onNavigate ? (
          <NavLink to="/contact" onNavigate={onNavigate}>
            {words.link}
          </NavLink>
        ) : (
          words.link
        )}
        {words.after}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  // Task 2: the nearest deadline of a message or of an order with an open item, ahead with its minutes left (a link to
  // Orders), or passed.
  if (contact.dueAt !== null) {
    const due = Date.parse(contact.dueAt);
    if (due > now) {
      const text = ORDER_WORDS.homeClock(bothTimes(contact.dueAt), Math.ceil((due - now) / 60_000));
      lines.push(
        <p key="clock" className="notice">
          {onNavigate ? (
            <NavLink to="/orders" onNavigate={onNavigate}>
              {text}
            </NavLink>
          ) : (
            text
          )}
        </p>,
      );
    } else {
      lines.push(
        <p key="overdue" className="error">
          {ORDER_WORDS.homeOverdue(bothTimes(contact.dueAt))}
        </p>,
      );
    }
  }
  if (alerts.channel === "down") lines.push(<p key="channel" className="error">{W.channel(since)}</p>);
  if (alerts.channel === "mailbox") lines.push(<p key="mailbox" className="error">{W.mailbox(since)}</p>);
  if (alerts.channel === "off") lines.push(<p key="off" className="notice">{W.off}</p>);
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div role="status" className="authorities">
      <h3>{W.title}</h3>
      {lines}
    </div>
  );
}

export function OverviewView({ overview, now, onOpenCase, onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; now: number; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const { reveals, mailsWaiting, mailsFailed } = overview;
  const lateErasures = erasureOverdue(overview.erasureOverdue);
  const waiting = mailsWaiting.receipts + mailsWaiting.authorMails + mailsWaiting.outcomes;
  const failed = mailsFailed.receipts + mailsFailed.authorMails + mailsFailed.outcomes;
  const mails = (m: StaffOverview["mailsWaiting"]) => `${counted(m.receipts, "receipt", "receipts")}, ${counted(m.authorMails, "statement to an author", "statements to authors")}, ${counted(m.outcomes, "outcome", "outcomes")}`;
  return (
    <>
      <AuthoritiesLines overview={overview} now={now} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      <h3>Cases</h3>
      <ul className="lanes">
        {overview.lanes.map((lane) => (
          <li key={lane.lane}>{`${LANE_NAMES[lane.lane]}: ${lane.open === 0 || lane.oldestAt === null ? "no open case" : `${counted(lane.open, "case", "cases")}, oldest ${waited(lane.oldestAt, now)}`}`}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p>{appealsLine(overview)}</p>
      {overview.appealsWaiting > 0 ? <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.reviewerRule}</p> : null}
      <StandingLines overview={overview} now={now} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      <p>{overview.deferUnproven ? "The emergency switch is on: cases whose unanswered items all come from unproven sources are listed after the others of their lane." : "The emergency switch is off."}</p>
      {overview.releaseOverdue > 0 ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {releaseOverdue(overview.releaseOverdue)}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {lateErasures !== null ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {lateErasures}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {waiting > 0 ? <p className="notice">{`Mails waiting for more than an hour: ${mails(mailsWaiting)}.`}</p> : null}
      {failed > 0 ? <p className="notice">{`Mails given up in the last 30 days: ${mails(mailsFailed)}.`}</p> : null}

      <h3>Sources revealed in the last 30 days</h3>
      <p className="hint">Every staff account's. A reveal nobody expected means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator.</p>
      {reveals.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p>No source was revealed in the last 30 days.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="reveals">
          {reveals.items.map((item, index) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(item.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${item.at} ${item.caseId} ${index}`}>
                <time dateTime={item.at}>{dateTime(item.at)}</time> <UserText>{item.handle}</UserText>{" "}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {reveals.total > reveals.items.length ? <p>{`Showing the newest ${OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX} of ${reveals.total}.`}</p> : null}

      <StaffList
        title="Protection of reported images lifted in the last 30 days"
        hint="Every staff account's: each lifted seal, and each admin's answer to a report or finding of child sexual abuse material without a seal. One nobody expected means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator."
        empty="No decision lifted the protection of reported images in the last 30 days."
        list={overview.protectionLifted}
        words={(item) => PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS[item.kind]}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />
      <StaffList
        title="Choices not to seal in the last 30 days"
        hint="Every staff account's: each recorded choice not to seal reported images, whose reason is on its case."
        empty="Nobody recorded a choice not to seal in the last 30 days."
        list={overview.sealsDeclined}
        words={() => "Chose not to seal"}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />
      <StaffList
        title="Seals taken while deciding that are in force"
        hint="Which images stand sealed until an admin answers, and by whom."
        empty="No seal taken while deciding is in force."
        list={overview.interimSeals}
        words={(item) => `${counted(item.images, "image", "images")} on ${counted(item.posts, "post", "posts")}`}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />

      <h3>Today, by staff account</h3>
      {overview.imagesToday.length === 0 && overview.findingsToday.length === 0 ? (
        <p>No image was viewed and no finding opened today.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="today">
          {overview.imagesToday.map((row) => (
            <li key={`images ${row.handle}`}>
              <UserText>{row.handle}</UserText>
              {`: ${counted(row.count, "image", "images")} viewed`}
            </li>
          ))}
          {overview.findingsToday.map((row) => (
            <li key={`findings ${row.handle}`}>
              <UserText>{row.handle}</UserText>
              {`: ${counted(row.count, "finding", "findings")} opened`}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The home screen (3a design, section 9; 3c design, section 8): who is signed in and with which role, the session's
 * absolute end, the cases' overview, every staff account's sign-ins of the last 7 days, the person's own staff sessions
 * with "Sign out that session" confirmed by the key, and the person's keys. Keys are added and revoked only with the
 * command line, so no button here touches them.
 */
export interface HomeViewProps {
  me: StaffMe;
  overview: Loadable<StaffOverview>;
  /** The time the overview's waiting times are counted to. */
  now: number;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  /** 3e: a move to one of the console's pages, which the home screen's lines of Task 4 link to. */
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
  signIns: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>;
  sessions: Loadable<StaffSession[]>;
  keys: Loadable<StaffKey[]>;
  /** The handle of the session whose revocation is under way. */
  revoking: string | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  onRevoke(handle: string): void;
}

export function HomeView({ me, overview, now, onOpenCase, onNavigate, signIns, sessions, keys, revoking, notice, error, onRevoke }: HomeViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="home-title">
      <h2 id="home-title">Home</h2>
      <p>
        Signed in as <UserText>{me.handle}</UserText>, {me.role}.
      </p>
      <p>{`Signed in until ${clockTime(me.absoluteExpiresAt)}.`}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Loaded value={overview} render={(value) => <OverviewView overview={value} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} />} />

      <h3>Staff sign-ins in the last 7 days</h3>
      <p className="hint">Every staff account's, newest first. A sign-in nobody recognises means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={signIns}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No staff sign-ins in the last 7 days.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="signins">
              {list.map((entry) => (
                <li key={entry.seq}>
                  <time dateTime={entry.createdAt}>{dateTime(entry.createdAt)}</time> <UserText>{entry.actorHandle ?? "no handle"}</UserText>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )
        }
      />

      <h3>Your staff sessions</h3>
      <p className="hint">Signing out another session asks your staff key to confirm it.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={sessions}
        render={(list) => (
          <table>
            <caption className="visually-hidden">Your staff sessions</caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Browser</th>
                <th scope="col">Started</th>
                <th scope="col">Last used</th>
                <th scope="col">
                  <span className="visually-hidden">Sign out</span>
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {list.map((session) => (
                <tr key={session.handle}>
                  <td>
                    <UserText>{session.browser}</UserText>
                  </td>
                  <td>{dateTime(session.createdAt)}</td>
                  <td>{dateTime(session.lastUsedAt)}</td>
                  <td>
                    {session.current ? (
                      "This session"
                    ) : (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => onRevoke(session.handle)} disabled={revoking !== null} aria-busy={revoking === session.handle}>
                        Sign out that session
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      />

      <h3>Your staff keys</h3>
      <p className="hint">The operator adds and revokes staff keys with the staff command line.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={keys}
        render={(list) => (
          <ul className="keys">
            {list.map((key) => (
              <li key={key.id}>
                <UserText>{key.name}</UserText>
                {`: added ${dateTime(key.createdAt)}, ${key.lastUsedAt === null ? "never used" : `last used ${dateTime(key.lastUsedAt)}`}`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Runs one read and hands its outcome to `set`, unless the screen has gone meanwhile. */
function load<T>(alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<T>) => void, read: () => Promise<T>): void {
  read().then(
    (value) => alive.current && set({ state: "ready", value }),
    (err: unknown) => alive.current && set({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
  );
}

/** The person's staff sessions, marked: the screen reads them when it opens and after a revocation the person asked for. */
function readSessions(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>) => void): void {
  load(alive, set, async () => (await api.sessions({ activity: true })).sessions);
}

/** Where the screen's lists go as each read finishes. */
export interface HomeLists {
  overview(value: Loadable<StaffOverview>): void;
  signIns(value: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>): void;
  sessions(value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>): void;
  keys(value: Loadable<StaffKey[]>): void;
}

/**
 * What the screen reads when it opens, every read marked, since opening the screen is its person's action. It takes no
 * session: the sign-ins' 7 days are counted from a /me read now (readSignInsAtOpening), never from the session the page
 * holds, which can be hours old.
 */
export function openHome(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: HomeLists): void {
  load(alive, set.signIns, () => readSignInsAtOpening(api));
  load(alive, set.overview, () => api.overview({ activity: true }));
  readSessions(api, alive, set.sessions);
  load(alive, set.keys, async () => (await api.keys({ activity: true })).keys);
}

export function Home({ me, api, credentials, onOpenCase, onNavigate }: { me: StaffMe; api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Loadable<StaffOverview>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [signIns, setSignIns] = useState<Loadable<AuditEntry[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Loadable<StaffSession[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<Loadable<StaffKey[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    openHome(api, alive, {
      overview: (value) => {
        setNow(Date.now());
        setOverview(value);
      },
      signIns: setSignIns,
      sessions: setSessions,
      keys: setKeys,
    });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen, never again when the idle timer's reads change `me`; the API client never
    // changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const revoke = async (handle: string) => {
    setRevoking(handle);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const outcome = await revokeSessionWithKey({ api, credentials }, handle);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNotice(outcome === "revoked" ? "That session is signed out." : "That session had already ended.");
      readSessions(api, alive, setSessions);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setRevoking(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <HomeView me={me} overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} signIns={signIns} sessions={sessions} keys={keys} revoking={revoking} notice={notice} error={error} onRevoke={(handle) => void revoke(handle)} />
  );
}

```ts
import {
  STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE,
  StaffStepUpOptionsRequest,
  stepUpActionHash,
  stepUpBinding,
  type AppealsReviewedParams,
  type AuthenticationResponseJSON,
  type CaseDecidedParams,
  type IdentityRevealedParams,
  type OrderCorrectFacts,
  type OrderEventRecordedParams,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ApiError, type StaffApi } from "./api";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { authenticationResponseToJSON, ceremonyFailure, fromBase64url, requestOptionsFromJSON, type CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The step-up as the console runs it (3a design, sections 7 and 9). Before it asks the key to confirm an action, the page
 * checks the options the API gave it: the challenge must be the 74 bytes of the contracts' step-up layout with the
 * staff_step_up purpose, bound to the sha256 of this session's handle and the hash of exactly the `{ action, target,
 * params }` the page chose, and the allow list must hold one key. Otherwise the key is never asked, so an API under an
 * attacker's control cannot have it sign an action the person did not choose. The check trusts the page, which Caddy
 * serves from its image, not the API.
 */

/** Options that bind something other than the action the person chose; the key was not asked. */
export class StepUpMismatch extends Error {
  readonly code = "step_up_mismatch";
  readonly status = 0;
  constructor() {
    super(messageFor("step_up_mismatch"));
    this.name = "StepUpMismatch";
  }
}

const sameBytes = (a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): boolean => a.length === b.length && a.every((byte, i) => byte === b[i]);

/**
 * Checks step-up options against this session's handle and the action the page is about to confirm, with the contracts'
 * layout, purpose code, sorted-JSON text and hash, never a copy of them. Throws StepUpMismatch on any difference.
 */
export async function checkStepUpOptions(options: { challenge: string; allowCredentials?: unknown }, sessionHandle: string, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest): Promise<void> {
  const layout = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
  let challenge: Uint8Array;
  try {
    challenge = fromBase64url(options.challenge);
  } catch {
    throw new StepUpMismatch();
  }
  if (challenge.length !== layout.bytes) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  if (challenge[layout.versionAt] !== layout.version || challenge[layout.purposeAt] !== layout.purpose) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // The binding is recomputed here from what the page chose, so a challenge bound to another action, target, params or
  // session never reaches the key.
  const expected = await stepUpBinding(sessionHandle, await stepUpActionHash(action));
  if (!sameBytes(challenge.subarray(layout.bindingAt, layout.bindingAt + layout.bindingBytes), expected)) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // Exactly one key, the session's own: an empty list would let the browser offer any key the person holds.
  if (!Array.isArray(options.allowCredentials) || options.allowCredentials.length !== 1) throw new StepUpMismatch();
}

/**
 * The action that revokes one of the person's staff sessions: its handle as the target, in lower case, the one spelling
 * the API accepts for a step-up target (it hashes the id exactly as sent), and no params.
 */
export function sessionRevokeAction(handle: string): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: handle.toLowerCase() }, params: {} });
}

/**
 * The action that reveals who sent an item: the item's id as the target and, as params, the reason's category and the
 * digest of the reason the person saved. The console builds it from what it shows, with the contracts' schema, so the
 * binding it checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function revealAction(itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "identity_revealed", target: { type: "intake_item", id: itemId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that decides a case: the case's id as the target and, as params, the decision as the composer built it from
 * what the page shows: ids, enums, whole numbers and the digests the console computed, never a text. The contracts'
 * schema refuses anything else, so the binding the console checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function decisionAction(caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: caseId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that reviews an appeal: the appealed decision's id as the target and, as params, the review as the review
 * composer built it from what the page shows: the appeal, ids, enums, whole numbers and digests, never a text.
 */
export function reviewAction(decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params });
}

/**
 * One action confirmed by the key (3c design, section 8): the session's handle read from a marked /me right before,
 * since the API binds the challenge to the session the request's cookie names, which another tab's sign-in may have
 * replaced since the page read its session; then options for exactly this action, asked right before the key (the API
 * reads a step-up challenge only while more than a minute of its ten is left), checked against what the page chose,
 * signed, and handed to `send`, which sends the action's own request with the assertion. The only place the console asks
 * a key to confirm anything: the revocation of a session, a decision, a review and a reveal all go through it. Every
 * request is marked: the person clicked.
 */
export async function confirmWithKey<T>(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, send: (stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const { sessionHandle } = await deps.api.me({ activity: true });
  const { options } = await deps.api.stepUpOptions(action, { activity: true });
  await checkStepUpOptions(options, sessionHandle, action);
  let credential: unknown;
  try {
    credential = await deps.credentials.get({ publicKey: requestOptionsFromJSON(options) });
  } catch (err) {
    throw ceremonyFailure(err);
  }
  return send(authenticationResponseToJSON(credential));
}

/** "Sign out that session", confirmed by the key. "gone" when the session had already ended. */
export async function revokeSessionWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, targetHandle: string): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> {
  const action = sessionRevokeAction(targetHandle);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, async (stepUp): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> => {
    try {
      await deps.api.revokeSession(action.target.id, { stepUp }, { activity: true });
      return "revoked";
    } catch (err) {
      // The API answers a handle that names no live session of the person's as the app does: 404.
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404 && err.code === "not_found") return "gone";
      throw err;
    }
  });
}

/**
 * "Reveal who sent this", confirmed by the key: the reveal of the item with the category and the digest of the saved
 * reason. Answers the reporter's handle or the notifier's given name; both are null when the name was forgotten.
 */
export function revealWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams) {
  const action = revealAction(itemId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.reveal(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the decision composer: the decision on the case, with exactly the params the page
 * built. Answers the case as it stands after the decision, which the page then shows.
 */
export function decideWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams) {
  const action = decisionAction(caseId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.decide(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the review composer: the review of the decision's appeal, with exactly the params the
 * page built. Answers the decision's case as it stands after the review, which must be the case the page shows.
 */
export function reviewWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams) {
  const action = reviewAction(decisionId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.review(caseId, action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3f: the action that records a clock event, a closing, a reopening or an extension on an order: the order's id as the
 * target and the event's kind, ground and message as params, as the page chose them.
 */
export function orderEventAction(orderId: string, params: OrderEventRecordedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_event_recorded", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params });
}

/** 3f: the action that corrects an order under the rule admin: the order's id and, as params, the facts to change. */
export function orderCorrectAction(orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_corrected", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params: { facts } });
}

/** "Confirm with your staff key" on an order's event; answers the order as it stands after it. */
export function recordOrderEventWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, params: OrderEventRecordedParams) {
  const action = orderEventAction(orderId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.recordOrderEvent(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** "Confirm with your staff key" on an admin's correction; answers the order as it stands after it. */
export function correctOrderWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts) {
  const action = orderCorrectAction(orderId, facts);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.correctOrder(action.target.id, { facts, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

import type { StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ApiError, type StaffApi } from "./api";
import type { CaseDraft } from "./compose";
import { createIdleTimer, type Clock, type IdleWarning } from "./idle";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { caseHref, orderHref, parseRoute, type CaseId, type ConsolePath, type OrderId, type Route } from "./router";

/**
 * The console's state across its screens (3a design, section 9): the address, the session the page holds, and the idle
 * timer's warning. Screens read it through React's useSyncExternalStore and keep their own lists to themselves.
 *
 * Any staff_session_required answer, from any request, the idle timer's reads included, means the API has already
 * cleared both staff cookies: the page then shows sign-in in place, keeping the address, and after the sign-in it shows
 * that address's page again. A GET /api/staff/me that answers 404 means the console is off on this server or was opened
 * at an address other than CONSOLE_ORIGIN (the staff gate answers both the same), and the page says only that.
 */
export type Session =
  | { kind: "checking" }
  | { kind: "signed-in"; me: StaffMe }
  /** Sign-in shows; `ended` when a staff_session_required answer told of a session that ended, which the page says. */
  | { kind: "signed-out"; ended: boolean }
  | { kind: "unavailable" }
  | { kind: "failed"; message: string };

export interface ConsoleState {
  path: string;
  route: Route;
  session: Session;
  warning: IdleWarning | null;
}

/** The part of window.history the store writes. */
export interface HistoryLike {
  pushState(data: unknown, unused: string, url: string): void;
  replaceState(data: unknown, unused: string, url: string): void;
}

export interface ConsoleStoreDeps {
  api: StaffApi;
  history: HistoryLike;
  clock: Clock;
  /** The address the page opened at. */
  path: string;
}

/**
 * The composer's draft slots, one for each case (3c design, section 8): what its person chose and typed and has not
 * confirmed yet. A session that ends shows sign-in in place of the case's page, which then starts anew; the slot is what
 * brings the draft back after a sign-in by the same handle. It lives in the page's memory only, and is dropped when
 * another handle signs in.
 */
export interface DraftSlots {
  get(caseId: CaseId): CaseDraft | null;
  set(draft: CaseDraft): void;
  clear(caseId: CaseId): void;
}

export type ConsoleStore = ReturnType<typeof createConsoleStore>;

export function createConsoleStore(deps: ConsoleStoreDeps) {
  const { api } = deps;
  let state: ConsoleState = { path: deps.path, route: parseRoute(deps.path), session: { kind: "checking" }, warning: null };
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  const set = (next: Partial<ConsoleState>) => {
    state = { ...state, ...next };
    for (const listener of listeners) listener();
  };

  const idle = createIdleTimer({
    clock: deps.clock,
    // The timer's reads carry no mark: they are the page's own, never its person's.
    readMe: () => api.me({ activity: false }),
    onWarning: (warning) => set({ warning }),
    onMe: (me) => {
      if (state.session.kind === "signed-in") set({ session: { kind: "signed-in", me } });
    },
  });

  const go = (path: string, how: "push" | "replace") => {
    if (how === "push") deps.history.pushState(null, "", path);
    else deps.history.replaceState(null, "", path);
    set({ path, route: parseRoute(path) });
  };

  const sessionEnded = (carriedStaffCookie: boolean) => {
    // The page says the session ended when it held one, or when the refused request carried the staff CSRF cookie, which
    // only a sign-in sets: a reload or a new tab after an idle-out. Without either, there was no session to end (never
    // signed in, signed out, or the cookie's 12 hours over), and the page shows plain sign-in.
    const ended = state.session.kind === "signed-in" || carriedStaffCookie || (state.session.kind === "signed-out" && state.session.ended);
    idle.stop();
    set({ session: { kind: "signed-out", ended }, warning: null });
  };

  const slots = new Map<CaseId, CaseDraft>();
  /** The handle the slots' drafts were written under. */
  let draftsOf: string | null = null;
  // Keeping a draft changes nothing a screen reads from the state, so no listener is told.
  const drafts: DraftSlots = {
    get: (caseId) => slots.get(caseId) ?? null,
    set: (draft) => void slots.set(draft.caseId, draft),
    clear: (caseId) => void slots.delete(caseId),
  };
  /**
   * Whose page this is now. Another person at this page never reads what the one before typed: the slots are emptied as
   * soon as the handle is another one, at a sign-in here and at any read of /me (a sign-in in another tab changes whose
   * session the page's cookie names).
   */
  const draftsFor = (handle: string) => {
    if (draftsOf !== null && draftsOf !== handle) slots.clear();
    draftsOf = handle;
  };

  api.hooks.onSessionRequired = sessionEnded;
  api.hooks.onActivity = () => {
    if (state.session.kind === "signed-in") idle.restart();
  };
  // Any /me read, a screen's, the step-up's and the idle timer's alike, keeps the page's session as the cookie names it
  // now, and the draft slots with it.
  api.hooks.onMe = (me) => {
    draftsFor(me.handle);
    if (state.session.kind === "signed-in") set({ session: { kind: "signed-in", me } });
  };

  const signedIn = (me: StaffMe) => {
    draftsFor(me.handle);
    set({ session: { kind: "signed-in", me }, warning: null });
    idle.start(me);
    // Sign-in in place keeps the address; only the sign-in page and an enrolment link move on, to the home page.
    if (state.route.name === "signin" || state.route.name === "enroll") go("/", "replace");
  };

  const unavailable = () => {
    idle.stop();
    set({ session: { kind: "unavailable" }, warning: null });
  };

  return {
    api,
    drafts,
    get: (): ConsoleState => state,
    subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    },

    /**
     * Opens the page: an enrolment link needs no session and reads none; every other page reads /me, marked, since
     * opening a page is its person's action.
     */
    async start(): Promise<void> {
      if (state.route.name === "enroll") {
        set({ session: { kind: "signed-out", ended: false } });
        return;
      }
      set({ session: { kind: "checking" } });
      try {
        signedIn(await api.me({ activity: true }));
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === "staff_session_required") return; // the hook showed sign-in
        if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404) return unavailable();
        set({ session: { kind: "failed", message: err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : messageFor("internal") } });
      }
    },

    /** A link inside the console: a new history entry, and the page for it. */
    navigate: (path: ConsolePath) => go(path, "push"),

    /** A link to a case: its address is built from a checked id, and from nothing else. */
    openCase: (id: CaseId) => go(caseHref(id), "push"),
    /** 3f: an order's page, by its checked id. */
    openOrder: (id: OrderId) => go(orderHref(id), "push"),

    /** The browser went back or forward. Back to the sign-in page with a live session is home. */
    popped(path: string) {
      set({ path, route: parseRoute(path) });
      if (state.session.kind === "signed-in" && state.route.name === "signin") go("/", "replace");
    },

    signedIn,

    /** The person signed out: the timer stops and the sign-in page shows, at its own address. */
    signedOut() {
      idle.stop();
      set({ session: { kind: "signed-out", ended: false }, warning: null });
      go("/signin", "push");
    },

    unavailable,

    /** "Stay signed in": one marked GET /me. Its success restarts the timer through the activity hook. */
    async stay(): Promise<void> {
      try {
        const me = await api.me({ activity: true });
        if (state.session.kind === "signed-in") set({ session: { kind: "signed-in", me } });
      } catch {
        // A 401 has shown sign-in; anything else leaves the warning up, and the timer's own read decides.
      }
    },

    dispose() {
      idle.stop();
      listeners.clear();
      slots.clear();
    },
  };
}
```
