```ts
/** What the staff module needs from this one: the console's operations on cases, which its routes run behind the staff gate. */
export interface ModerationForStaff {
  /**
   * Records the decision a step-up confirmed, in one transaction with its audit row. "ended" when the confirming account
   * or key no longer opens anything, "late" when the challenge's time ran out; neither writes anything.
   */
  decide(session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<DecideOutcome>;
  /** The case as the answer to a decision that has just committed on it: logged like every read, and never refused for the day's limit. */
  decidedCase(session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string): Promise<CaseView>;
  /**
   * Records the review a step-up confirmed: the answer to the one appeal of the decision the confirmation names, in one
   * transaction with its audit row. "ended" and "late" as for a decision.
   */
  review(session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<DecideOutcome>;
  /** The case of a reviewed decision as the answer to a review that has just committed on it, read as decidedCase reads. */
  reviewedCase(session: ActiveStaffSession, decisionId: string): Promise<CaseView>;
  /** A page of the pending appeals, newest first, each marked whether this person may review it; never a statement. */
  appeals(session: ActiveStaffSession, cursor?: string): Promise<AppealsPage>;
  /** What every staff member's home screen shows: counts, times, staff handles and cases, and how many appeals this person may review. */
  overview(session: ActiveStaffSession): Promise<StaffOverview>;
  /** A page of the queue: open cases by lane and age, after the cursor when one is given; the first page leads with the replies no decision answered. */
  queue(cursor?: string): Promise<QueuePage>;
  /** 3e: the Standing screen's four lists (accounts at the ladder's strikes, reporting records, notices not sent, terminations waiting). */
  standing(): Promise<StandingLists>;
  /** The case as staff read it. The read is logged, and held to the day's limit on different cases; a recused person is refused. */
  caseView(session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string): Promise<CaseView>;
  /** An image of the case's own post, opened for staff and logged, or image_refused. The caller streams the file and closes it. */
  caseImage(session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string, mediaId: string, size: MediaSize): Promise<StoredFile>;
  /**
   * A fresh snapshot of the case's target when it differs from the newest; its id and digest, never content. Run again
   * when it gives way to a decision on the case, and refused as case_closed when it keeps having to.
   */
  takeSnapshot(session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string): Promise<StaffSnapshotTaken>;
  /** Opens a case, or joins the open one, on the moderator's own finding under a rule (its target resolved first), within the day's limit. */
  openFinding(session: ActiveStaffSession, request: FindingRequest): Promise<FindingResponse>;
  /** Saves a text on the case, as written or not at all. */
  saveText(session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string, request: StaffTextSaveRequest): Promise<StaffTextSaved>;
  /** The person's own drafts on the case, with their salts. */
  texts(session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string): Promise<StaffTextsResponse>;
  /**
   * Reveals who sent an item, once a step-up confirmed it: the access row and the audit row in one transaction, the
   * identity read only after the commit. "ended" and "late" as for a decision.
   */
  reveal(session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<RevealOutcome>;
  /** 3f: a page of the messages at the authorities' contact point, newest first, with no sender and no subject. */
  contact(query: ContactQuery): Promise<ContactPage>;
  /**
   * 3f: closes a message as what it turned out to be, in one transaction with its audit row; message_handled when it
   * has a disposition already, not_found for an unknown id. No key: closing restricts nothing and tells nobody.
   */
  closeContact(session: ActiveStaffSession, messageId: string, request: ContactCloseRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<void>;
  /** 3f: the orders that are not closed, the nearest deadline first, and those closed in the last 30 days. */
  orders(): Promise<OrdersPage>;
  /** 3f: one order with its clock, items, events, what the command line owes and the hold, as this person may act on it; null when unknown. */
  order(session: ActiveStaffSession, orderId: string): Promise<OrderView | null>;
  /** 3f: opens an order record, with or without a message, in one transaction with its audit row; every staff account is alerted. No key. */
  openOrder(session: ActiveStaffSession, request: OrderOpenRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderView>;
  /** 3f: adds links to an order that is not closed, with its audit row. No key. */
  addOrderItems(session: ActiveStaffSession, orderId: string, request: OrderItemsRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderView>;
  /** 3f: records a console event a step-up confirmed, through order_event_record, with its confirmed audit row. */
  recordOrderEvent(session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderOutcome>;
  /**
   * 3f: corrects what a person entered, through order_correct, with its audit row: a plain one under the rules entry and
   * caution, a confirmed one under admin, which "step_up_required" answers when no key confirmed it.
   */
  correctOrder(session: ActiveStaffSession, orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed | null, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderOutcome | "step_up_required">;
}

/**
 * What the social module needs from this one (3c design, section 5): the facts behind the chip on the author's own post.
 * For each of these posts that the viewer wrote and that is withheld or removed, the decision of the strongest post
 * measure in force, or the decision whose erasure removed it. Asked once a page, and only about the viewer's own posts.
 */
export interface ModerationForSocial {
  authorFacts(viewer: string, postIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, PostModeration>>;
}

/** What the account module needs from this one (3c design, sections 5, 7.10 and 7.11): the purge's forgetting, and the export's member; 3e adds the take-down of terminated accounts. */
export interface ModerationForAccount {
  /**
   * Forgets that a deleted account sent its reports: the account's id goes from its intakes and their items, which go on
   * being processed. The database acts only on an account whose auth row the take-down marked deleted, and changes
   * nothing when run again.
   */
  forgetAccount(userId: string): Promise<void>;
  /**
   * The moderation member of the account's data export: the decisions about the account that its Cases screen lists and
   * its own reports and notices while their records are kept, each as the account's own screens show it. Never another
   * person's report, a reporter, a notifier or a staff member.
   */
  exportFor(userId: string): Promise<ModerationExport>;
  /**
   * 3e (design, sections 5 and 7.8): takes down every account whose termination is final for its author. For each, in a
   * transaction of its own, the profile and then the terminating decision's case FOR UPDATE, terminations_due() again for
   * that account, and only then `takeDown` (the auth module's takeDownTerminated), awaited while the transaction is open.
   * Answers how many it took down and how many failed; one failure never stops the next account.
   */
  takeDownDue(takeDown: TakeDown): Promise<{ terminated: number; failed: number }>;
}

export interface CreateModerationOptions {
  /** The korbat_api pool. The module never sees the auth pool. */
  apiDb: Db;
  /** The auth module's interface for moderation: auth.forModeration. */
  auth: AuthForModeration;
  /** The social module's interface for cases: socialForModeration(apiDb). */
  social: SocialForModeration;
  /** The media module's interface for cases: media.forCases. */
  media: MediaForCases;
  /**
   * The auth module's requireSession: an onboarded account with CSRF and Origin checked. The author's and the reporter's
   * routes stand behind it. Without it they refuse every request, so a module built for the staff side alone opens none.
   */
  requireSession?: MiddlewareHandler<AppEnv>;
  /** What one sender may send, and the throttles of the staff alerts, count in the store the per-IP middleware uses. */
  rateLimitStore: RateLimitStore;
  config: Config;
  logger: Logger;
  now?: () => Date;
}

export function createModeration(options: CreateModerationOptions) {
  const deps: ModerationDeps = {
    apiDb: options.apiDb,
    auth: options.auth,
    social: options.social,
    media: options.media,
    limits: options.rateLimitStore,
    background: createBackground(options.logger),
    config: options.config,
    log: options.logger,
    now: options.now ?? (() => new Date()),
  };
  const forStaff: ModerationForStaff = {
    decide: (session, confirmed, ctx) => decide(deps, session, confirmed, ctx),
    decidedCase: (session, caseId) => readDecidedCase(deps, session, caseId),
    review: (session, confirmed, ctx) => review(deps, session, confirmed, ctx),
    reviewedCase: async (session, decisionId) => readDecidedCase(deps, session, await reviewedCase(deps, decisionId)),
    appeals: (session, cursor) => appealsList(deps, session, cursor),
    overview: (session) => overview(deps, session),
    queue: (cursor) => queue(deps, cursor),
    standing: () => standingLists(deps.apiDb),
    caseView: (session, caseId) => readCase(deps, session, caseId),
    caseImage: (session, caseId, mediaId, size) => caseImage(deps, session, caseId, mediaId, size),
    takeSnapshot: (session, caseId) => takeSnapshot(deps, session, caseId),
    openFinding: (session, request) => openFinding(deps, session, request),
    saveText: (session, caseId, request) => saveText(deps, session, caseId, request),
    texts: (session, caseId) => ownTexts(deps, session, caseId),
    reveal: (session, confirmed, ctx) => reveal(deps, session, confirmed, ctx),
    contact: (query) => contactPage(deps, query),
    closeContact: (session, messageId, request, ctx) => closeContact(deps, session, messageId, request, ctx),
    orders: () => ordersPage(deps),
    order: (session, orderId) => orderView(deps, orderId, session),
    openOrder: (session, request, ctx) => openOrder(deps, session, request, ctx),
    addOrderItems: (session, orderId, request, ctx) => addItems(deps, session, orderId, request, ctx),
    recordOrderEvent: (session, confirmed, ctx) => recordEvent(deps, session, confirmed, ctx),
    correctOrder: (session, orderId, facts, confirmed, ctx) => correctOrderRecord(deps, session, orderId, facts, confirmed, ctx),
  };
  const forSocial: ModerationForSocial = {
    authorFacts: (viewer, postIds) => authorFacts(deps, viewer, postIds),
  };
  const forAccount: ModerationForAccount = {
    forgetAccount: async (userId) => {
      await forgetReporter(deps.apiDb, userId);
    },
    exportFor: (userId) => exportFor(deps, userId),
    takeDownDue: (takeDown) => takeDownDue(deps, takeDown),
  };
  return {
    deps,
    /**
     * The app's routes, mounted at /api: reports and notices, their status page with its contact buttons and its
     * re-examinations, and behind the session guard the account's own decisions, appeals, reports and re-examinations.
     */
    routes: moderationRoutes(deps, options.requireSession ?? noSession),
    /** The interface the staff module uses. */
    forStaff,
    /** The interface the social module's views use. */
    forSocial,
    /** The interface the account module's purge and export use. */
    forAccount,
    /**
     * 3e (design, section 7.12): /api/me's standing, read fresh from the ledger: null for an account without a live
     * profile. The app composes the route from this and the auth module's meFor.
     */
    standingFor: (userId: string) => standingFor(deps.apiDb, userId),
    /**
     * Resolves once every task a request started and did not wait for has ended: the mails after a report, a notice, a
     * finding, a reveal or a refused case read. The tests await it; the server lets the tasks run.
     */
    settle: () => deps.background.settle(),
    /**
     * Starts the module's background work under the jobs' shared lock, on one API instance at a time: the dispatch job
     * and 3f's alert tick always, and the retention job only while MODERATION_RETENTION is on. The dispatch and retention
     * jobs' first rounds come ten minutes after the start, the tick's 30 seconds after it. While the switch is off nothing
     * is erased, released or deleted, and the warning is logged at every start, so a switch left off after a restore is
     * seen; the tick runs all the same, since an alert is never about retention. Answers the function that stops them
     * all; a round in flight finishes.
     */
    startJobs: (lock: JobLock): (() => void) => {
      const stopDispatch = createDispatchJob(deps, lock).start();
      const stopTick = createAlertTick(deps, lock).start();
      if (deps.config.MODERATION_RETENTION !== "on") {
        deps.log.warn(RETENTION_OFF_WARNING);
        return () => {
          stopDispatch();
          stopTick();
        };
      }
      const stopRetention = createRetentionJob(deps, lock).start();
      return () => {
        stopDispatch();
        stopTick();
        stopRetention();
      };
    },
  };
}

export type Moderation = ReturnType<typeof createModeration>;
```

### Replace `apps/api/src/moderation/links.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { ModerationError } from "./context";

/**
 * korbat links (3c design, section 7.1, step 3). A report names things on korbat only: a post by its id, an account by
 * its handle, or the app's own address of either, which is parsed here. Nothing is ever fetched: a link to another site
 * is refused, never followed, so no moderator and no server opens an address a stranger chose.
 */

/** What a korbat link names. */
export type LinkTarget = { type: "post"; id: string } | { type: "account"; handle: string };

// The path's own words are the app's, in lower case only; the id's letters may be written in either case.
const POST_PATH = /^[/]post[/]([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12})[/]?$/;
const PROFILE_PATH = /^[/]u[/]([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20})[/]?$/;

/**
 * Parses a link: it must be the app's address of a post (`/post/<id>`) or of a profile (`/u/<handle>`). Refused with
 * notice_link_offsite when it names another host, and with notice_link_invalid when it is no web address or names
 * another path. The host is compared with the app's, port included; the scheme is not, since a person may copy an
 * address from before the redirect to https. A query and a fragment are ignored. The id and the handle are answered in
 * lower case, as the database keeps them.
 */
export function parseLink(appOrigin: string, link: string): LinkTarget {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(link);
  } catch {
    throw new ModerationError("notice_link_invalid");
  }
  if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") throw new ModerationError("notice_link_invalid");
  if (url.host !== new URL(appOrigin).host) throw new ModerationError("notice_link_offsite");
  // No korbat address carries a user name or a password.
  if (url.username !== "" || url.password !== "") throw new ModerationError("notice_link_invalid");
  const post = POST_PATH.exec(url.pathname);
  if (post) return { type: "post", id: post[1]!.toLowerCase() };
  const profile = PROFILE_PATH.exec(url.pathname);
  if (profile) return { type: "account", handle: profile[1]!.toLowerCase() };
  throw new ModerationError("notice_link_invalid");
}

/** What an order's link names (3f design, section 7.4). */
export type OrderLinkTarget = { kind: "post"; postId: string } | { kind: "image"; mediaId: string } | { kind: "account"; handle: string } | { kind: "other" };

// The address of an image korbat serves: /api/media/<id>/small.webp or large.webp, on the app's origin.
const IMAGE_PATH = /^[/]api[/]media[/]([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12})[/](small|large)[.]webp$/;

/**
 * What a link an authority's order names is (3f design, section 7.4), for its item: the app's address of a post or of a
 * profile as parseLink reads them, the address of an image korbat serves, or anything else (another site, another path,
 * no address at all). It never refuses: an order's link is recorded as named whatever it is, and an item whose link names
 * no post stays open until a person closes it. Nothing is fetched.
 */
export function orderLinkTarget(appOrigin: string, link: string): OrderLinkTarget {
  try {
    const target = parseLink(appOrigin, link);
    return target.type === "post" ? { kind: "post", postId: target.id } : { kind: "account", handle: target.handle };
  } catch (err) {
    if (!(err instanceof ModerationError)) throw err;
  }
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(link);
  } catch {
    return { kind: "other" };
  }
  if ((url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") || url.host !== new URL(appOrigin).host || url.username !== "" || url.password !== "") return { kind: "other" };
  const image = IMAGE_PATH.exec(url.pathname);
  return image ? { kind: "image", mediaId: image[1]!.toLowerCase() } : { kind: "other" };
}

/** The app's origin without a path, whatever final slash the setting was written with. */
const originOf = (appOrigin: string) => new URL(appOrigin).origin;

/** The app's address of a post. */
export const postLink = (appOrigin: string, postId: string): string => `${originOf(appOrigin)}/post/${postId}`;

/**
 * The app's address of an account under a handle. A report is shown back under the handle it named, never under the one
 * the profile holds now: no report may show its sender a later handle, since there is no redirect from a handle an
 * account has left either.
 */
export const accountLink = (appOrigin: string, handle: string): string => `${originOf(appOrigin)}/u/${handle}`;
```

### Replace `apps/api/src/moderation/orders-repo.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type {
  Annex3Ground,
  ContactDisposition,
  ContactFolder,
  HoldEndReason,
  OrderChannel,
  OrderCloseGround,
  OrderConsoleEvent,
  OrderEventKind,
  OrderEventVia,
  OrderGround,
  OrderItemCloseReason,
  OrderKind,
  TellPersonRule,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";

/**
 * The SQL of authorities' orders (3f design, section 5): the messages at the contact point, which the watcher inserts and
 * the console lists and closes (the API role reads every column of contact_messages and may update only its disposition
 * and who set it; the database forces when), and the order records, their items and events (Task 2). The API role reads
 * every order and inserts the console's columns; the clock's events and the corrections go through the two definer
 * functions, bound to their audit rows.
 */

type Querier = Pick<Db, "execute"> | Pick<DbTx, "execute">;

/** One message as the Contact point screen reads it, with its place in the list as text of microseconds for the cursor. */
export interface ContactRow {
  id: string;
  folder: ContactFolder;
  receivedAt: Date;
  /** received_at in UTC to the microsecond: the cursor's sort key. */
  place: string;
  seenAt: Date;
  stale: boolean;
  disposition: ContactDisposition | null;
  handledAt: Date | null;
  /** The handle of the staff member who handled it, or null. */
  handledBy: string | null;
}

/** A page of messages, newest first by the time of receipt, after the given place; only those without a disposition when `open`. */
export async function contactMessages(q: Querier, options: { open: boolean; after: { place: string; id: string } | null; limit: number }): Promise<ContactRow[]> {
  const after = options.after === null ? sql`true` : sql`(m.received_at, m.id) < (${options.after.place}::timestamptz, ${options.after.id}::uuid)`;
  const rows = await q.execute<{
    id: string;
    folder: ContactFolder;
    received_at: string;
    place: string;
    seen_at: string;
    stale: boolean;
    disposition: ContactDisposition | null;
    handled_at: string | null;
    handled_by: string | null;
  }>(sql`
    select m.id, m.folder, m.received_at, to_char(m.received_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as place,
           m.seen_at, m.stale, m.disposition, m.handled_at, p.handle as handled_by
      from public.contact_messages m
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = m.handled_by
     where ${after} and (not ${options.open} or m.disposition is null)
     order by m.received_at desc, m.id desc
     limit ${options.limit}`);
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    folder: row.folder,
    receivedAt: new Date(row.received_at),
    place: row.place,
    seenAt: new Date(row.seen_at),
    stale: row.stale,
    disposition: row.disposition,
    handledAt: row.handled_at === null ? null : new Date(row.handled_at),
    handledBy: row.handled_by,
  }));
}

/**
 * Sets a message's disposition and who set it, only while it has none: the trigger stamps when, and refuses any other
 * change. Answers the message's time of receipt and folder for the audit row, or null when no message without a
 * disposition has the id.
 */
export async function closeMessage(tx: DbTx, id: string, disposition: Exclude<ContactDisposition, "order">, staffId: string): Promise<{ receivedAt: Date; folder: ContactFolder } | null> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ received_at: string; folder: ContactFolder }>(sql`
    update public.contact_messages set disposition = ${disposition}, handled_by = ${staffId}::uuid
     where id = ${id}::uuid and disposition is null
    returning received_at, folder`);
  return row ? { receivedAt: new Date(row.received_at), folder: row.folder } : null;
}

/** Whether a message has the id, whatever its disposition. */
export async function messageExists(q: Querier, id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await q.execute(sql`select 1 from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`)).length > 0;
}

/**
 * The home screen's counts of the contact point: the messages without a disposition, stale ones included, the oldest
 * one's time of receipt, and the earliest deadline among them, the time of receipt and order_rules().hour_minutes, also
 * once it has passed. The orders' deadlines are nearestOrderDeadline's.
 */
export async function contactCounts(q: Querier): Promise<{ open: number; oldestAt: Date | null; dueAt: Date | null }> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ open: number; oldest_at: string | null; due_at: string | null }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as open, min(m.received_at) as oldest_at,
           min(m.received_at) + make_interval(mins => (select r.hour_minutes from public.order_rules() r)) as due_at
      from public.contact_messages m
     where m.disposition is null`);
  return { open: row!.open, oldestAt: row!.oldest_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.oldest_at), dueAt: row!.due_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.due_at) };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- order records (3f design, sections 6.2, 7.4 and 7.5)

/** A timestamptz expression as ISO text in UTC, to the millisecond. The expression is written here, never input. */
const isoOf = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')`);
/** A list of uuids as a PostgreSQL array. */
const uuidList = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

/** One link of a new order, with the post it resolved to (null when it named none). */
export interface NewOrderItem {
  link: string;
  postId: string | null;
}

/**
 * The rows of opening an order (section 7.4), which the console's route, `staff.js order-open` and the import all write
 * through insertOrder. `openedBy` is the opening staff account, null from the command line; `cli` carries what only the
 * migrator may write (the receipt and the sending time a channel states), and is absent for the console, whose insert
 * names the console's columns alone and lets the trigger force the rest.
 */
export interface NewOrder {
  id: string;
  kind: OrderKind;
  memberState: string;
  authority: string;
  reference: string;
  channel: OrderChannel;
  messageId: string | null;
  sectionC: boolean;
  emergency: boolean;
  crossBorder: boolean;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
  openedBy: string | null;
  items: readonly NewOrderItem[];
  cli?: { receivedAt: Date | null; sentAt: Date | null };
}

/** An item as written: its id, position, the time the database stamped, and what it names. */
export interface WrittenItem {
  id: string;
  position: number;
  addedAt: Date;
  link: string;
  postId: string | null;
}

/** What opening an order wrote, as its audit row and its alert need it. */
export interface InsertedOrder {
  id: string;
  openedAt: Date;
  receivedAt: Date | null;
  sentAt: Date | null;
  channel: OrderChannel;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
  items: WrittenItem[];
}

/** Inserts items at the next positions of an order, in the order given, and answers them. */
async function insertItems(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, items: readonly NewOrderItem[], from: number): Promise<WrittenItem[]> {
  const written: WrittenItem[] = [];
  for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; position: number; added_at: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${orderId}::uuid, ${from + index}::smallint, ${item.link}, ${item.postId}::uuid)
      returning id, position, ${isoOf("added_at")} as added_at`);
    written.push({ id: row!.id, position: row!.position, addedAt: new Date(row!.added_at), link: item.link, postId: item.postId });
  }
  return written;
}

/**
 * The rows of opening an order, in the caller's transaction (section 7.4 step 4): the order's row (the trigger forces
 * when and how it was opened, the receipt from the message and the withholding), one item a link from position 1, the
 * event `opened`, and the message's disposition `order` when one is named and has none (a message closed as something
 * else keeps its word). The audit row is the caller's, last. A plain function of the module's index: it takes the
 * caller's transaction and no dependency, so the command line, as the migrator, writes the same rows. The migrator's
 * insert passes the triggers' forcing, so it supplies its own `opened_via`, its event's `via` and the message's time.
 */
export async function insertOrder(tx: DbTx, order: NewOrder): Promise<InsertedOrder> {
  const cli = order.cli;
  const [row] =
    cli === undefined
      ? await tx.execute<{ opened_at: string; received_at: string | null; sent_at: string | null; channel: OrderChannel; withhold_from_author: boolean }>(sql`
          insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
          values (${order.id}::uuid, ${order.kind}, ${order.memberState}, ${order.authority}, ${order.reference}, ${order.channel}, ${order.messageId}::uuid,
                  ${order.sectionC}::boolean, ${order.emergency}::boolean, ${order.crossBorder}::boolean, ${order.withholdFromAuthor}::boolean, ${order.openedBy}::uuid)
          returning ${isoOf("opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("sent_at")} as sent_at, channel, withhold_from_author`)
      : await tx.execute<{ opened_at: string; received_at: string | null; sent_at: string | null; channel: OrderChannel; withhold_from_author: boolean }>(sql`
          insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author,
                                           opened_by, opened_via, received_at, sent_at)
          values (${order.id}::uuid, ${order.kind}, ${order.memberState}, ${order.authority}, ${order.reference}, ${order.channel}, ${order.messageId}::uuid,
                  ${order.sectionC}::boolean, ${order.emergency}::boolean, ${order.crossBorder}::boolean, ${order.withholdFromAuthor}::boolean, ${order.openedBy}::uuid,
                  'cli', ${cli.receivedAt?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz, ${cli.sentAt?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz)
          returning ${isoOf("opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("sent_at")} as sent_at, channel, withhold_from_author`);
  const items = await insertItems(tx, order.id, order.items, 1);
  // The event `opened`: the API role's insert is forced to the console, the clock and the opening account; the migrator's
  // is the command line's.
  await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, by_staff, via) values (${order.id}::uuid, 'opened', ${order.openedBy}::uuid, ${cli === undefined ? "console" : "cli"})`);
  if (order.messageId !== null) {
    // The trigger stamps when for the API role; the migrator, whom it does not touch, stamps it here.
    await tx.execute(
      cli === undefined
        ? sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'order', handled_by = ${order.openedBy}::uuid where id = ${order.messageId}::uuid and disposition is null`
        : sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'order', handled_at = now() where id = ${order.messageId}::uuid and disposition is null`,
    );
  }
  return {
    id: order.id,
    openedAt: new Date(row!.opened_at),
    receivedAt: row!.received_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.received_at),
    sentAt: row!.sent_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.sent_at),
    channel: row!.channel,
    withholdFromAuthor: row!.withhold_from_author,
    items,
  };
}

/** Adds items to an order after its last position (section 7.4, "More items"); the caller holds the order's advisory lock. */
export async function addOrderItems(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, items: readonly NewOrderItem[]): Promise<WrittenItem[]> {
  const [last] = await tx.execute<{ position: number }>(sql`select coalesce(max(position), 0)::int as position from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
  return insertItems(tx, orderId, items, last!.position + 1);
}

/** The posts of these ids that a row of posts has, in any state. */
export async function existingPosts(q: Querier, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) return new Set();
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.posts where id = any(${uuidList(ids)})`);
  return new Set(found.map((row) => row.id));
}

/**
 * How many orders the account opened in the last 24 hours by the database's clock, and in how many seconds the oldest of
 * them leaves that window (section 7.4 step 1); the insert's trigger counts again under the account's lock.
 */
export async function ordersOpenedToday(q: Querier, staffId: string): Promise<{ count: number; retryAfterSeconds: number }> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ count: number; retry: number | null }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as count,
           ceil(extract(epoch from min(opened_at) + make_interval(days => 1) - clock_timestamp()))::int as retry
      from public.legal_orders where opened_by = ${staffId}::uuid and opened_at > clock_timestamp() - make_interval(days => 1)`);
  return { count: row!.count, retryAfterSeconds: Math.max(1, row!.retry ?? 1) };
}

/** The order of this issuing state, authority and reference, which the unique key names. */
export async function orderByReference(q: Querier, memberState: string, authority: string, reference: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.legal_orders where member_state = ${memberState} and authority = ${authority} and reference = ${reference}`);
  return row?.id ?? null;
}

/** An order's row as the console's reads need it: the facts, the hold's columns and what the command line recorded. */
export interface OrderRow {
  id: string;
  kind: OrderKind;
  memberState: string;
  authority: string;
  reference: string;
  channel: OrderChannel;
  messageId: string | null;
  receivedAt: string | null;
  sentAt: string | null;
  issuedAt: string | null;
  dueAt: string | null;
  sectionC: boolean;
  emergency: boolean;
  crossBorder: boolean;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
  preserve: boolean;
  holdExtended: boolean;
  holdEndedAt: string | null;
  holdEndReason: HoldEndReason | null;
  tellPerson: TellPersonRule | null;
  tellPersonAt: string | null;
  openedBy: string | null;
  openedVia: "console" | "cli";
  openedAt: string;
  verifiedAt: string | null;
  hasReasons: boolean;
  hasRedress: boolean;
  hasScope: boolean;
  hasDocument: boolean;
  closedAt: string | null;
  importedAt: string | null;
  /** order_hold_until: null without Section C, 'infinity' as null with `holdOpen`. */
  holdUntil: string | null;
  holdOpen: boolean;
  closeGround: OrderCloseGround | null;
  /** The newest notice_released event's time. */
  releasedAt: string | null;
  /** Whether a scrutiny was requested. */
  scrutinyRequested: boolean;
  items: number;
  itemsInForce: number;
  /** Decisions of the order whose author was not told. */
  noticesHeld: number;
  /** An item of the order is disabled, or was. */
  givenEffect: boolean;
  /** Items neither disabled nor closed with a reason, for every kind of order. */
  itemsOpen: number;
  /** An item added after the verification, or any item while the order is not verified. */
  itemsUnverified: boolean;
  clock: OrderClockRow | null;
  /** The database's clock when the row was read. */
  now: string;
}

/** One row of legal_order_clock, with the newest Annex III's time and ground while the clock is stopped. */
export interface OrderClockRow {
  clockStart: string | null;
  stopped: boolean;
  stoppedAt: string | null;
  stopGround: Annex3Ground | null;
  deadlineAt: string | null;
  targetAt: string | null;
  itemsOpen: number;
  firstEffectAt: string | null;
  lastEffectAt: string | null;
  withinHour: boolean | null;
}

/** The orders the filter selects, with every fact the list and the order's screen print. */
async function orderRowsWhere(q: Querier, where: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<OrderRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select o.id, o.kind, o.member_state, o.authority, o.reference, o.channel, o.message_id,
           ${isoOf("o.received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("o.sent_at")} as sent_at, ${isoOf("o.issued_at")} as issued_at, ${isoOf("o.due_at")} as due_at,
           o.section_c, o.emergency, o.cross_border, o.withhold_from_author, o.preserve, o.hold_extended,
           ${isoOf("o.hold_ended_at")} as hold_ended_at, o.hold_end_reason, o.tell_person, ${isoOf("o.tell_person_at")} as tell_person_at,
           p.handle as opened_by, o.opened_via, ${isoOf("o.opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("o.verified_at")} as verified_at,
           o.reasons is not null as has_reasons, o.redress is not null as has_redress, o.scope is not null as has_scope, o.document_sha256 is not null as has_document,
           ${isoOf("o.closed_at")} as closed_at, ${isoOf("o.imported_at")} as imported_at,
           case when h.until = 'infinity'::timestamptz then null else ${isoOf("h.until")} end as hold_until,
           coalesce(h.until = 'infinity'::timestamptz, false) as hold_open,
           case when o.closed_at is null then null else
             (select e.ground from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'closed_without_effect' order by e.at desc, e.id desc limit 1) end as close_ground,
           (select ${isoOf("max(e.at)")} from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'notice_released') as released_at,
           exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'scrutiny_requested') as scrutiny_requested,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id) as items,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i join public.measures_in_force m on m.id = i.action_id where i.order_id = o.id) as items_in_force,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i join public.decisions d on d.order_item_id = i.id where i.order_id = o.id and d.informed_at is null) as notices_held,
           exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is not null) as given_effect,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is null and i.closed_at is null) as items_open_all,
           exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and (o.verified_at is null or i.added_at > o.verified_at)) as items_unverified,
           c.order_id is not null as has_clock, ${isoOf("c.clock_start")} as clock_start, c.stopped, ${isoOf("c.deadline_at")} as deadline_at, ${isoOf("c.target_at")} as target_at,
           c.items_open, ${isoOf("c.first_effect_at")} as first_effect_at, ${isoOf("c.last_effect_at")} as last_effect_at, c.within_hour,
           case when c.stopped then (select ${isoOf("a.at")} from public.legal_order_events a where a.order_id = o.id and a.kind = 'annex3_sent' order by a.at desc, a.id desc limit 1) end as stopped_at,
           case when c.stopped then (select a.ground from public.legal_order_events a where a.order_id = o.id and a.kind = 'annex3_sent' order by a.at desc, a.id desc limit 1) end as stop_ground,
           ${isoOf("clock_timestamp()")} as now
      from public.legal_orders o
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = o.opened_by
      left join public.legal_order_clock c on c.order_id = o.id
      cross join lateral (select public.order_hold_until(o.id) as until) h
     where ${where}`);
  return found.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id as string,
    kind: r.kind as OrderKind,
    memberState: r.member_state as string,
    authority: r.authority as string,
    reference: r.reference as string,
    channel: r.channel as OrderChannel,
    messageId: r.message_id as string | null,
    receivedAt: r.received_at as string | null,
    sentAt: r.sent_at as string | null,
    issuedAt: r.issued_at as string | null,
    dueAt: r.due_at as string | null,
    sectionC: r.section_c as boolean,
    emergency: r.emergency as boolean,
    crossBorder: r.cross_border as boolean,
    withholdFromAuthor: r.withhold_from_author as boolean,
    preserve: r.preserve as boolean,
    holdExtended: r.hold_extended as boolean,
    holdEndedAt: r.hold_ended_at as string | null,
    holdEndReason: r.hold_end_reason as HoldEndReason | null,
    tellPerson: r.tell_person as TellPersonRule | null,
    tellPersonAt: r.tell_person_at as string | null,
    openedBy: r.opened_by as string | null,
    openedVia: r.opened_via as "console" | "cli",
    openedAt: r.opened_at as string,
    verifiedAt: r.verified_at as string | null,
    hasReasons: r.has_reasons as boolean,
    hasRedress: r.has_redress as boolean,
    hasScope: r.has_scope as boolean,
    hasDocument: r.has_document as boolean,
    closedAt: r.closed_at as string | null,
    importedAt: r.imported_at as string | null,
    holdUntil: r.hold_until as string | null,
    holdOpen: r.hold_open as boolean,
    closeGround: r.close_ground as OrderCloseGround | null,
    releasedAt: r.released_at as string | null,
    scrutinyRequested: r.scrutiny_requested as boolean,
    items: r.items as number,
    itemsInForce: r.items_in_force as number,
    noticesHeld: r.notices_held as number,
    givenEffect: r.given_effect as boolean,
    itemsOpen: r.items_open_all as number,
    itemsUnverified: r.items_unverified as boolean,
    clock: r.has_clock
      ? {
          clockStart: r.clock_start as string | null,
          stopped: r.stopped as boolean,
          stoppedAt: r.stopped_at as string | null,
          stopGround: r.stop_ground as Annex3Ground | null,
          deadlineAt: r.deadline_at as string | null,
          targetAt: r.target_at as string | null,
          itemsOpen: r.items_open as number,
          firstEffectAt: r.first_effect_at as string | null,
          lastEffectAt: r.last_effect_at as string | null,
          withinHour: r.within_hour as boolean | null,
        }
      : null,
    now: r.now as string,
  }));
}

/** One order's row, or null. */
export async function orderRow(q: Querier, id: string): Promise<OrderRow | null> {
  const [row] = await orderRowsWhere(q, sql`o.id = ${id}::uuid`);
  return row ?? null;
}

/** The orders that are not closed, and those closed in the last 30 days (section 7.5). */
export async function orderRows(q: Querier): Promise<OrderRow[]> {
  return orderRowsWhere(q, sql`(o.closed_at is null or o.closed_at > clock_timestamp() - make_interval(days => 30))`);
}

/** One item of an order with what it named, read live, and what became of it. */
export interface OrderItemRow {
  id: string;
  position: number;
  link: string;
  postId: string | null;
  addedAt: string;
  decisionId: string | null;
  caseId: string | null;
  inForce: boolean;
  disabledAt: string | null;
  noEffect: "deleted" | "already" | null;
  preserveUntil: string | null;
  preserveEndedAt: string | null;
  reinstatedAt: string | null;
  reinstatedGround: OrderGround | null;
  closedAt: string | null;
  closedReason: OrderItemCloseReason | null;
  /** The post as it stands now, when a row of posts has the item's post. */
  post: { authorHandle: string | null; state: string; body: string; createdAt: string; deletedOn: string | null } | null;
}

/** An order's items in position order, each with its post read live. */
export async function orderItems(q: Querier, orderId: string): Promise<OrderItemRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select i.id, i.position, i.link, i.post_id, ${isoOf("i.added_at")} as added_at, i.decision_id, d.case_id,
           exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.id = i.action_id) as in_force,
           ${isoOf("i.disabled_at")} as disabled_at, a.no_effect, ${isoOf("i.preserve_until")} as preserve_until, ${isoOf("i.preserve_ended_at")} as preserve_ended_at,
           ${isoOf("i.reinstated_at")} as reinstated_at,
           (select e.ground from public.legal_order_events e where e.item_id = i.id and e.kind = 'reinstated' order by e.at desc, e.id desc limit 1) as reinstated_ground,
           ${isoOf("i.closed_at")} as closed_at, i.closed_reason,
           p.id is not null as has_post, a2.handle as author_handle, p.state::text as post_state, p.body, ${isoOf("p.created_at")} as post_created_at,
           to_char(p.deleted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as deleted_on
      from public.legal_order_items i
      left join public.decisions d on d.id = i.decision_id
      left join public.decision_actions a on a.id = i.action_id
      left join public.posts p on p.id = i.post_id
      left join public.profiles a2 on a2.id = p.author_id
     where i.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid
     order by i.position`);
  return found.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id as string,
    position: r.position as number,
    link: r.link as string,
    postId: r.post_id as string | null,
    addedAt: r.added_at as string,
    decisionId: r.decision_id as string | null,
    caseId: r.case_id as string | null,
    inForce: r.in_force as boolean,
    disabledAt: r.disabled_at as string | null,
    noEffect: r.no_effect as "deleted" | "already" | null,
    preserveUntil: r.preserve_until as string | null,
    preserveEndedAt: r.preserve_ended_at as string | null,
    reinstatedAt: r.reinstated_at as string | null,
    reinstatedGround: r.reinstated_ground as OrderGround | null,
    closedAt: r.closed_at as string | null,
    closedReason: r.closed_reason as OrderItemCloseReason | null,
    post: r.has_post
      ? { authorHandle: r.author_handle as string | null, state: r.post_state as string, body: r.body as string, createdAt: r.post_created_at as string, deletedOn: r.deleted_on as string | null }
      : null,
  }));
}

/** One event of an order, oldest first, with who wrote it as a staff handle. */
export interface OrderEventRow {
  id: string;
  kind: OrderEventKind;
  ground: string | null;
  at: string;
  effectiveAt: string | null;
  itemId: string | null;
  by: string | null;
  via: OrderEventVia;
}

export async function orderEvents(q: Querier, orderId: string): Promise<OrderEventRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select e.id, e.kind, e.ground, ${isoOf("e.at")} as at, ${isoOf("e.effective_at")} as effective_at, e.item_id, p.handle as by, e.via
      from public.legal_order_events e left join public.profiles p on p.id = e.by_staff
     where e.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by e.at, e.id`);
  return found.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id as string,
    kind: r.kind as OrderEventKind,
    ground: r.ground as string | null,
    at: r.at as string,
    effectiveAt: r.effective_at as string | null,
    itemId: r.item_id as string | null,
    by: r.by as string | null,
    via: r.via as OrderEventVia,
  }));
}

/** An event's effective time, as its audit row records it. */
export async function eventEffectiveAt(q: Querier, eventId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ effective_at: string | null }>(sql`select ${isoOf("effective_at")} as effective_at from public.legal_order_events where id = ${eventId}::uuid`);
  return row?.effective_at ?? null;
}

/** The ground of an event, which for `corrected` is the rule that allowed the correction. */
export async function eventGround(q: Querier, eventId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ ground: string | null }>(sql`select ground from public.legal_order_events where id = ${eventId}::uuid`);
  return row?.ground ?? null;
}

/** order_event_record, as its owner, for the acting account (section 6.2): answers the event's id. */
export async function recordOrderEvent(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, kind: OrderConsoleEvent, ground: string | null, messageId: string | null, byStaff: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`select public.order_event_record(${orderId}::uuid, ${kind}::text, ${ground}::text, ${messageId}::uuid, ${byStaff}::uuid) as id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/** order_correct, as its owner, for the acting account (section 6.2): answers the event's id. */
export async function correctOrder(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, facts: Record<string, unknown>, byStaff: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select public.order_correct(${orderId}::uuid, ${JSON.stringify(facts)}::text::jsonb, ${byStaff}::uuid) as id`);
  return row!.id;
}

/** The authors of the posts an order disabled, which a correction after effect locks first (section 5, the lock order, item 2). */
export async function disabledAuthors(q: Querier, orderId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ author_id: string }>(sql`
    select distinct p.author_id from public.legal_order_items i join public.posts p on p.id = i.post_id
     where i.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid and i.disabled_at is not null order by p.author_id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.author_id);
}

/** The orders opened from each of these messages. */
export async function ordersOfMessages(q: Querier, messageIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
  const orders = new Map<string, string[]>();
  if (messageIds.length === 0) return orders;
  const found = await q.execute<{ message_id: string; id: string }>(
    sql`select message_id, id from public.legal_orders where message_id = any(${uuidList(messageIds)}) order by opened_at, id`,
  );
  for (const row of found) orders.set(row.message_id, [...(orders.get(row.message_id) ?? []), row.id]);
  return orders;
}

/**
 * The earliest deadline of an order that still has an open item (section 10.2, StaffOverview.contact.dueAt), also once
 * it has passed: a removal order's running clock, or a DSA order's deadline as its text states it. Null when none runs.
 */
export async function nearestOrderDeadline(q: Querier): Promise<Date | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ due_at: string | null }>(sql`
    select min(d.due) as due_at from (
      select c.deadline_at as due from public.legal_order_clock c join public.legal_orders o on o.id = c.order_id
       where o.closed_at is null and not c.stopped and c.deadline_at is not null and c.items_open > 0
      union all
      select o.due_at from public.legal_orders o
       where o.closed_at is null and o.kind <> 'tco_removal' and o.due_at is not null
         and exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is null and i.closed_at is null)) d`);
  return row?.due_at ? new Date(row.due_at) : null;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Authorities' orders (3f design, sections 5, 7.3 and 8.3). In this task: the messages at the contact point. The watcher
 * records that a message arrived and when, and never who sent it or what it says; a person reads it in the mail host's own
 * app, and then either opens an order from it (Task 2) or closes it here with what it was. Closing restricts nothing and
 * tells nobody, so it needs no key: one transaction, the disposition and then the audit row `contact_closed`.
 */

const PLACE = /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{6}Z$/;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/** The list's cursor: the last row's time of receipt to the microsecond and its id, as an opaque word. */
const encodeCursor = (row: { place: string; id: string }): string => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify([row.place, row.id]), "utf8").toString("base64url");

/** Reads a cursor back; anything this module did not write is refused, never guessed at. */
function decodeCursor(cursor: string): { place: string; id: string } {
  let parts: unknown;
  try {
    parts = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, "base64url").toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(parts) || parts.length !== 2) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  const [place, id] = parts as unknown[];
  if (typeof place !== "string" || !PLACE.test(place) || typeof id !== "string" || !UUID.test(id)) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  return { place, id };
}

/**
 * GET /api/staff/contact: the messages newest first by the time of receipt, CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE a page; with open=1 only
 * those without a disposition. No sender and no subject exist to show. Each carries the orders opened from it.
 */
export async function contactPage(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, query: ContactQuery): Promise<ContactPage> {
  const after = query.cursor === undefined ? null : decodeCursor(query.cursor);
  // One row more than a page, to know whether another page follows.
  const rows = await contactMessages(deps.apiDb, { open: query.open === "1", after, limit: CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE + 1 });
  const page = rows.slice(0, CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE);
  const orders = await ordersOfMessages(deps.apiDb, page.map((row) => row.id));
  return {
    items: page.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      folder: row.folder,
      receivedAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
      seenAt: row.seenAt.toISOString(),
      stale: row.stale,
      disposition: row.disposition,
      handledAt: row.handledAt === null ? null : row.handledAt.toISOString(),
      handledBy: row.handledBy,
      orders: orders.get(row.id) ?? [],
    })),
    nextCursor: rows.length > CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE ? encodeCursor(page.at(-1)!) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close (section 7.3 step 3): the disposition and who set it, only while the message has
 * none (the trigger stamps when), then the audit row, last, with the disposition, the time of receipt and the folder. A
 * message that has a disposition already is message_handled, and a disposition never changes; an unknown id is
 * not_found.
 */
export async function closeContact(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, session: ActiveStaffSession, messageId: string, request: ContactCloseRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<void> {
  await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const closed = await closeMessage(tx, messageId, request.disposition, session.userId);
    if (closed === null) throw new ModerationError((await messageExists(tx, messageId)) ? "message_handled" : "not_found");
    await appendAuditRow(tx, {
      actorId: session.userId,
      action: "contact_closed",
      targetType: "contact_message",
      targetId: messageId,
      requestId: ctx.requestId,
      staffSession: session.handle,
      metadata: { disposition: request.disposition, receivedAt: closed.receivedAt.toISOString(), folder: closed.folder },
    });
  });
}

/**
 * StaffOverview.contact: the messages nobody has handled, the oldest one's time of receipt, and the earliest deadline of a
 * message that is not handled or of an order that still has an open item, also once it has passed (section 10.2).
 */
export async function contactOverview(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">): Promise<StaffOverview["contact"]> {
  const [counts, order] = await Promise.all([contactCounts(deps.apiDb), nearestOrderDeadline(deps.apiDb)]);
  const due = [counts.dueAt, order].filter((at): at is Date => at !== null).sort((a, b) => a.getTime() - b.getTime())[0] ?? null;
  return { open: counts.open, oldestAt: counts.oldestAt?.toISOString() ?? null, dueAt: due?.toISOString() ?? null };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- order records (3f design, sections 7.4, 7.5 and 7.8)

/** What a confirmed action of an order answers: its view, or that the confirming key or account ended, or the challenge ran out. */
export type OrderOutcome = OrderView | "ended" | "late";

/** The locks a recorded event may wait for: the order, the acting account, the message, the key and the audit head. */
const EVENT_WAITS = 5;
/** A correction's: the order, the acting account, the key and the audit head; and one more for each author's profile, decision and post. */
const CORRECTION_WAITS = 4;
/** A correction without a key has no challenge to count from: its lock waits end at this bound, as the command line's do. */
const CORRECTION_LOCK_MS = 10_000;

/** The sha256 of a link, in hex: a link is not copied into the audit chain (section 10.5), its digest and length are. */
const linkDigest = (link: string) => createHash("sha256").update(link, "utf8").digest("hex");

/** An item as the audit rows of opening and adding name it: by its post when its link resolved, else by its link's digest. */
function auditItem(item: WrittenItem): Record<string, unknown> {
  const base = { itemId: item.id, position: item.position, addedAt: item.addedAt.toISOString() };
  return item.postId !== null ? { ...base, postId: item.postId } : { ...base, linkSha256: linkDigest(item.link), linkLength: Array.from(item.link).length };
}

/** What an order's link names now, for its item: a link that named a post or an image with no post found names nothing. */
function linkKindOf(appOrigin: string, link: string, postId: string | null): OrderLinkKind {
  const target = orderLinkTarget(appOrigin, link);
  if ((target.kind === "post" || target.kind === "image") && postId === null) return "other";
  return target.kind;
}

/**
 * The links of an order as its items (section 7.4 step 2), resolved against the app's origin and never fetched: a post's
 * page names the post when a row of posts has it, in any state; an image's address names the post the image is attached
 * to (the media module's imagePost); a profile's page and anything else name no post. Two links that name one post, among
 * these and the order's items already, are refused (invalid_request, 422). A plain function of the module's index, for
 * the console's route and for `staff.js order-open`, on the caller's connection or transaction.
 */
export async function orderItemsFor(q: Db | DbTx, appOrigin: string, links: readonly string[], existingPostIds: readonly string[] = []): Promise<NewOrderItem[]> {
  const targets = links.map((link) => ({ link, target: orderLinkTarget(appOrigin, link) }));
  const named = await existingPosts(q, targets.flatMap(({ target }) => (target.kind === "post" ? [target.postId] : [])));
  const items: NewOrderItem[] = [];
  for (const { link, target } of targets) {
    let postId: string | null = null;
    if (target.kind === "post" && named.has(target.postId)) postId = target.postId;
    if (target.kind === "image") postId = await imagePost(q, target.mediaId);
    items.push({ link, postId });
  }
  const posts = [...existingPostIds, ...items.flatMap((item) => (item.postId === null ? [] : [item.postId]))];
  if (new Set(posts).size !== posts.length) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request", 422, "Two links name the same post.");
  return items;
}

/** Whether the order's issuing state is not the operator's; with no home state named, every order counts as from elsewhere. */
const crossBorderOf = (deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "config">, memberState: string) => deps.config.HOME_STATE === undefined || memberState !== deps.config.HOME_STATE;

/**
 * A refusal the database raised in an order's transaction, as the module's error: its codes, the shared invalid_request
 * (422 here: a member or an item the order does not take) and not_found; anything else is thrown as it is.
 */
function orderRefusal(err: unknown): ModerationError | null {
  const raised = raisedMessage(err);
  if (raised === "invalid_request") return new ModerationError("invalid_request", 422);
  if (raised === "not_found") return new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (raised === "rate_limited") return new ModerationError("rate_limited");
  if (raised !== null && isModerationErrorCode(raised)) return new ModerationError(raised);
  return null;
}

/** order_exists with the order that stands, read after the refusal, so the console links to it (section 7.4 step 5). */
async function orderExists(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, memberState: string, authority: string, reference: string): Promise<ModerationError> {
  const orderId = await orderByReference(deps.apiDb, memberState, authority, reference);
  return new ModerationError("order_exists", undefined, undefined, undefined, orderId === null ? undefined : { orderId });
}

/** The day's limit of order records, counted by the API before anything is written (section 7.4 step 1). */
async function checkRecordLimit(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, staffId: string): Promise<void> {
  const opened = await ordersOpenedToday(deps.apiDb, staffId);
  if (opened.count >= ORDER_RULES.recordsPerDay) throw new ModerationError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, opened.retryAfterSeconds);
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders (section 7.4): the day's limit; the message, which must exist (not_found; order_needs_message
 * when it went between the read and the insert); the links as items; then one transaction, the rows of insertOrder and
 * the audit row `order_opened` last. No key: the record restricts nothing, copies nothing and tells nobody. After the
 * commit every staff account is alerted (`order_opened`), with the count of items and the deadline, or that it is unknown.
 */
export async function openOrder(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, request: OrderOpenRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderView> {
  await checkRecordLimit(deps, session.userId);
  if (request.messageId !== null && !(await messageExists(deps.apiDb, request.messageId))) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  const items = await orderItemsFor(deps.apiDb, deps.config.APP_ORIGIN, request.links);
  const crossBorder = crossBorderOf(deps, request.memberState);
  const id = randomUUID();
  let inserted: InsertedOrder;
  try {
    inserted = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', '10s', true)`);
      const written = await insertOrder(tx, {
        id,
        kind: request.kind,
        memberState: request.memberState,
        authority: request.authority,
        reference: request.reference,
        channel: request.channel,
        messageId: request.messageId,
        sectionC: request.sectionC,
        emergency: request.emergency,
        crossBorder,
        withholdFromAuthor: request.withholdFromAuthor,
        openedBy: session.userId,
        items,
      });
      await appendAuditRow(tx, {
        actorId: session.userId,
        action: "order_opened",
        targetType: "order",
        targetId: id,
        requestId: ctx.requestId,
        staffSession: session.handle,
        metadata: {
          kind: request.kind,
          memberState: request.memberState,
          authority: request.authority,
          reference: request.reference,
          channel: written.channel,
          messageId: request.messageId,
          receivedAt: written.receivedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          sentAt: null,
          openedAt: written.openedAt.toISOString(),
          sectionC: request.sectionC,
          emergency: request.emergency,
          crossBorder,
          withholdFromAuthor: written.withholdFromAuthor,
          via: "console",
          items: written.items.map(auditItem),
        },
      });
      return written;
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (violatedUniqueConstraint(err) === "legal_orders_reference_key") throw await orderExists(deps, request.memberState, request.authority, request.reference);
    const refusal = orderRefusal(err);
    if (refusal !== null) throw refusal.code === "rate_limited" ? new ModerationError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, (await ordersOpenedToday(deps.apiDb, session.userId)).retryAfterSeconds) : refusal;
    throw err;
  }
  // The deadline a removal order has from its receipt; none for a DSA order, and unknown for a removal order without one.
  const hasClock = request.kind === "tco_removal";
  const facts: AlertFacts = {
    items: inserted.items.length,
    ...(hasClock && inserted.receivedAt !== null ? { dueAt: new Date(inserted.receivedAt.getTime() + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString() } : {}),
    unknown: hasClock && inserted.receivedAt === null ? 1 : 0,
  };
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    await staffAlert(deps, null, 0, { template: "order_opened", facts });
  });
```
